then `qy_hosted_halt`). The output is `query_eq`'s word: in the middle `n < ℓ_{s+1}`, at the top
`n = ℓ_{s+1}` with `X² = budget f ℓ_s` (`budget_eq`), the code `stageCode_eq`. The time: the
setup's `qySetB`, the locator's `qyLoopA (n + 1)`, the writer's (`qy_midB_le`, `qy_topB_le`, with
`j ≤ s < n` and, at the top, `X⁴ < 2 ^ X⁴ = n`), and `n ≤ g n`. -/
private theorem qy_main_long {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (κ : QyKit f g) (hle : ∀ n, n ≤ g n) {x : List Bool}
    (hn : 3 ≤ x.length) :
    ∃ t ≤ qyMainA κ * (g x.length + 1),
      ((qyM₁ κ).tm.runFrom ((qyM₁ κ).tm.initCfg x) t).state = none ∧
      ((qyM₁ κ).tm.runFrom ((qyM₁ κ).tm.initCfg x) t).output =
        query f g (List.replicate x.length true) := by
  rw [qy_initCfg]
  show ∃ t ≤ _, ((phaseHostTM (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ)).runFrom
    _ t).state = none ∧ ((phaseHostTM (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩
      (qyMainRed κ)).runFrom _ t).output = _
  -- the setup
  obtain ⟨t1, ht1, seg1⟩ := qy_setup_long κ hn
  obtain ⟨h1, hc1, -⟩ := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp seg1
  have hs1 := qy_hosted (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ) .setup
    ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩ ⟨.s10, SweepPhase.done⟩ ⟨.loc, ⟨.anc, SweepPhase.sweep⟩⟩ 1 1 _ _ _ _ [] []
    t1 h1 (by simp [qyMainRed]) (fun u hu s hs => qy_mainRed_setup κ s (hs ▸ hc1 u hu)) ∅
    (fun _ h => h)
  -- the locator
  obtain ⟨t2, ht2, c', seg2, hcase⟩ := qy_loop κ hn
  have hq0 : qyAt κ x 0 = qyC ⟨.anc, SweepPhase.sweep⟩ 1
      (fun t => FinTM.bufferTape (qyLay κ x.length 3 0 0 t)) (fun _ => 0) [] := by
    unfold qyAt qyAnc qyLayT
    rw [ladder_zero, Nat.unpair_zero]
    rfl
  rw [hq0] at seg2
  obtain ⟨h2, hc2, -⟩ := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp seg2
  have hs := stage_spec f hn
  have hlog := qy_stage_lt_log f hn
  have hlogn := Nat.log_le_self 2 x.length
  have hj := Nat.unpair_left_le (stage f x.length)
  have hS : qySetB κ x.length ≤
      (κ.cbA + κ.prA + 2 * (Nat.bits (κ.cfA * (κ.cfc + 2))).length + 60) * (g x.length + 1) := by
    unfold qySetB
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by have := hle x.length; omega)
  have hL : qyLoopA κ * (x.length + 1) ≤ qyLoopA κ * (g x.length + 1) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by have := hle x.length; omega)
  have hA : qyMainA κ * (g x.length + 1) =
      (κ.cbA + κ.prA + 2 * (Nat.bits (κ.cfA * (κ.cfc + 2))).length + 60) * (g x.length + 1) +
        qyLoopA κ * (g x.length + 1) + qyWk κ * (g x.length + 1) + 8 * (g x.length + 1) := by
    unfold qyMainA
    ring
  rcases hcase with ⟨hI, ip, T, P, hc', hesc⟩ | ⟨hT, T, P, hc', hesc, h4, hP4⟩
  · -- the middle
    have hmid : Segment (phaseHostTM (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ)) ∅
        (fun _ => True) (qyC ⟨.loc, ⟨.anc, SweepPhase.sweep⟩⟩ 1
          (fun t => FinTM.bufferTape (qyLay κ x.length 3 0 0 t)) (fun _ => 0) [])
        (qyC ⟨.mid, ⟨.m0, κ.rE⟩⟩ ip T P []) (t2 + 1) := by
      rcases hc' with hc' | hc' <;> subst hc' <;>
        exact qy_hosted (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ) .loc
          ⟨.anc, SweepPhase.sweep⟩ _ ⟨.mid, ⟨.m0, κ.rE⟩⟩ 1 ip _ T _ P [] [] t2 h2
          (by simp [qyMainRed]) (fun u hu s hs => qy_mainRed_loc κ s (hs ▸ hc2 u hu)) ∅
          (fun _ h => h)
    obtain ⟨t3, ht3, hh3, ho3⟩ := qy_mid_run κ (x := x) _ _ _ ip T P hesc
    have h3 := qy_hosted_halt (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ) .mid
      ⟨.m0, κ.rE⟩ ip T P [] t3 _ rfl hh3 (fun _ _ _ _ => by simp [qyMainRed])
    have hseg := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp (hs1.trans hmid)
    refine ⟨t1 + 1 + (t2 + 1) + t3, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hW := qy_midB_le κ x.length (Nat.unpair (stage f x.length)).1 (by omega)
        (hle x.length)
      rw [hA]
      omega
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add]
      erw [hseg.1]
      refine ⟨h3.1, ?_⟩
      rw [h3.2, ho3, query_eq f g hn, if_neg (by omega), stageCode_eq]
  · -- the top
    subst hc'
    have htop := qy_hosted (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ) .loc
      ⟨.anc, SweepPhase.sweep⟩ _ ⟨.top, ⟨.t1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ 1 1 _ T _ P [] [] t2 h2
      (by simp [qyMainRed]) (fun u hu s hs => qy_mainRed_loc κ s (hs ▸ hc2 u hu)) ∅
      (fun _ h => h)
    obtain ⟨t3, ht3, hh3, ho3⟩ := qy_top_run κ (x := x) _ _ _ T P hesc h4 hP4
    have h3 := qy_hosted_halt (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ) .top
      ⟨.t1, Sum.inl ()⟩ 1 T P [] t3 _ rfl hh3 (fun _ _ _ _ => by simp [qyMainRed])
    have hseg := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp (hs1.trans htop)
    refine ⟨t1 + 1 + (t2 + 1) + t3, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hX := qy_ladder_succ_eq f (stage f x.length)
      rw [hT] at hX
      set X := f (ladder f (stage f x.length) + 1) + (ladder f (stage f x.length) + 1) + 1
        with hXd
      have hX4 : X ^ 4 < x.length := by
        rw [hX]
        exact Nat.lt_two_pow_self
      have hX1 : 1 ≤ X := by omega
      have hX3 : X ^ 3 ≤ x.length := by
        have : X ^ 3 ≤ X ^ 4 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hX1 (by norm_num)
        omega
      have hX2 : X ^ 2 ≤ x.length := by
        have : X ^ 2 ≤ X ^ 4 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hX1 (by norm_num)
        omega
      have hW := qy_topB_le κ x.length X (ladder f (stage f x.length) + 1)
        (Nat.unpair (stage f x.length)).1 hX3 hX2 (by omega) (by omega)
      have hW' : qyWk κ * (x.length + 1) ≤ qyWk κ * (g x.length + 1) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by have := hle x.length; omega)
      rw [hA]
      omega
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add]
      erw [hseg.1]
      refine ⟨h3.1, ?_⟩
      rw [h3.2, ho3, query_eq f g hn, if_pos hT.symm, stageCode_eq, budget_eq]

/-- **`M₁` on inputs of length `n ≤ 2`**: from its initial configuration it halts
within `qyMainA (g n + 1)` steps with the empty output, the stage query of `1ⁿ`.

**Proof sketch.** The setup's short path (`qy_setup_short`), hosted; then the halting phase, an
emitter of nothing (`qy_emit_stop`, `qy_hosted_halt`). The query is `[]` off its guard
(`query_of_not_guard`). -/
private theorem qy_main_short {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (κ : QyKit f g) (hle : ∀ n, n ≤ g n) {x : List Bool}
    (hn : x.length ≤ 2) :
    ∃ t ≤ qyMainA κ * (g x.length + 1),
      ((qyM₁ κ).tm.runFrom ((qyM₁ κ).tm.initCfg x) t).state = none ∧
      ((qyM₁ κ).tm.runFrom ((qyM₁ κ).tm.initCfg x) t).output =
        query f g (List.replicate x.length true) := by
  rw [qy_initCfg]
  show ∃ t ≤ _, ((phaseHostTM (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ)).runFrom
    _ t).state = none ∧ ((phaseHostTM (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩
      (qyMainRed κ)).runFrom _ t).output = _
  obtain ⟨t1, ht1, v, hv, seg1⟩ := qy_setup_short κ hn
  obtain ⟨h1, hc1, -⟩ := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp seg1
  have hs1 := qy_hosted (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ) .setup
    ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩ ⟨.s6, QyCmp.done v⟩ ⟨.halt, QyEm.pre 0⟩ 1 1 _ _ _ _ [] [] t1 h1
    (by rcases hv with rfl | rfl <;> simp [qyMainRed])
    (fun u hu s hs => qy_mainRed_setup κ s (hs ▸ hc1 u hu)) ∅ (fun _ h => h)
  obtain ⟨t2, ht2, hh2, ho2⟩ := qy_emit_stop (x := x) (κ.tp 15) [] [] 0 false 1 (qySetT5 κ x.length)
    (fun _ => 0) [] [] (by simp [qySetT5, QyKit.tp_inj]) rfl
  have h2 := qy_hosted_halt (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ) .halt
    (QyEm.pre 0) 1 (qySetT5 κ x.length) (fun _ => 0) [] t2 _ rfl hh2
    (fun _ _ _ _ => by simp [qyMainRed])
  have hseg := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp hs1
  refine ⟨t1 + 1 + t2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [List.length_nil, zero_mul] at ht2
    have hS : qySetB κ x.length ≤
        (κ.cbA + κ.prA + 2 * (Nat.bits (κ.cfA * (κ.cfc + 2))).length + 60) * (g x.length + 1) := by
      unfold qySetB
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by have := hle x.length; omega)
    have hA : qyMainA κ * (g x.length + 1) =
        (κ.cbA + κ.prA + 2 * (Nat.bits (κ.cfA * (κ.cfc + 2))).length + 60) * (g x.length + 1) +
          qyLoopA κ * (g x.length + 1) + qyWk κ * (g x.length + 1) + 8 * (g x.length + 1) := by
      unfold qyMainA
      ring
    rw [hA]
    omega
  · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add]
    erw [hseg.1]
    refine ⟨h2.1, ?_⟩
    rw [h2.2, ho2, query_of_not_guard f g (by simp only [List.length_replicate]; omega)]
    simp [qyBody]

/-- **The main machine computes the query on the unary word of every input's length**
(the target's `hmain`): for time-constructible `f` and `g`, `M₁` halts on every
input `x` within `qyMainA (g |x| + 1)` steps with `query f g 1^{|x|}`.

**Proof sketch.** The kit (`qy_kit_exists`); `n ≤ g n` from `Complexity.timeConstructible_iff`;
on each input, `qy_main_long` or `qy_main_short`, read through `Turing.FinTM.computesInTime_iff`
and widened to the bound by `Turing.FinTM.ComputesInTime.mono`. -/
private theorem qy_main {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Complexity.TimeConstructible f)
    (hg : Complexity.TimeConstructible g) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (A : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => query f g (List.replicate x.length true))
        (fun n => A * (g n + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨κ⟩ := qy_kit_exists hf hg
  have hle := ((Complexity.timeConstructible_iff g).mp hg).1
  refine ⟨qyM₁ κ, qyMainA κ, (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mpr fun x => ?_⟩
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge x.length 3 with h | h
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, h1, h2⟩ := qy_main_short κ hle (x := x) (by omega)
    exact ((FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩).mono ht
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, h1, h2⟩ := qy_main_long κ hle h
    exact ((FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩).mono ht

/-- **The stage query in linear time** (C1-E; [the P3.3 gate's round 2, §2]): for
time-constructible `f` and `g` there is a deterministic machine computing the stage query within
`C · (g n + 1)`.

**Proof sketch.**
- Reject a non-unary input or one shorter than `3` by a scan, output `[]`.
- Otherwise run the **capped locator** of the gate's round 2, §2, from `ℓ₀ = 2`. At each stage
  prepare `1^a`, with `a = ℓ + 1 ≤ n`, and run `f`'s witness capped at `c_f · (n + 1)` steps (the
  step clock `Turing.exists_stepClockTMVia`). A timeout, or an output above `n`, places `n` inside
  the current stage. Otherwise compare `(f a + a + 1)⁴` with `⌊log₂ n⌋`, testing whether `n` is a
  power of two at equality, and either stop (`n` is inside the stage, or is its top, keeping `T*`)
  or write `ℓᵢ₊₁` in binary and advance.
- At the stage found, compute `j = (Nat.unpair i).1` and the code `(Nat.bits (j + 1)).dropLast`.
- For the middle, run `g`'s witness.
- Materialize the query with the `pairEncode` writer: bit doubling, the separator, the unary tail.

The ledger is the gate's: preparations and completed witness runs sum to less than `2n`, the last
capped run is `O(n)`, and the binary arithmetic is `O(log³ n)` over `O(log n)` stages. So the
locator is `O(n + 1) ≤ O(g n + 1)` by `n ≤ g n`, and `g`'s witness and the materialization add
`O(g n + 1)`. Fill obligations, named: the locator and its private arithmetic rows (numeric `≤`,
fixed-degree binary arithmetic, the `⌊log₂⌋` comparison, the power-of-two test, `Nat.unpair` on
binary words, the unranking); the `pairEncode` writer; the ledger.

**Implementation status.** Proved. The guard reduces the query to a machine computing it on the
unary word of every input's length. That machine is a phase host of: a linear-time setup
(`bits n` by the input call, `1^{n+1}`, the first rung, the test `n ≥ 3`, the input seek's tape
and an all-ones clock counter); the locator, whose rounds run `f`'s witness under the step clock
on the rung `1^a` and build the next rung `2 ^ (f a + a + 1)⁴` in unary only when it is at most
`n`, each a round at the locator's anchor with interior, top and timeout escapes, the passed
rungs summing to less than `2n`; and two writers, which seek the input head home, compute the
stage code, run `g`'s witness or the budget's square, and emit the `pairEncode` word. -/
theorem exists_queryTM {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Complexity.TimeConstructible f)
    (hg : Complexity.TimeConstructible g) :
    ∃ (G : FinTM Bool) (C : ℕ), G.ComputesFunInTime (query f g) fun n => C * (g n + 1) := by
  suffices hmain : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (A : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => query f g (List.replicate x.length true))
        (fun n => A * (g n + 1)) by
    obtain ⟨M, A, hM⟩ := hmain
    exact qy_query_of_main hg hM
  exact qy_main hf hg

/-- **The diagonalizer** (C1-E; [AB09, proof of Theorem 3.2]; the route of C1's design §2.5 and the
P3.3 gate's round 2, §§3–5): for time-constructible `f`, `g`, an effective scheme `c` and a
deterministic decider of the coded machines' bounded acceptance in exponential time (`hBF`, the
conclusion of `Turing.exists_ndAcceptsWithin_decider`) there are a nondeterministic machine `D` and
a constant `K` with:
- every branch of `D` on every input `x` halts within `K · (g |x| + 1)`;
- for every code `α` a constant `C` such that, on `1ⁿ` with `n ≥ 3` in a stage of `α`:
  - in the middle (`n` not the stage's top): if `D` accepts `1ⁿ` within `K · (g n + 1)`, the coded
    machine accepts `1^{n + 1}` within `g n`; and if the coded machine accepts `1^{n + 1}` within
    some `t'` with `C · (t' + 1) ≤ g n`, `D` accepts `1ⁿ` within `K · (g n + 1)`;
  - at the top (`n = ℓᵢ₊₁`), when `C · 2^{C · (T* + 1)} ≤ n`: `D` accepts `1ⁿ` within
    `K · (g n + 1)` iff the coded machine does not accept the bottom `1^{ℓᵢ + 1}` within
    `T* = budget f ℓᵢ`.

**Why the decider is a hypothesis.** It is stated in
`TCSlib.Complexity.Diagonalization.NTimeHierarchy`, whose `ntime_hierarchy` needs this module,
so this module cannot import it. That proof supplies it from
`Turing.exists_ndAcceptsWithin_decider`; taking it as a hypothesis keeps the two modules' imports
acyclic.

**Proof sketch.** `D` is assembled by the nondeterministic phase host
`Turing.NDTM.phaseHostND`:
- **query:** the stage query by `Turing.NTimeDiag.exists_queryTM`'s machine, called on the native
  input (`Turing.FinTM.exists_inputCallTM`);
- **guess:** `bits (g n)` by `g`'s witness, expanded to a block (`Turing.expandTM`), overwritten by
  the choice writer (`Turing.ndWriterTM_run_block`) and rewound: the stream `s`, with `|s| = g n`.
  In the middle, also a **nominal budget** `b` (C1's design §3.6, the fallback): a word of the
  width of `bits (g n)` from the choice writer, rejected unless its value is at most `g n`, and
  normalized to `bits b`;
- **middle:** the query word with its budget field rewritten from `bits (g n)` to `bits b`, that
  is `⟨⟨bits b, α⟩, 1^{n + 1}⟩`, run by the interpreter core `Turing.exists_ndInterpreterCore` with
  the stream `s` (`b ≤ |s|`), under the step clock (`Turing.exists_stepClockTMVia`) with the body
  allowance `g n` (its counter is `bits (g n)`), accepting iff the interpreter accepts in time;
- **top:** the exponential decider of `hBF` on the query word
  (hosted by `Turing.vhostSilentTM`), under the same clock, accepting iff it completes with
  `[false]`;
- default reject.

**Time.** Every phase before the simulators is code-independent and costs at most `P · (g n + 1)`
for a uniform `P`: the query, the stream, and the budget's guess, test, normalization and rewrite.
The clock runs a simulator for at most its body allowance, `g n` steps, at a physical cost of at
most `5 · g n + 2 · |bits (g n)| + 2 ≤ 7 · (g n + 1)`, and the final dispatch costs a constant `P'`.
So `K = P + 7 + P'` bounds every branch; the body allowance and `K` are distinct quantities.
- **Middle completeness:** if the coded machine accepts `1^{n + 1}` along a word of length `t'`
  with `C · (t' + 1) ≤ g n`, take `b = t'` and a stream whose first `t'` bits are that word. The
  interpreter's total-time clause, `T ≤ C_R · (b + 1)` with no `|x|` term, gives
  `T ≤ C · (t' + 1) ≤ g n` when `C ≥ C_R`: inside the allowance, with the verdict `accept`.
- **Middle soundness:** an accepting interpreter run is an accepting branch along `s.take b` (the
  replay lemma), and acceptance within `b ≤ g n` is acceptance within `g n`
  (`Turing.FinNDTM.AcceptsWithin.mono`). A guess `b` below every acceptance time sees no halted
  accepting branch and rejects.
- **Top:** the decider's time is `C_BF · 2^{C_BF · (T* + 1)} ≤ n ≤ g n`, inside the allowance.

The interpreter's prefix clause is not used: its `|x|` term (`|x| = n + 1`) carries the per-code
constant, which the uniform `K` cannot absorb when `g n = n` (the statement gate, finding 1).

Fill obligations, named: the assembly; the budget's guess, test, normalization and rewrite (a
private leaf in `O(g n + 1)`); the transfer to every branch
(`Turing.NDTM.runWith_mapState_of_agreeOn_det`); the clock's two exits per rung; the per-code
constant `C = max 1 (max C_R C_BF)`. -/
theorem exists_diagonalizer {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Complexity.TimeConstructible f)
    (hg : Complexity.TimeConstructible g) (c : EffectiveNDMachineCode)
    (hBF : ∃ BF : FinTM Bool, ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
      ((c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin x t →
        BF.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) [true]
          (C * 2 ^ (C * (t + 1)))) ∧
      (¬(c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin x t →
        BF.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) [false]
          (C * 2 ^ (C * (t + 1))))) :
    ∃ (D : FinNDTM Bool) (K : ℕ),
      (∀ x : List Bool, D.tm.HaltsWithin x (K * (g x.length + 1))) ∧
      ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, 3 ≤ n → stageCode (stage f n) = α →
        (n ≠ ladder f (stage f n + 1) →
          (D.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate n true) (K * (g n + 1)) →
            (c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate (n + 1) true) (g n)) ∧
          (∀ t' : ℕ, (c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate (n + 1) true) t' →
            C * (t' + 1) ≤ g n →
            D.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate n true) (K * (g n + 1)))) ∧
        (n = ladder f (stage f n + 1) →
          C * 2 ^ (C * (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)) + 1)) ≤ n →
          (D.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate n true) (K * (g n + 1)) ↔
            ¬(c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin
              (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true)
              (budget f (ladder f (stage f n))))) := by
  sorry

end Turing.NTimeDiag

/-! Review probe appendix (not library code): axioms of E-Q's leaves in #176's file, and the
core's input word without the flag, derived from `qy_writer_word` (no second writer lemma). -/
namespace Turing.NTimeDiag

private theorem rv_core_word (B α N : List Bool) :
    qyBody false 3 B ++ [false, false, true, true] ++ qyBody false 1 α ++ [false, true] ++
      qyBody false 0 N = pairEncode (pairEncode B α) N := by
  have h := qy_writer_word true B (α ++ [true]) N
  have hb : qyBody true 1 (α ++ [true]) = qyBody false 1 α := by
    unfold qyBody
    rw [if_pos rfl, if_neg Bool.false_ne_true, List.dropLast_concat]
  rw [hb, List.dropLast_concat] at h
  simp only [List.nil_append, List.append_nil, List.singleton_append, List.cons_append,
    List.append_assoc] at h
  simpa only [List.append_assoc] using (List.cons.inj h).2

end Turing.NTimeDiag

## ===== campaign/fills/eq/inputs/eq-fill-diagonalizer/RVRouteRows.lean.txt =====

/-
Review probe for the E-D brief draft (`eq-fill-diagonalizer.DRAFT.md` at 615e56b4). A probe record,
not library code. It imports what the fill's file sees after its overlay and checks:
* (A) every public row the route needs, cited or proposed, resolves and is free of `sorryAx`;
* (B) the split obstruction: the framed copy/transfer/clear rows need a blank at relative
  position `-1`, which a suffix of a contiguous nonblank block never has;
* (C) the positioning that published rows do allow: skip back over the empty word, then the
  lockstep walk with a ruler `1^G`, lands a head on cell `G` of the block;
* (D) `α` from the query's tail by a function-level composite (an install call's argument), its
  value on the tail, and `1^{n+1}` by the prepend row;
* (E) the core's stream needs no clearing: `(s ++ w).take b = s.take b` for `b ≤ |s|`.
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.Diagonalization.NTimeDiagonalizer
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.NDHost
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.NDCodeSimulator
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.VirtualInput

set_option autoImplicit false

open Turing

namespace RVProbe

/-! ### (B) The split obstruction -/

/-- The framed rows' delimiter hypothesis (`copyMapTM_run_ofCfg`, `transferMapTM_run_ofCfg`,
`clearTM_run_ofCfg`, and the counters of `expandTM_run_ofCfg` and the step clock) fails for the
suffix `w` of a block `s ++ w` read from the suffix's first cell, whenever `s ≠ []`: the cell at
relative position `-1` is `s`'s last symbol, not a blank. -/
theorem rv_no_left_delim (s w : List Bool) (hs : s ≠ []) :
    ¬ (∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      FinTM.bufferTape (s ++ w) ((s.length : ℤ) + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) := by
  intro h
  have hlen : 0 < s.length := by
    cases s with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl hs
    | cons a t => exact Nat.succ_pos _
  have h1 := h (-1) le_rfl (by omega)
  rw [FinTM.bufferTape_left] at h1
  have hc : ((s.length : ℤ) + -1) = ((s.length - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by omega
  rw [hc, FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_append_left (by omega),
    List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)] at h1
  exact Option.some_ne_none _ h1

/-- The same at the query tape: the tail after the flag has the flag as its left neighbour. -/
theorem rv_flag_no_left_delim (b : Bool) (tail : List Bool) :
    ¬ (∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (tail.length : ℤ) →
      FinTM.bufferTape (b :: tail) (1 + p) = FinTM.bufferTape tail p) := by
  have h := rv_no_left_delim [b] tail (List.cons_ne_nil _ _)
  simpa only [List.singleton_append, List.length_singleton, Nat.cast_one] using h

/-! ### (C) Positioning by published rows -/

/-- Skip back over the empty word: from cell `0` of a tape holding a buffer word, the head of
`skipBackTM` ends on cell `-1` (cells `-2` and `-1` are blank). -/
theorem rv_skipBack_empty {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (j : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Bool SeekPhase x)
    (hst : d.state = some .run) (v : List Bool) (hT : d.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape v)
    (hP : d.workTapePos j = 0) :
    ((skipBackTM k j).runFrom d (([] : List Bool).length + 3)).workTapePos j = -1 := by
  obtain ⟨h1, -, -⟩ := skipBackTM_run_ofCfg j ([] : List Bool) d hst (fun p hp1 hp2 => by
    rw [hT, hP, FinTM.bufferTape_of_neg v (by simp only [List.length_nil, Nat.cast_zero] at hp2 ⊢; omega),
      FinTM.bufferTape_eq_none_of_not_mem ([] : List Bool) (by
        simp only [List.length_nil, Nat.cast_zero]; omega)])
  rw [h1]
  show Function.update d.workTapePos j (d.workTapePos j - (([] : List Bool).length : ℤ) - 1) j = -1
  rw [Function.update_self, hP]
  simp only [List.length_nil, Nat.cast_zero]
  omega

/-- The lockstep walk with the ruler `1^G` (tape `A`, head on its first cell) carries a head that
starts on cell `-1` to cell `G`, the first cell after `G` stream cells. -/
theorem rv_walk_to_boundary {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (A j : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool SeekPhase x) (hst : d.state = some .run) (G : ℕ)
    (hA : d.workTapes A = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate G true)) (hPA : d.workTapePos A = 0)
    (hPj : d.workTapePos j = -1) :
    ((walkTM k A (fun i => i = A ∨ i = j) .pos).runFrom d (G + 1)).workTapePos j = G := by
  obtain ⟨h1, -, -⟩ := walkTM_run_ofCfg A (fun i => i = A ∨ i = j) (Or.inl rfl) .pos
    (List.replicate G true) d hst (fun p _ => by
      rw [hA, hPA, show ((SignType.pos : SignType) : ℤ) = 1 from rfl, one_mul, zero_add])
  rw [List.length_replicate] at h1
  rw [h1]
  show d.workTapePos j + (if (j = A ∨ j = j) then ((SignType.pos : SignType) : ℤ) *
    ((G + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) else 0) = G
  rw [if_pos (Or.inr rfl), hPj, show ((SignType.pos : SignType) : ℤ) = 1 from rfl, one_mul]
  push_cast
  ring

/-! ### (D) `α` and `1^{n+1}` from function-level rows -/

/-- The inner second component as a function-level composite of the published extractors
(`Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_comp`): linear time, hence an install call's argument row. -/
theorem rv_alpha_row : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
    M.ComputesFunInTime
      (fun z => ((pairDecode (((pairDecode z).map Prod.fst).getD [])).map Prod.snd).getD [])
      (fun n => c * (5 * (n + 1) + 5 * (5 * (n + 1) + 1) + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨M, c, h⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_comp FinTM.pairExtractTM_fst FinTM.pairExtractTM_snd
    (fun a b hab => by show 5 * (a + 1) ≤ 5 * (b + 1); omega)
  exact ⟨M, c, h⟩

/-- On the query's middle tail `⟨⟨bits b, α⟩, N⟩` the composite returns `α`. -/
theorem rv_alpha_value (B α N : List Bool) :
    ((pairDecode (((pairDecode (pairEncode (pairEncode B α) N)).map Prod.fst).getD [])).map
      Prod.snd).getD [] = α := by
  simp only [pairDecode_pairEncode, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some]

/-- `1^{n+1}` by the published prepend row: `[true] ++ 1ⁿ = 1^{n+1}`. -/
theorem rv_tail_ones : (∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
    M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [true] ++ x) (fun n => c * (n + 1))) ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, [true] ++ List.replicate n true = List.replicate (n + 1) true := by
  refine ⟨FinTM.computesFunInTime_prepend [true], fun n => ?_⟩
  rw [List.replicate_succ]
  rfl

/-! ### (E) The core's stream -/

/-- The core reads only `stream.take b`, so the whole block (stream, then budget word) serves as
its stream when `b ≤ |s|`. -/
theorem rv_stream_take (s w : List Bool) (b : ℕ) (hb : b ≤ s.length) :
    (s ++ w).take b = s.take b :=
  List.take_append_of_le_length hb

end RVProbe

## (b) The route: feasibility from published rows, and the mathematics

**What holds.**
- **The host.** `guessRunTM_haltsWithin` and `guessRunTM_accepts_iff` take exactly the draft's shape:
  - a setup `P` with first exit `TP`;
  - `hblock`/`hend`/`hleft` on tape `j` (a nonblank block of `m` cells from the head, blank at `m` and at `-1`);
  - a uniform `T` for every stream's first verdict;
  - acceptance at every `B ≥ TP + 2m + T + 11` iff some stream reaches `acc` with output `[]` (NDHost.lean 1405-1511).
- **Acceptance.** Its left side is `FinNDTM.AcceptsWithin` verbatim (`acceptsWithin_iff`, NTIME.lean 104), so `D` bundles directly.
- **The core.** `exists_ndInterpreterCore` (NDCodeSimulator.lean 894-912) starts from `⟨some entry, 1, fun i => if i = j then FinTM.bufferTape s else fun _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩` on `⟨⟨bits t, α⟩, x⟩` with `t ≤ |s|`. It needs no `|x|` term in its total-time clause.
- **The top's input.** The top's tail is exactly `hBF`'s input (`ed_query_top`; the statement's negated `AcceptsWithin` at `1^{ℓᵢ+1}` and `budget f ℓᵢ`).
- **Silence.** Every phase of `Q` can stay silent, so the run's output is `[]` at its verdict:
  - the calls end at `Cfg.ofWords …` with output `[]`;
  - the rows emit nothing;
  - `qyEmitTM` runs under `embedSilentTM`;
  - the clock's host output is the body's, and `vhostSilentTM` is silent.
- **Normalization.** `computesFunInTime_lengthBits` through the **install** call (`exists_installCallTM`, the argument a work-tape word) is the right normalization of `1^b` to `bits b`. Its axioms are the standard three: it comes from `timeConstructible_id`, not from the sorried `lengthBitsTM_computes`.
- **The uniform `T` and `K`.** `T = O(g n + 1)` on every stream:
  - `w_b`'s value is at most `2^L − 1 ≤ 2 g n` (`qy_two_pow_bits_le`);
  - every call is linear in `g n + 1`;
  - the clock bounds both simulators by `5 g n + 2L + 2`;
  - `b = 0` and the off-stage inputs (`query = []`) are immediate.

  So `K = P₀ + P₁ + 15` is uniform (`ed_time`).
- **The per-code constant.** `C = max 1 (max C_R C_BF)` works:
  - `C ≥ 1` gives `t' < g n`, so `bits t'` fits width `L` (`ed_width`, `ed_padded_value`);
  - `C ≥ C_R` puts the core inside the allowance;
  - `C ≥ C_BF` and `n ≤ g n` put `BF` inside the allowance.
- **Middle soundness.** It needs the clock's first stop to be the core's first verdict. It is: a halt before `T` would contradict `state = some accept/reject` at `T`. `t = b ≤ g n = |s|` is ensured by the test.

**What does not hold.**
- **(F1) No published row can split a contiguous word**, and the route splits two:
  - **the guessed block**, into the stream and `w_b`;
  - **the query word**, into its flag and its tail.

  Every framed row that reads a word from a head requires blanks at relative positions `−1` and `|w|`:

  ```lean
  -- copyMapTM_run_ofCfg (Catalog.lean 1315), transferMapTM_run_ofCfg (1260), clearTM_run_ofCfg (1523)
  (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
    d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p)
  -- expandTM_run_ofCfg's counter (CounterLoop.lean 1652-1656), the step clock's (StepClock.lean 1104)
  (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → ct (cp + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p)
  ```

  The guessed block is nonblank throughout:

  ```lean
  (hblock : ∀ p : ℕ, p < m → cP.workTapes j (cP.workTapePos j + p) ≠ none)   -- NDHost.lean 1230
  ```

  So `w_b`'s left neighbour (cell `g n − 1`) is a stream bit. "Copy `w_b` off the block and clear its cells (the copy and clear rows)" (draft 139) cannot be done by those rows. `rv_no_left_delim` proves that the hypothesis fails at `p = −1` whenever `s ≠ []`.

  Likewise the query tape holds `bufferTape (flag :: tail)` (the input call's endpoint). Yet `vhostSilentTM`'s buffer must be exactly the buffer of its word:

  ```lean
  workTapes := Fin.addCases (fun _ => FinTM.bufferTape y) c.workTapes   -- VirtualInput.lean 139
  ```

  So `BF` cannot run "on the query word's tail" in place (draft 151-152), and an install call's argument must be at cell `0` too. No published row writes a single blank: `writeConstTM` writes only `some (some w₀[j])` (Scan.lean 136).

  I checked the function-level detours:
  - `computesFunInTime_unaryToken` (sorry-free) splits `false :: tail` but not `true :: tail`, since the top's tail may start with `true`;
  - `computesFunInTime_splitSolve(With)` costs `c (n + 1)^(e + 2)`, resp. `c (n + 1)(TE (n + 1) + n + 2)`, which is superlinear.

  **This is a genuine gap.** The draft's "from published rows and E-Q's leaves, with no new leaf" is false.

  **Smallest fix, a decision for the maintainer.**
  - **(a) Extend the draft's own one-step flag leaf** into `dzTakeTM`: read the cell, write a blank, step right, enter `got o`. Its step lemma is its own, because `qy_step` covers only steps that write nothing. Use it three times:
    1. on the flag, which makes the tail left-delimited, so `copyMapTM_run_ofCfg` copies the tail to a fresh buffer at cell `0`;
    2. on a **separator cell** that `P` adds to the block (`m = g n + 1 + L`, still `≤ 2 (g n + 1)` by `length_bits_le_self`, so `K` and the route probe are unchanged);
    3. to read the top's captured bit after a rewind.

    The block is reached by published rows:
    - `skipBackTM_run_ofCfg` over the empty word moves tape `j`'s head from `0` to `−1` (`rv_skipBack_empty`);
    - `walkTM_run_ofCfg` with a ruler `1^{g n}` (built by `qy_expandHost` in `P`) carries it to the separator, cell `g n` (`rv_walk_to_boundary`);
    - after the blank, `transferMapTM_run_ofCfg` moves the now-delimited `w_b` to a fresh tape and blanks it, leaving tape `j` exactly `bufferTape s`;
    - `skipBackTM_run_ofCfg` over `s` returns the head to `0`.

    The core then finds its stream tape as `exists_ndInterpreterCore` demands.
  - **(b) Commission a public framed "take one cell" row** (read, write blank, step right) in the next shared-file window, and issue E-D after it lands.

  The diff implements (a), marked ⟨the maintainer's decision, review F1⟩.
- **(F2) `α`:** "one hosted call of the second-component extractor on the query word's tail" (draft 143-144) yields `1^{n+1}`, not `α`:

  ```lean
  theorem pairExtractTM_snd : (pairExtractTM false true).ComputesFunInTime
    (fun x => ((pairDecode x).map Prod.snd).getD []) (fun n => 5 * (n + 1))   -- Primitives.lean 1025
  ```

  The route note's machine, `prefixCanonTM (pairExtractTM false true)`, is published only as a native-input run that halts (`prefixCanon_pairExtract_halt`, InterpreterStartup.lean 91-98: `d.state = none ∧ d.output = …`). That is neither a phase (a halt ends the host) nor an argument of a call.

  The published route is one **install call** of the composite `FinTM.computesFunInTime_comp FinTM.pairExtractTM_fst FinTM.pairExtractTM_snd`, linear, on the tail's buffer. `rv_alpha_row` and `rv_alpha_value` prove it, through `pairDecode_pairEncode`.
- **(F4) The hosted runs.**
  - `vhostSilentTM M : MultiTapeTM ((1 + m) + 1) Bool (S × Bool)` (VirtualInput.lean 185), and the clock adds one more tape (`H : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Γ Q`, StepClock.lean 1098). So "the step clock over `vhostSilentTM R`" is a phase of `Q` only after an **embedding into `D`'s `k` tapes**: `embedEmitTM` (E-Q's `qy_embed`), with a tape plan the draft never states.
  - The plan:
    - the core's stream bank tape goes to tape `j` (`bufferTape s`, head `0`);
    - the virtual buffer goes to the capture tape of the three emissions, rewound to `0` (the buffer head is `inputPos − 1 = 0`);
    - the core's other tapes and `vhostCap` go to blank tapes;
    - the counter goes to a copy of `bits (g n)`.
  - Both runs are the same composition, so they should be **one** generic private lemma, not two copies.
- **(F5) `1^{n+1}`** has no source in `P`. The published `computesFunInTime_prepend [true]` through an input call gives it (`rv_tail_ones`).
- **(F6) The core's input word** is `qy_writer_word` without its flag. It follows in one step (`rv_core_word`, proved in the overlay copy: `W := α ++ [true]`, `List.dropLast_concat`, `List.cons.inj`), so no second word lemma is needed.

**P can leave the block where both consumers need it**, once F1 is fixed. `P` builds `1^{g n} ++ [true] ++ bits (g n)` on a fresh tape `j` with E-Q's wrappers (`qy_expandHost` twice, the second with the counter `[true]` from `qy_writeConst`; then `qy_copy`; then `qy_rewind`). ## What this is

**The lazy diagonalizer** ([AB09, proof of Theorem 3.2 and Figure 3.1]). For time-constructible `f`,
`g`, an effective scheme `c` and an exponential-time decider of the coded machines' bounded
acceptance (`hBF`), a nondeterministic machine `D` and a uniform `K` with: every branch of `D` on
every input halts within `K · (g |x| + 1)`; per code `α` a constant `C` such that, on `1ⁿ` with
`n ≥ 3` in a stage of `α`, in the middle `D` accepts `1ⁿ` iff (up to the stated slack) the coded
machine accepts `1^{n + 1}`, and at the top `D` accepts `1ⁿ` iff the coded machine does **not**
accept the stage's bottom `1^{ℓᵢ + 1}` within `T* = budget f ℓᵢ` (the statement, line 5406).

**Where it stands.** The body is `sorry`. Every host is proved, and E-Q's query is proved in your
file. **Proved modulo, exactly:** none. **A complete delivery has no `sorryAx` in the target.**

### Hosts (binding; the host-first rule, `policy.md` §1, `workflow.md` §2)

- **`D` is `Turing.guessRunTM P pexit j Q qentry acc rej`**, bundled as a `FinNDTM`: one guessed
  block of `m = g n + 1 + L` cells (`L = |bits (g n)|`): its first `g n` bits the stream `s`, then
  one separator cell, then the budget word `w_b` of `L` bits. **Halting** is
  `guessRunTM_haltsWithin`; **acceptance** is `guessRunTM_accepts_iff` (not
  `guessRunTM_silent_spec`: your setup is not clean, it keeps the query word and the counter).
  Never compose `phaseHostND` yourself, and never re-prove a writer, handoff or acceptance lemma.
- **No published row splits a contiguous word.** Every framed row that reads a word from a head
  (`copyMapTM_run_ofCfg`, `transferMapTM_run_ofCfg`, `clearTM_run_ofCfg`, the counters of
  `expandTM_run_ofCfg` and of the step clock) demands blanks at the word's relative positions `-1`
  and `|w|`, and no published row writes a blank at one cell. The guessed block is nonblank
  throughout (`guessRunTM`'s `hblock`), and the query's tail has the flag before it, while the
  extractor's argument and `vhostSilentTM`'s buffer must each be exactly `FinTM.bufferTape` of
  their word (`vhostCfg`). So the route has **one own leaf**, `dzTakeTM` (⟨the maintainer's
  decision, review F1⟩): in one step, read the cell under a tape's head, **write a blank there**,
  step right, and enter `got o` with the symbol read. Its step lemma is its own (`qy_step` covers
  only steps that write nothing; rule 10's own-leaf clause), and its docstring names the missing
  row. It reads the flag, splits the block at the separator and reads the top's captured bit.
- **`P`, the deterministic setup:** the query call on the native input (released;
  `exists_queryTM`'s machine through `FinTM.exists_inputCallTM`; `qy_inputSpec`, `qy_callHost`);
  `g`'s witness call (released; through `timeConstructible_iff`), giving `bits (g n)`, and copies
  of it (`qy_copy`: each expansion consumes its counter, and the clock patches its own); the
  **block** on tape `j`: `1^{g n}`, one more `true` (the separator) and a copy of `bits (g n)`, for
  example `qy_expandHost` twice (the second with the counter `[true]`, written by `qy_writeConst`)
  and `qy_copy`, rewound to cell `0` (`qy_rewind`), blank on both sides; the **ruler** `1^{g n}`
  on its own tape (`qy_expandHost`, rewound); the clock's counter `bits (g n)` on its own tape; and
  `1^{n + 1}`, by the input call of the published `FinTM.computesFunInTime_prepend [true]`. Its
  first exit `TP ≤ P₀ · (g n + 1)`, uniform.
- **`Q`, the deterministic run**, a phase host (`Turing.phaseHostTM`) over:
  1. **the flag:** `dzTakeTM` on the query tape: `got none` (`n < 3` or not unary: the query is
     `[]`) → `rej`; `got (some true)` → the top; `got (some false)` → the middle. The flag's cell
     is now blank: the tail's left delimiter;
  2. **the tail:** copy it from the query tape's cell `1` onto a fresh buffer at cell `0`
     (`copyMapTM_run_ofCfg` directly: `qy_copy` assumes the word at cell `0`);
  3. **the middle's preparation** (route note, revision), from published rows, E-Q's leaves and
     `dzTakeTM`:
     - **the split:** skip back over the empty word on tape `j` (`skipBackTM_run_ofCfg`: its head
       from `0` to `-1`), then the lockstep walk `walkTM_run_ofCfg` with the ruler as its source,
       moving the ruler's head and tape `j`'s: tape `j`'s head lands on the separator, cell
       `g n`. `dzTakeTM` blanks it and steps right, so `w_b` is delimited; `transferMapTM_run_ofCfg`
       moves `w_b` onto a fresh tape at cell `0` and blanks its cells, which leaves tape `j`
       exactly `bufferTape s`; skip back over `s` (`skipBackTM_run_ofCfg`) returns its head to
       `0`;
     - **the test:** expand `w_b` to `1^b` (`qy_expandHost`: `expandTM_run_ofCfg` reads any
       little-endian word, top zeros included), rewind it, and compare `1^b` with `s` by
       `qyCmpTM`: `gt` → `rej`;
     - **the normalization** to `bits b`: the install call of `FinTM.computesFunInTime_lengthBits`
       on `1^b` (`FinTM.exists_installCallTM`; `qy_installSpec`, `qy_callHost`);
     - **`α`:** one install call, on the tail's buffer, of the function-level composite
       `FinTM.computesFunInTime_comp FinTM.pairExtractTM_fst FinTM.pairExtractTM_snd`, the second
       component of the first component (on `⟨⟨bits (g n), α⟩, 1^{n + 1}⟩` it is `α`, by
       `pairDecode_pairEncode`). Not `pairExtractTM false true` alone, whose output on the tail
       is `1^{n + 1}`, and not `prefixCanon_pairExtract_halt`, a native-input run that halts;
     - **the core's input** `⟨⟨bits b, α⟩, 1^{n + 1}⟩`, written onto a capture tape by three
       `qyEmitTM` emissions (`bits b`, each bit four times, then `[false, false, true, true]`;
       `α` doubled, then `[false, true]`; `1^{n + 1}` from `P`) **run under the capture wrapper
       `embedSilentTM`**, which records every emission and emits nothing. The word is
       `qy_writer_word`'s without its flag (take `W := α ++ [true]` and cancel the flag: no
       second word lemma). Rewind the capture tape to cell `0`, the virtual input's position;
  4. **the middle's run:** the step clock (counter `bits (g n)`, allowance `g n`) over
     `vhostSilentTM R`, `R` the interpreter core, stopping at its `accept` or `reject`, **embedded
     into `D`'s tapes** (`embedEmitTM`, `qy_embed`): the core's stream tape on tape `j`
     (`bufferTape s`, head `0`), the virtual input's buffer on the capture tape just rewound, the
     core's other tapes and `vhostSilentTM`'s capture tape on tapes blank there, the counter on its
     copy. `finish accept` → `acc`; `finish reject` and `timeout` → `rej`;
  5. **the top's run:** the same composition over `vhostSilentTM BF` on the tail's buffer
     `⟨⟨bits T*, α⟩, 1^{ℓᵢ + 1}⟩` (`query_eq`'s top branch, exactly `hBF`'s input shape), stopping
     at `BF`'s halt. The captured output sits on `vhostSilentTM`'s capture tape with its head
     after it (`embedSilentCfg_cap`): rewind it and read cell `0` with `dzTakeTM`: `false` →
     `acc`; anything else, or a `timeout`, → `rej`.

  **State the clocked, hosted run once**, generic in the hosted machine and its stop set (the
  step clock over `vhostSilentTM`, embedded: a composition of two registered hosts, not a new
  host, and a promotion candidate), and use it for both runs; two copies would be a same-file
  duplicate.

  **`Q` is silent:** both simulators are hosted silently and every other phase emits nothing, so
  the run's output is empty at its verdict, as `guessRunTM_accepts_iff` requires.

### The route (binding where it names a row; the rest is the recommended shape)

**Time, uniform.** `TP + 2m + T + 11` with `m = g n + 1 + L ≤ 2 (g n + 1)` (`length_bits_le_self`)
and `T` the preparation `O(g n + 1)` (the expansion of `w_b` is at most `2 g n` cells:
`qy_two_pow_bits_le`), the clock's `5 g n + 2L + 2` and the dispatches; so `K` is uniform and
`guessRunTM_haltsWithin` gives `D.tm.HaltsWithin x (K · (g |x| + 1))` on **every** input (off unary
inputs the query is `[]` and `Q` rejects at once).

**The middle, per code `α`** (`C = max 1 (max C_R C_BF)`):
- **Completeness:** an acceptance of `1^{n + 1}` along `v`, `|v| = t'`, `C (t' + 1) ≤ g n`: take the
  stream `v` padded to `g n` bits, any separator bit, and `w_b := bits t'` padded with zeros to
  width `L`. The test
  passes, the core runs on `⟨⟨bits t', α⟩, 1^{n + 1}⟩` and accepts at `T ≤ C_R (t' + 1) ≤ g n`,
  inside the allowance (`finish accept`); `guessRunTM_accepts_iff` gives the accepting branch at the
  budget `K (g n + 1)`.
- **Soundness:** an accepting branch has a stream `s` and `b ≤ g n` whose core run accepts inside
  the allowance, so the coded machine's branch along `s.take b` halts with `[true]` (the core's
  clause): `AcceptsWithin (1^{n + 1}) b`, then `AcceptsWithin.mono` to `g n`.

**The top:** `BF` completes within `C_BF 2^{C_BF (T* + 1)} ≤ n ≤ g n`, inside the allowance, so `D`
accepts iff `BF` answers `[false]`; every stream gives the same verdict.

**The interpreter's prefix clause is not used** (its `|x|` term carries the per-code constant, which
the uniform `K` cannot absorb when `g n = n`).

**Edge cases that must stay true:** `n ≤ 2` and non-unary inputs (the query is `[]`: `rej`); a
budget word above `g n` (`qyCmpTM`'s `gt`: `rej`); `b = 0` (`1^0` is empty: `qyCmpTM` and the
`lengthBits` call on the empty word); a stream shorter than an acceptance (the core rejects or times
out: `rej`); `BF` halting with a word other than `[false]` or `[true]` (`rej`); the clock's
`timeout` in either run (`rej`); and `g n = 0` (only at `n = 0`, for the halting clause): the
block is the separator alone, the ruler, `w_b` and every counter are empty, the walk moves one
cell, and the clock's allowance is `0`.

## Known pitfalls at this pin (hard-won)

- **The simps field equations are pointwise**: `funext` before `rw`.
- **Every framed row needs both delimiters** (relative positions `-1` and `|w|`): a word inside a
  nonblank block cannot be copied, moved, cleared or counted until a blank is written before it
  (`dzTakeTM`). E-Q's wrappers assume the word at cell `0` under a head at `0`.
- **`vhostSilentTM`'s buffer is exactly `FinTM.bufferTape y`**, its head at the virtual input
  position minus one: the virtual input sits alone on its tape from cell `0`, its head at `0`
  (input position `1`), with the initial tag `true` (`FinTM.VirtualTag_iff`).
- **The install call's start is `Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)`**: every tape
  of the call blank except tape `0`, all heads at `0`, the input head at `1`. Embed it on tapes
  blank there (`qy_callHost`).
- **`P` starts at its initial configuration** (`guessRunTM`'s lemmas take
  `P.runFrom (P.initCfg z)`): the phase host's initial state through `phaseHostTM_q₀`, the blank
  seam through `initCfg_ofWords`. The calls' and the clock's times are existential: fix them before
  the ledger.
- **`FinTM.lengthBitsTM_computes` is sorried** (the base set): the normalization cites
  `FinTM.computesFunInTime_lengthBits`, whose axioms are the standard three.
- **A call's entry may equal its exit**: run every call released (`seamReleaseTM`), as E-Q's
  review F1 found.
- **The clock's stop state** and first-stop reasoning: E-Q's `qy_clocked_call` and `QyClockSpec` are
  the model for an install call; for a hosted machine, state the clock's clauses afresh over
  `vhostSilentTM`'s run lemma.
- **No core or Mathlib definition is reduced outside `rfl`, `decide` or `show`.** `omega` with
  products as atoms (`ring` first). The linter needs a literal "Proof sketch" before every
  `sorry` (partial only).

## What this is

**The lazy diagonalizer** ([AB09, proof of Theorem 3.2 and Figure 3.1]). For time-constructible `f`,
`g`, an effective scheme `c` and an exponential-time decider of the coded machines' bounded
acceptance (`hBF`), a nondeterministic machine `D` and a uniform `K` with: every branch of `D` on
every input halts within `K · (g |x| + 1)`; per code `α` a constant `C` such that, on `1ⁿ` with
`n ≥ 3` in a stage of `α`, in the middle `D` accepts `1ⁿ` iff (up to the stated slack) the coded
machine accepts `1^{n + 1}`, and at the top `D` accepts `1ⁿ` iff the coded machine does **not**
accept the stage's bottom `1^{ℓᵢ + 1}` within `T* = budget f ℓᵢ` (the statement, line 5406).

**Where it stands.** The body is `sorry`. Every host is proved, and E-Q's query is proved in your
file. **Proved modulo, exactly:** none. **A complete delivery has no `sorryAx` in the target.**

**Read first:** the route note with its revision (`ED-route-design.md`); the target's docstring
(lines 5346–5405), whose sketch this brief refines; `Build/NDHost.lean`'s `guessRunTM` family
(its docstrings name the setup hypotheses); E-Q's leaves named above; `exists_ndInterpreterCore`'s
statement; `Build/VirtualInput.lean`'s header.

### Hosts (binding; the host-first rule, `policy.md` §1, `workflow.md` §2)

- **`D` is `Turing.guessRunTM P pexit j Q qentry acc rej`**, bundled as a `FinNDTM`: one guessed
  block of `m = g n + L` cells (`L = |bits (g n)|`), its first `g n` bits the stream `s`, its last
  `L` the budget word `w_b`. **Halting** is `guessRunTM_haltsWithin`; **acceptance** is
  `guessRunTM_accepts_iff` (not `guessRunTM_silent_spec`: your setup is not clean, it keeps the
  query word and the counter). Never compose `phaseHostND` yourself, and never re-prove a writer,
  handoff or acceptance lemma.
- **`P`, the deterministic setup:** the query call on the native input (released; `exists_queryTM`'s
  machine through `FinTM.exists_inputCallTM`), `g`'s witness call (released; through
  `timeConstructible_iff`), the block (`expandTM` of `bits (g n)`, then a copy of `bits (g n)`), the
  clock's counter `bits (g n)` on its own tape, and rewinds. Its first exit `TP ≤ P₀ · (g n + 1)`,
  uniform.
- **`Q`, the deterministic run**, a phase host (`Turing.phaseHostTM`) over:
  1. **the flag:** read the query word's first cell: blank (`n < 3` or not unary) → `rej`; `true` →
     the top; `false` → the middle (a one-step own leaf);
  2. **the middle's preparation** (route note, revision), **from published rows and E-Q's leaves,
     with no new leaf:** copy `w_b` off the block and clear its cells (the copy and clear rows);
     expand it to `1^b` (`expandTM` with the pattern `[true]`: `expandTM_run_ofCfg` takes any
     little-endian word, top zeros included); compare `1^b` with the stream `s` (`g n` nonblank
     cells) by `qyCmpTM`: `gt` → `rej`; normalize to `bits b` by the published `lengthBits` install
     call on `1^b`; extract `α` by one hosted call of the second-component extractor on the query
     word's tail; write the core's input `⟨⟨bits b, α⟩, 1^{n + 1}⟩` onto a buffer by three
     `qyEmitTM` emissions (`bits b`, each bit four times, then `[false, false, true, true]`; `α`
     doubled, then `[false, true]`; `1^{n + 1}`) **run under the capture wrapper `embedSilentTM`**,
     which records every emission on its capture tape and emits nothing;
  3. **the middle's run:** the step clock (counter `bits (g n)`, allowance `g n`) over
     `vhostSilentTM R`, `R` the interpreter core, stopping at its `accept` or `reject`:
     `finish accept` → `acc`; `finish reject` and `timeout` → `rej`;
  4. **the top's run:** the clock over `vhostSilentTM BF` on the query word's tail
     `⟨⟨bits T*, α⟩, 1^{ℓᵢ + 1}⟩` (`query_eq`'s top branch, exactly `hBF`'s input shape), stopping at `BF`'s halt; then read the captured bit: `[false]` → `acc`,
     anything else, or a `timeout`, → `rej`.

  **`Q` is silent:** both simulators are hosted silently and every other phase emits nothing, so
  the run's output is empty at its verdict, as `guessRunTM_accepts_iff` requires.

### The route (binding where it names a row; the rest is the recommended shape)

**Time, uniform.** `TP + 2m + T + 11` with `m ≤ 2 (g n + 1)` and `T` the preparation
`O(g n + 1)`, the clock's `5 g n + 2L + 2` and the dispatches; so `K` is uniform and
`guessRunTM_haltsWithin` gives `D.tm.HaltsWithin x (K · (g |x| + 1))` on **every** input (off unary
inputs the query is `[]` and `Q` rejects at once).

**The middle, per code `α`** (`C = max 1 (max C_R C_BF)`):
- **Completeness:** an acceptance of `1^{n + 1}` along `v`, `|v| = t'`, `C (t' + 1) ≤ g n`: take the
  stream `v` padded to `g n` bits and `w_b := bits t'` padded with zeros to width `L`. The test
  passes, the core runs on `⟨⟨bits t', α⟩, 1^{n + 1}⟩` and accepts at `T ≤ C_R (t' + 1) ≤ g n`,
  inside the allowance (`finish accept`); `guessRunTM_accepts_iff` gives the accepting branch at the
  budget `K (g n + 1)`.
- **Soundness:** an accepting branch has a stream `s` and `b ≤ g n` whose core run accepts inside
  the allowance, so the coded machine's branch along `s.take b` halts with `[true]` (the core's
  clause): `AcceptsWithin (1^{n + 1}) b`, then `AcceptsWithin.mono` to `g n`.

**The top:** `BF` completes within `C_BF 2^{C_BF (T* + 1)} ≤ n ≤ g n`, inside the allowance, so `D`
accepts iff `BF` answers `[false]`; every stream gives the same verdict.

**The interpreter's prefix clause is not used** (its `|x|` term carries the per-code constant, which
the uniform `K` cannot absorb when `g n = n`).

**Edge cases that must stay true:** `n ≤ 2` and non-unary inputs (the query is `[]`: `rej`); a
budget word above `g n` (`qyCmpTM`'s `gt`: `rej`); `b = 0` (`1^0` is empty: `qyCmpTM` and the
`lengthBits` call on the empty word); a stream shorter than an acceptance (the core rejects or times
out: `rej`); `BF` halting with a word other than `[false]` or `[true]` (`rej`); the clock's
`timeout` in either run (`rej`).

## Known pitfalls at this pin (hard-won)

  review F1 found.
- **The clock's stop state** and first-stop reasoning: E-Q's `qy_clocked_call` and `QyClockSpec` are
  the model for an install call; for a hosted machine, state the clock's clauses afresh over
  `vhostSilentTM`'s run lemma.
- **No core or Mathlib definition is reduced outside `rfl`, `decide` or `show`.** `omega` with
  products as atoms (`ring` first). The linter needs a literal "Proof sketch" before every
  `sorry` (partial only).

                  ((c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin x t →

                    (¬(c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin x t →
                      BF.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode t.bits α) x) [false] (C * 2 ^ (C * (t + 1))))) →
          ∃ D K,
            (∀ (x : List Bool), D.tm.HaltsWithin x (K * (g x.length + 1))) ∧
              ∀ (α : List Bool),
                ∃ C,
                  ∀ (n : ℕ),
                    3 ≤ n →

  TimeConstructible f → TimeConstructible g → ∃ G C, G.ComputesFunInTime (NTimeDiag.query f g) fun n => C * (g n + 1)
NTimeDiag.query : (ℕ → ℕ) → (ℕ → ℕ) → List Bool → List Bool
NTimeDiag.query_eq : ∀ (f g : ℕ → ℕ) {n : ℕ},
  3 ≤ n →
    NTimeDiag.query f g (List.replicate n true) =
      if n = NTimeDiag.ladder f (NTimeDiag.stage f n + 1) then
        true ::
          pairEncode
            (pairEncode (NTimeDiag.budget f (NTimeDiag.ladder f (NTimeDiag.stage f n))).bits
              (NTimeDiag.stageCode (NTimeDiag.stage f n)))
            (List.replicate (NTimeDiag.ladder f (NTimeDiag.stage f n) + 1) true)
      else
        false ::
          pairEncode (pairEncode (g n).bits (NTimeDiag.stageCode (NTimeDiag.stage f n))) (List.replicate (n + 1) true)
NTimeDiag.query_of_not_guard : ∀ (f g : ℕ → ℕ) {x : List Bool},
  ¬(x = List.replicate x.length true ∧ 3 ≤ x.length) → NTimeDiag.query f g x = []
NTimeDiag.budget_eq : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (ℓ : ℕ), NTimeDiag.budget f ℓ = (f (ℓ + 1) + (ℓ + 1) + 1) ^ 2
NTimeDiag.ladder_zero : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ), NTimeDiag.ladder f 0 = 2
NTimeDiag.ladder_succ : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ),

NTimeDiag.le_ladder : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ), i + 2 ≤ NTimeDiag.ladder f i
NTimeDiag.ladder_strictMono : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono (NTimeDiag.ladder f)
NTimeDiag.stage_spec : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) {n : ℕ},

NTimeDiag.stage_eq : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) {n i : ℕ},

                          ∀ u < T,

                                (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).state ≠ some (timeout r)) ∧

                        clockCfg (some (timeout (runFrom c d).state)) (runFrom c d) ct' cp ∧

                        ∀ (r : Option S),
                          (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).state ≠ some (finish r) ∧
                            (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).state ≠ some (timeout r))

  {S : Type u_1} → {Symbol : Type u_2} → (Fin m ↪ Fin k) → Fin k → MultiTapeTM m Symbol S → MultiTapeTM k Symbol S

@embedSilentTM_runFrom : ∀ {m k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol} (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k),
  ∀ cap ∉ Set.range ⇑ι,
    ∀ (M : MultiTapeTM m Symbol S) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (pre out₀ : List Symbol)
      (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (t : ℕ),
      runFrom (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads pre out₀ c) t = embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads pre out₀ (runFrom c t)

                runFrom (Cfg.ofWords entry fun x => []) t = Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (f x))

@expandTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (pat : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (pat.length + 1)) x),
  c.state = some 0 →
    ∀ (w : List Bool) (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ),
      (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → ct (cp + p) = bufferTape w p) →
        ∀ (d : ℕ),
          Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w) = d →
            runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp)
                  (d * (pat.length + 1) + counterOverhead w (d + 1)) =
                counterLoopCfg (some CounterLoopState.done)
                  { state := c.state, inputPos := c.inputPos,
                    workTapes := fun j q =>
                      if j = i ∧ c.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < c.workTapePos j + ↑(d * pat.length) then
                        bufferTape (List.replicate d pat).flatten (q - c.workTapePos j)
                      else c.workTapes j q,
                    workTapePos := Function.update c.workTapePos i (c.workTapePos i + ↑(d * pat.length)),
                    output := c.output }
                  (fun q => if cp ≤ q ∧ q < cp + ↑w.length then some true else ct q) cp ∧
              (∀ t < d * (pat.length + 1) + counterOverhead w (d + 1),
                  (runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp) t).state ≠
                      some CounterLoopState.done ∧
                    (runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp) t).state ≠
                      some CounterLoopState.escape) ∧
                (∀ t ≤ d * (pat.length + 1) + counterOverhead w (d + 1),
                    (runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp) t).workTapePos
                        (Fin.last k) ∈
                      Finset.Icc (cp - 1) (cp + ↑w.length)) ∧
                  ∀ t ≤ d * (pat.length + 1) + counterOverhead w (d + 1),
                    ∀ (j : Fin k),
                      if j = i then
                        (runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp) t).workTapePos
                            j.castSucc ∈
                          Finset.Icc (c.workTapePos j) (c.workTapePos j + ↑(d * pat.length))
                      else
                        (runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp) t).workTapePos
                            j.castSucc =
                          c.workTapePos j
@copyMapTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {Δ : Type u_2} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k),
  src ≠ dst →
    ∀ (extract : Symbol → Δ) (merge : Option Symbol → Δ → Symbol) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x),
      d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep →
        (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = bufferTape w p) →
          runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
              { state := some SweepPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos,
                workTapes := fun j q =>
                  if j = dst ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then
                    Option.map (fun γ => merge (d.workTapes j q) (extract γ)) (bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j))
                  else d.workTapes j q,
                workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
            (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, (runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧
              ∀ (j : Fin k),
                ∀ t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2,
                  if j = src ∨ j = dst then
                    (runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length)
                  else (runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@transferMapTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {Δ : Type u_2} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k),
  src ≠ dst →
    ∀ (extract : Symbol → Δ) (merge : Option Symbol → Δ → Symbol) (rest : Symbol → Option Symbol) (w : List Symbol)
      (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x),
      d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep →
        (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = bufferTape w p) →
          runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
              { state := some SweepPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos,
                workTapes := fun j q =>
                  if j = src ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then
                    (bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)).bind rest
                  else
                    if j = dst ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then
                      Option.map (fun γ => merge (d.workTapes j q) (extract γ)) (bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j))
                    else d.workTapes j q,
                workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
            (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, (runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧
              ∀ (j : Fin k),
                ∀ t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2,
                  if j = src ∨ j = dst then
                    (runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length)
                  else (runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@clearTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol)
  (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x),
  d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep →
    (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = bufferTape w p) →
      runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
          { state := some SweepPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos,
            workTapes := fun j q =>
              if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then none else d.workTapes j q,
            workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
        (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, (runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin k),
            ∀ t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2,
              if j = i then (runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length)
              else (runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@skipBackTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (u : List Symbol)
  (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x),
  d.state = some SeekPhase.run →
    (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑u.length → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - ↑u.length - 1 + p) = bufferTape u p) →
      runFrom d (u.length + 3) =
          { state := some SeekPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos, workTapes := d.workTapes,
            workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i - ↑u.length - 1), output := d.output } ∧
        (∀ t < u.length + 3, (runFrom d t).state ≠ some SeekPhase.done) ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin k),
            ∀ t ≤ u.length + 3,
              if j = i then (runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - ↑u.length - 2) (d.workTapePos j)
              else (runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@rewindTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (u : List Symbol),
  ∀ n ≤ u.length,
    ∀ (d : Cfg k Symbol RewindPhase x),
      d.state = some RewindPhase.start →
        (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p < ↑n → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - ↑n + p) = bufferTape u p) →
          runFrom d (n + 2) =
              { state := some RewindPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos, workTapes := d.workTapes,
                workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i - ↑n), output := d.output } ∧
            (∀ t < n + 2, (runFrom d t).state ≠ some RewindPhase.done) ∧
              ∀ (j : Fin k),
                ∀ t ≤ n + 2,
                  if j = i then (runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - ↑n - 1) (d.workTapePos j)
                  else (runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j

/-! Review probe appendix (not library code): axioms of E-Q's leaves in #176's file, and the
core's input word without the flag, derived from `qy_writer_word` (no second writer lemma). -/
namespace Turing.NTimeDiag

private theorem rv_core_word (B α N : List Bool) :
    qyBody false 3 B ++ [false, false, true, true] ++ qyBody false 1 α ++ [false, true] ++
      qyBody false 0 N = pairEncode (pairEncode B α) N := by
  have h := qy_writer_word true B (α ++ [true]) N
  have hb : qyBody true 1 (α ++ [true]) = qyBody false 1 α := by
    unfold qyBody
    rw [if_pos rfl, if_neg Bool.false_ne_true, List.dropLast_concat]
  rw [hb, List.dropLast_concat] at h
  simp only [List.nil_append, List.append_nil, List.singleton_append, List.cons_append,
    List.append_assoc] at h
  simpa only [List.append_assoc] using (List.cons.inj h).2

end Turing.NTimeDiag

/-

import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Log
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.NDCodes
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassNP.NTIME
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassP.TimeConstructible
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.StepClock
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.InputCall
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Contract.Catalog
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Contract.Seam
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Primitives
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Rewind
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.BufferWords
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.WordTests
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.NDHost
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.NDCodeSimulator
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.VirtualInput

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The lazy diagonalizer of the nondeterministic time hierarchy

[AB09, §3.2, proof of Theorem 3.2 and Figure 3.1] ([Coo72]): the machine `D` of the lazy
diagonalization, as two contracts over a pure description of its stages. C1-E's statement phase
(C1's fill plan, `audits/evidence/c1/C1-fill-plan.md`; the route of
`audits/evidence/c1/C1-design.md` §2.5 and the P3.3 gate's round 2,
`audits/ch3-p33-r2-findings.md` §§1–5).

* **The stages** are pure. The ladder is `ℓ₀ = 2` and `ℓᵢ₊₁ = 2 ^ (T*ᵢ)²`, with bottom `aᵢ = ℓᵢ + 1`
  and budget `T*ᵢ = (f aᵢ + aᵢ + 1)²` (`Turing.NTimeDiag.ladder`, `Turing.NTimeDiag.budget`). An
  input `1ⁿ` with `n ≥ 3` lies in the stage `i` with `ℓᵢ < n ≤ ℓᵢ₊₁` (`Turing.NTimeDiag.stage`).
  That stage diagonalizes against the code `αⱼ` with `j = (Nat.unpair i).1`
  (`Turing.NTimeDiag.stageCode`), so every code recurs at unboundedly many stages: the P3.3 gate's
  fixed-code schedule.
* **The stage query** (`Turing.NTimeDiag.query`) is the word that `D` hands to its simulators.
  - At the top `n = ℓᵢ₊₁` it is the flag `true` and the exponential decider's input
    `⟨⟨bits T*, α⟩, 1^a⟩`.
  - In the middle it is the flag `false` and `⟨⟨bits (g n), α⟩, 1^{n+1}⟩`; `D` rewrites its budget.
  - Off unary inputs of length at least `3` it is `[]`.

  One deterministic machine computes it in time linear in `g n + 1`
  (`Turing.NTimeDiag.exists_queryTM`). Its fill is the capped locator of the gate's round 2, `g`'s
  witness and the materialization.
* **The diagonalizer's contract** (`Turing.NTimeDiag.exists_diagonalizer`) is exactly what the chain
  of [AB09, Figure 3.1] reads:
  - every branch halts within a uniform `K · (g n + 1)`;
  - per code `α` there is a constant `C`;
  - in the middle of a stage of `α`, `D` accepts `1ⁿ` only if the coded machine accepts `1^{n+1}`
    within `g n`, and it does whenever the coded machine accepts within some `t'` with
    `C · (t' + 1) ≤ g n`;
  - at a top, once `C · 2^{C·(T* + 1)} ≤ n`, `D` accepts `1ⁿ` iff the coded machine does not accept
    the bottom `1^a` within `T*`.

## Main definitions

* `Turing.NTimeDiag.budget`, `Turing.NTimeDiag.ladder`, `Turing.NTimeDiag.stage`,
  `Turing.NTimeDiag.stageCode`, `Turing.NTimeDiag.query`.

## Main results

* `Turing.NTimeDiag.budget_eq`, `ladder_zero`, `ladder_succ`, `two_mul_lt_ladder_succ`,
  `stage_spec`, `stage_eq`, `stage_of_le_two`, `stageCode_eq`, `stageCode_frequently`, `query_eq`,
  `query_of_not_guard` — the stages' laws (proved).
* `Turing.NTimeDiag.acceptLang_mem_NTIME` — a halting NDTM's bounded language is in `NTIME`
  (proved).
* `Turing.NTimeDiag.exists_queryTM` — the stage query in linear time (proved).
* `Turing.NTimeDiag.exists_diagonalizer` — the diagonalizer (sorried; C1-E's second fill).

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§3.2, Theorem 3.2 and Figure 3.1.)
* [Coo72] S. Cook, *A hierarchy for nondeterministic time complexity*,
  STOC 1972. (Cited through [AB09]; no external text is required.)
-/

namespace Turing.NTimeDiag

/-- **The budget of a stage** with bottom ladder value `ℓ`: with the bottom `a = ℓ + 1`, the
budget is `T* = (f a + a + 1)²` [the P3.3 gate's round 2, §1]. -/
def budget (f : ℕ → ℕ) (ℓ : ℕ) : ℕ := (f (ℓ + 1) + (ℓ + 1) + 1) ^ 2

/-- The budget, unfolded: `budget f ℓ = (f (ℓ + 1) + (ℓ + 1) + 1) ^ 2`. -/
theorem budget_eq (f : ℕ → ℕ) (ℓ : ℕ) : budget f ℓ = (f (ℓ + 1) + (ℓ + 1) + 1) ^ 2 := rfl

/-- **The ladder** [AB09, Figure 3.1; the P3.3 gate's round 2, §1]: `ℓ₀ = 2` and
`ℓᵢ₊₁ = 2 ^ (T*ᵢ)²`, where `T*ᵢ = budget f ℓᵢ`. -/
def ladder (f : ℕ → ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => 2
  | i + 1 => 2 ^ budget f (ladder f i) ^ 2

/-- The ladder starts at `2`: `ladder f 0 = 2`. -/
theorem ladder_zero (f : ℕ → ℕ) : ladder f 0 = 2 := rfl

/-- One more rung: `ladder f (i + 1) = 2 ^ (budget f (ladder f i)) ^ 2`. -/
theorem ladder_succ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ) :
    ladder f (i + 1) = 2 ^ budget f (ladder f i) ^ 2 := rfl

/-- **The ladder more than doubles**: `2 · ℓᵢ < ℓᵢ₊₁`.

**Proof sketch.** The budget is at least `(ℓᵢ + 2)²`, so its square exceeds `ℓᵢ + 1`, and
`2 · ℓᵢ < 2 ^ (ℓᵢ + 1)` (`Nat.lt_two_pow`). -/
theorem two_mul_lt_ladder_succ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ) : 2 * ladder f i < ladder f (i + 1) := by
  rw [ladder_succ]
  have hb : ladder f i + 1 ≤ budget f (ladder f i) ^ 2 := by
    unfold budget
    have h1 : ladder f i + 1 ≤ f (ladder f i + 1) + (ladder f i + 1) + 1 := by omega
    have h2 : f (ladder f i + 1) + (ladder f i + 1) + 1 ≤
        (f (ladder f i + 1) + (ladder f i + 1) + 1) ^ 2 := Nat.le_self_pow (by norm_num) _
    have h3 : (f (ladder f i + 1) + (ladder f i + 1) + 1) ^ 2 ≤
        ((f (ladder f i + 1) + (ladder f i + 1) + 1) ^ 2) ^ 2 := Nat.le_self_pow (by norm_num) _
    omega
  calc 2 * ladder f i < 2 * 2 ^ ladder f i := by
        have := Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := ladder f i); omega
    _ = 2 ^ (ladder f i + 1) := by rw [Nat.pow_succ]; ring
    _ ≤ 2 ^ budget f (ladder f i) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hb

/-- The ladder is above its index: `i + 2 ≤ ℓᵢ`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `i`, by `Turing.NTimeDiag.two_mul_lt_ladder_succ`. -/
theorem le_ladder (f : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ) : i + 2 ≤ ladder f i := by
  induction i with
  | zero => exact le_of_eq (ladder_zero f).symm
  | succ i ih => have := two_mul_lt_ladder_succ f i; omega

/-- The ladder is strictly increasing.

**Proof sketch.** `Turing.NTimeDiag.two_mul_lt_ladder_succ` at each step. -/
theorem ladder_strictMono (f : ℕ → ℕ) : StrictMono (ladder f) :=
  strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun i => by have := two_mul_lt_ladder_succ f i; omega

/-- Every length is below some rung: `n ≤ ladder f (n + 1)`. -/
theorem exists_le_ladder_succ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ∃ i, n ≤ ladder f (i + 1) :=
  ⟨n, by have := le_ladder f (n + 1); omega⟩

/-- **The stage of a length** `n`: the least `i` with `n ≤ ℓᵢ₊₁`. For `n ≥ 3` it is the unique `i`
with `ℓᵢ < n ≤ ℓᵢ₊₁` (`Turing.NTimeDiag.stage_spec`, `Turing.NTimeDiag.stage_eq`). -/
def stage (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.find (exists_le_ladder_succ f n)

/-- **The stage brackets its length**: for `n ≥ 3`, `ℓ_{stage n} < n ≤ ℓ_{stage n + 1}`.

**Proof sketch.** The upper bound is `Nat.find_spec`. For the lower bound, stage `0` has
`ℓ₀ = 2 < n`; a positive stage `i` has `n > ℓᵢ` by `Nat.find_min` at `i - 1`. -/
theorem stage_spec (f : ℕ → ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ladder f (stage f n) < n ∧ n ≤ ladder f (stage f n + 1) := by
  refine ⟨?_, Nat.find_spec (exists_le_ladder_succ f n)⟩
  unfold stage
  rcases h : Nat.find (exists_le_ladder_succ f n) with _ | i
  · rw [ladder_zero]; omega
  · have hmin := Nat.find_min (exists_le_ladder_succ f n) (m := i) (by omega)
    omega

/-- **The stage is determined by its bracket**: `ℓᵢ < n ≤ ℓᵢ₊₁` gives `stage f n = i`.

**Proof sketch.** `Nat.find` is at most `i` by the upper bound, and a smaller stage `i'` would
give `n ≤ ℓ_{i'+1} ≤ ℓᵢ < n` by monotonicity. -/
theorem stage_eq (f : ℕ → ℕ) {n i : ℕ} (hlo : ladder f i < n) (hhi : n ≤ ladder f (i + 1)) :
    stage f n = i := by
  have hle : stage f n ≤ i := Nat.find_min' (exists_le_ladder_succ f n) hhi
  rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le hle with hlt | heq
  · exfalso
    have hs := Nat.find_spec (exists_le_ladder_succ f n)
    have hm : ladder f (stage f n + 1) ≤ ladder f i :=
      (ladder_strictMono f).monotone (by unfold stage at hlt ⊢; omega)
    unfold stage at hm
    omega
  · exact heq

/-- **Short lengths are in stage `0`** (the statement gate, finding 3): for `n ≤ 2`,
`stage f n = 0`.

**Proof sketch.** `n ≤ 2 < 3 ≤ ℓ₁` (`Turing.NTimeDiag.le_ladder`), so `0` already satisfies the
search. -/
theorem stage_of_le_two (f : ℕ → ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ 2) : stage f n = 0 :=
  (Nat.find_eq_zero (exists_le_ladder_succ f n)).2 (le_trans (by omega) (le_ladder f 1))

/-- **The code a stage diagonalizes against**: the binary word of index `j = (Nat.unpair i).1`,
`(Nat.bits (j + 1)).dropLast` (the binary expansion of `j + 1` without its top bit). Every word
arises for exactly one `j`, and every `j` for unboundedly many stages
(`Turing.NTimeDiag.stageCode_frequently`). -/
def stageCode (i : ℕ) : List Bool := (Nat.bits ((Nat.unpair i).1 + 1)).dropLast

/-- The scheduled code, unfolded: `stageCode i = (Nat.bits ((Nat.unpair i).1 + 1)).dropLast`. -/
theorem stageCode_eq (i : ℕ) : stageCode i = (Nat.bits ((Nat.unpair i).1 + 1)).dropLast := rfl

/-- **Every code recurs at unboundedly many stages** [the P3.3 gate's round 2, §1: the fixed-code
schedule]: for every word `α` and bound `N` some stage `i ≥ N` has `stageCode i = α`.

**Proof sketch.** Take `j + 1 = Nat.ofBits (α ++ [true])`, whose binary expansion is `α` followed
by its top bit, and `i = Nat.pair j N ≥ N` (`Nat.right_le_pair`, `Nat.unpair_pair`). -/
theorem stageCode_frequently (α : List Bool) (N : ℕ) : ∃ i, N ≤ i ∧ stageCode i = α := by
  obtain ⟨m, hm1, hm⟩ : ∃ m, 1 ≤ m ∧ Nat.bits m = α ++ [true] := by
    induction α with
    | nil => exact ⟨1, le_rfl, by simp⟩
    | cons b α ih =>
      obtain ⟨m, hm1, hm⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨Nat.bit b m, ?_, ?_⟩
      · cases b <;> simp only [Nat.bit, cond_true, cond_false] <;> omega
      · rw [Nat.bits_append_bit _ _ (fun h => absurd h (by omega)), hm, List.cons_append]
  refine ⟨Nat.pair (m - 1) N, Nat.right_le_pair _ _, ?_⟩
  simp only [stageCode, Nat.unpair_pair, Nat.sub_add_cancel hm1, hm, List.dropLast_concat]

/-- **The stage query** on an input `x`: the word the diagonalizer builds its rungs from. On a
unary `x = 1ⁿ` with `n ≥ 3`, in the stage `i = stage f n` with code `α = stageCode i` and bottom
`ℓ = ladder f i`:
- at the top `n = ladder f (i + 1)`: `true :: ⟨⟨bits (budget f ℓ), α⟩, 1^{ℓ + 1}⟩`;
- otherwise: `false :: ⟨⟨bits (g n), α⟩, 1^{n + 1}⟩`.

On every other input it is `[]`. -/
def query (f g : ℕ → ℕ) (x : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  if x = List.replicate x.length true ∧ 3 ≤ x.length then
    if x.length = ladder f (stage f x.length + 1) then
      true :: pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (budget f (ladder f (stage f x.length))))
        (stageCode (stage f x.length))) (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f x.length) + 1) true)
    else
      false :: pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (g x.length)) (stageCode (stage f x.length)))
        (List.replicate (x.length + 1) true)
  else []

/-- **The stage query on `1ⁿ`, unfolded**: for `n ≥ 3`, with `i = stage f n`, it is
`true :: ⟨⟨bits (budget f ℓᵢ), αᵢ⟩, 1^{ℓᵢ + 1}⟩` at the top `n = ℓᵢ₊₁` and
`false :: ⟨⟨bits (g n), αᵢ⟩, 1^{n + 1}⟩` otherwise. -/
theorem query_eq (f g : ℕ → ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    query f g (List.replicate n true) =
      if n = ladder f (stage f n + 1) then
        true :: pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (budget f (ladder f (stage f n))))
          (stageCode (stage f n))) (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true)
      else
        false :: pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (g n)) (stageCode (stage f n)))
          (List.replicate (n + 1) true) := by
  simp only [query, List.length_replicate, true_and, hn, ↓reduceIte]

/-- **The stage query off its guard is empty** (the statement gate, finding 3): unless `x` is
unary of length at least `3`, `query f g x = []`. With `Turing.NTimeDiag.query_eq` it covers every
input. -/
theorem query_of_not_guard (f g : ℕ → ℕ) {x : List Bool}
    (hx : ¬(x = List.replicate x.length true ∧ 3 ≤ x.length)) : query f g x = [] := by
  unfold query
  exact if_neg hx

/-- **A halting NDTM's bounded language is in `NTIME`**: if every branch of `D` on every `x` halts
within `K · (g |x| + 1)`, then the language `{x | D accepts x within K · (g |x| + 1)}` is in
`NTIME (g + 1)`. It is the first half of the hierarchy's strictness argument, read off
`Turing.NTimeDiag.exists_diagonalizer`'s time clause.

**Proof sketch.** `Complexity.mem_NTIME_iff` at the constant `K`: the halting clause is the
hypothesis, and membership is acceptance by definition. -/
theorem acceptLang_mem_NTIME (D : FinNDTM Bool) (K : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ x : List Bool, D.tm.HaltsWithin x (K * (g x.length + 1))) :
    {x : List Bool | D.AcceptsWithin x (K * (g x.length + 1))} ∈
      Complexity.NTIME fun n => g n + 1 :=
  ⟨K, D, fun x => ⟨h x, Iff.rfl⟩⟩

/-- The query of a word is the query of the unary word of the same length when the word is unary
of length at least three, and is empty otherwise. -/
private theorem qy_guard (f g : ℕ → ℕ) (x : List Bool) :
    query f g x = if x = List.replicate x.length true ∧ 3 ≤ x.length then
      query f g (List.replicate x.length true) else [] := by
  by_cases h : x = List.replicate x.length true ∧ 3 ≤ x.length
  · rw [if_pos h]
    exact congrArg (query f g) h.1
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact query_of_not_guard f g h

/-- A linear-time decider recognizes all-true words of length at least three. It composes the
published all-true test `Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_allTrue` with three fixed-word tests
`Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_decideEq` by the timed conditional; it introduces no input scan
beyond those rows. No public row decides the length bound.

**Proof sketch.** The all-true test decides unarity. Three fixed-word tests reject the empty word
and the all-true words of lengths one and two. Each conditional preserves a linear time bound. -/
private theorem qy_guard_decider :
    ∃ (D : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      D.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun x => [decide (x = List.replicate x.length true ∧ 3 ≤ x.length)])
        (fun n => c * (n + 1)) := by
  have hcut (w : List Bool) {M : FinTM Bool} {p : List Bool → Bool} {C : ℕ}
      (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) (fun n => C * (n + 1))) :
      ∃ (D : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
        D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [decide (x ≠ w) && p x])
          (fun n => c * (n + 1)) := by
    obtain ⟨E, a, hE'⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_decideEq w
    obtain ⟨F, b, hF⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_const [false]
    obtain ⟨D, d, hD⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond hE' hF hM
    refine ⟨D, d * (a + b + C + 1), (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mpr ?_⟩
    intro x
    have hx := (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mp hD x
    have hout : (if decide (x = w) then [false] else [p x]) =
        [decide (x ≠ w) && p x] := by
      by_cases he : x = w <;> simp [he]
    rw [hout] at hx
    apply hx.mono
    calc
      _ ≤ d * ((a + b + C + 1) * (x.length + 1)) := by
        apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
        have hm : max (b * (x.length + 1)) (C * (x.length + 1)) ≤
            b * (x.length + 1) + C * (x.length + 1) :=
          max_le (Nat.le_add_right _ _) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
        nlinarith
      _ = _ := by ring
  obtain ⟨U, c, hU'⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_allTrue
  obtain ⟨D₀, c₀, h₀⟩ := hcut [] hU'
  obtain ⟨D₁, c₁, h₁⟩ := hcut [true] h₀
  obtain ⟨D₂, c₂, h₂⟩ := hcut [true, true] h₁
  refine ⟨D₂, c₂, ?_⟩
  convert h₂ using 1
  funext x
  refine congrArg (fun b => [b]) ?_
  apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hu, hn⟩
    have hz : x ≠ [] := by
      intro h
      have := congrArg List.length h
      simp only [List.length_nil] at this
      omega
    have ho : x ≠ [true] := by
      intro h
      have := congrArg List.length h
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at this
      omega
    have ht : x ≠ [true, true] := by
      intro h
      have := congrArg List.length h
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at this
      omega
    exact ⟨ht, ho, hz, hu⟩
  · rintro ⟨ht, ho, hz, hu⟩
    refine ⟨hu, ?_⟩
    by_contra hn
    have hlen : x.length = 0 ∨ x.length = 1 ∨ x.length = 2 := by omega
    rcases hlen with hlen | hlen | hlen
    · exact hz (by simpa only [hlen, List.replicate_zero] using hu)
    · exact ho (by simpa only [hlen, List.replicate_succ, List.replicate_zero] using hu)
    · exact ht (by simpa only [hlen, List.replicate_succ, List.replicate_zero] using hu)

/-- A machine for the query on the unary word of every input's length suffices for the full
