  have hs1 := qy_hosted (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ) .setup
    ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩ ⟨.s10, SweepPhase.done⟩ ⟨.loc, ⟨.anc, SweepPhase.sweep⟩⟩ 1 1 _ _ _ _ [] []
    t1 h1 (by simp [qyMainRed]) (fun u hu s hs => qy_mainRed_setup κ s (hs ▸ hc1 u hu)) ∅
    (fun _ h => h)
  -- the locator
  obtain ⟨t2, ht2, c', seg2, hcase⟩ := qy_loop κ hn
  have hq0 : qyAt κ x 0 = qyC ⟨.anc, SweepPhase.sweep⟩ 1
      (fun t => FinTM.bufferTape (qyLay κ x.length 3 0 0 t)) (fun _ => 0) [] := by
    unfold qyAt qyAnc qyLayT
    rw [ladder_zero, Nat.unpair_zero]
    rfl
  rw [hq0] at seg2
  obtain ⟨h2, hc2, -⟩ := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp seg2
  have hs := stage_spec f hn
  have hlog := qy_stage_lt_log f hn
  have hlogn := Nat.log_le_self 2 x.length
  have hj := Nat.unpair_left_le (stage f x.length)
  have hS : qySetB κ x.length ≤
      (κ.cbA + κ.prA + 2 * (Nat.bits (κ.cfA * (κ.cfc + 2))).length + 60) * (g x.length + 1) := by
    unfold qySetB
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by have := hle x.length; omega)
  have hL : qyLoopA κ * (x.length + 1) ≤ qyLoopA κ * (g x.length + 1) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by have := hle x.length; omega)
  have hA : qyMainA κ * (g x.length + 1) =
      (κ.cbA + κ.prA + 2 * (Nat.bits (κ.cfA * (κ.cfc + 2))).length + 60) * (g x.length + 1) +
        qyLoopA κ * (g x.length + 1) + qyWk κ * (g x.length + 1) + 8 * (g x.length + 1) := by
    unfold qyMainA
    ring
  rcases hcase with ⟨hI, ip, T, P, hc', hesc⟩ | ⟨hT, T, P, hc', hesc, h4, hP4⟩
  · -- the middle
    have hmid : Segment (phaseHostTM (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ)) ∅
        (fun _ => True) (qyC ⟨.loc, ⟨.anc, SweepPhase.sweep⟩⟩ 1
          (fun t => FinTM.bufferTape (qyLay κ x.length 3 0 0 t)) (fun _ => 0) [])
        (qyC ⟨.mid, ⟨.m0, κ.rE⟩⟩ ip T P []) (t2 + 1) := by
      rcases hc' with hc' | hc' <;> subst hc' <;>
        exact qy_hosted (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ) .loc
          ⟨.anc, SweepPhase.sweep⟩ _ ⟨.mid, ⟨.m0, κ.rE⟩⟩ 1 ip _ T _ P [] [] t2 h2
          (by simp [qyMainRed]) (fun u hu s hs => qy_mainRed_loc κ s (hs ▸ hc2 u hu)) ∅
          (fun _ h => h)
    obtain ⟨t3, ht3, hh3, ho3⟩ := qy_mid_run κ (x := x) _ _ _ ip T P hesc
    have h3 := qy_hosted_halt (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ) .mid
      ⟨.m0, κ.rE⟩ ip T P [] t3 _ rfl hh3 (fun _ _ _ _ => by simp [qyMainRed])
    have hseg := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp (hs1.trans hmid)
    refine ⟨t1 + 1 + (t2 + 1) + t3, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hW := qy_midB_le κ x.length (Nat.unpair (stage f x.length)).1 (by omega)
        (hle x.length)
      rw [hA]
      omega
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add]
      erw [hseg.1]
      refine ⟨h3.1, ?_⟩
      rw [h3.2, ho3, query_eq f g hn, if_neg (by omega), stageCode_eq]
  · -- the top
    subst hc'
    have htop := qy_hosted (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ) .loc
      ⟨.anc, SweepPhase.sweep⟩ _ ⟨.top, ⟨.t1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ 1 1 _ T _ P [] [] t2 h2
      (by simp [qyMainRed]) (fun u hu s hs => qy_mainRed_loc κ s (hs ▸ hc2 u hu)) ∅
      (fun _ h => h)
    obtain ⟨t3, ht3, hh3, ho3⟩ := qy_top_run κ (x := x) _ _ _ T P hesc h4 hP4
    have h3 := qy_hosted_halt (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ) .top
      ⟨.t1, Sum.inl ()⟩ 1 T P [] t3 _ rfl hh3 (fun _ _ _ _ => by simp [qyMainRed])
    have hseg := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp (hs1.trans htop)
    refine ⟨t1 + 1 + (t2 + 1) + t3, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hX := qy_ladder_succ_eq f (stage f x.length)
      rw [hT] at hX
      set X := f (ladder f (stage f x.length) + 1) + (ladder f (stage f x.length) + 1) + 1
        with hXd
      have hX4 : X ^ 4 < x.length := by
        rw [hX]
        exact Nat.lt_two_pow_self
      have hX1 : 1 ≤ X := by omega
      have hX3 : X ^ 3 ≤ x.length := by
        have : X ^ 3 ≤ X ^ 4 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hX1 (by norm_num)
        omega
      have hX2 : X ^ 2 ≤ x.length := by
        have : X ^ 2 ≤ X ^ 4 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hX1 (by norm_num)
        omega
      have hW := qy_topB_le κ x.length X (ladder f (stage f x.length) + 1)
        (Nat.unpair (stage f x.length)).1 hX3 hX2 (by omega) (by omega)
      have hW' : qyWk κ * (x.length + 1) ≤ qyWk κ * (g x.length + 1) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by have := hle x.length; omega)
      rw [hA]
      omega
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add]
      erw [hseg.1]
      refine ⟨h3.1, ?_⟩
      rw [h3.2, ho3, query_eq f g hn, if_pos hT.symm, stageCode_eq, budget_eq]

/-- **`M₁` on inputs of length `n ≤ 2`**: from its initial configuration it halts
within `qyMainA (g n + 1)` steps with the empty output, the stage query of `1ⁿ`.

**Proof sketch.** The setup's short path (`qy_setup_short`), hosted; then the halting phase, an
emitter of nothing (`qy_emit_stop`, `qy_hosted_halt`). The query is `[]` off its guard
(`query_of_not_guard`). -/
private theorem qy_main_short {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (κ : QyKit f g) (hle : ∀ n, n ≤ g n) {x : List Bool}
    (hn : x.length ≤ 2) :
    ∃ t ≤ qyMainA κ * (g x.length + 1),
      ((qyM₁ κ).tm.runFrom ((qyM₁ κ).tm.initCfg x) t).state = none ∧
      ((qyM₁ κ).tm.runFrom ((qyM₁ κ).tm.initCfg x) t).output =
        query f g (List.replicate x.length true) := by
  rw [qy_initCfg]
  show ∃ t ≤ _, ((phaseHostTM (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ)).runFrom
    _ t).state = none ∧ ((phaseHostTM (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩
      (qyMainRed κ)).runFrom _ t).output = _
  obtain ⟨t1, ht1, v, hv, seg1⟩ := qy_setup_short κ hn
  obtain ⟨h1, hc1, -⟩ := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp seg1
  have hs1 := qy_hosted (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ) .setup
    ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩ ⟨.s6, QyCmp.done v⟩ ⟨.halt, QyEm.pre 0⟩ 1 1 _ _ _ _ [] [] t1 h1
    (by rcases hv with rfl | rfl <;> simp [qyMainRed])
    (fun u hu s hs => qy_mainRed_setup κ s (hs ▸ hc1 u hu)) ∅ (fun _ h => h)
  obtain ⟨t2, ht2, hh2, ho2⟩ := qy_emit_stop (x := x) (κ.tp 15) [] [] 0 false 1 (qySetT5 κ x.length)
    (fun _ => 0) [] [] (by simp [qySetT5, QyKit.tp_inj]) rfl
  have h2 := qy_hosted_halt (qyMainM κ) ⟨.setup, ⟨.s1, Sum.inl ()⟩⟩ (qyMainRed κ) .halt
    (QyEm.pre 0) 1 (qySetT5 κ x.length) (fun _ => 0) [] t2 _ rfl hh2
    (fun _ _ _ _ => by simp [qyMainRed])
  have hseg := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp hs1
  refine ⟨t1 + 1 + t2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [List.length_nil, zero_mul] at ht2
    have hS : qySetB κ x.length ≤
        (κ.cbA + κ.prA + 2 * (Nat.bits (κ.cfA * (κ.cfc + 2))).length + 60) * (g x.length + 1) := by
      unfold qySetB
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by have := hle x.length; omega)
    have hA : qyMainA κ * (g x.length + 1) =
        (κ.cbA + κ.prA + 2 * (Nat.bits (κ.cfA * (κ.cfc + 2))).length + 60) * (g x.length + 1) +
          qyLoopA κ * (g x.length + 1) + qyWk κ * (g x.length + 1) + 8 * (g x.length + 1) := by
      unfold qyMainA
      ring
    rw [hA]
    omega
  · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add]
    erw [hseg.1]
    refine ⟨h2.1, ?_⟩
    rw [h2.2, ho2, query_of_not_guard f g (by simp only [List.length_replicate]; omega)]
    simp [qyBody]

/-- **The main machine computes the query on the unary word of every input's length**
(the target's `hmain`): for time-constructible `f` and `g`, `M₁` halts on every
input `x` within `qyMainA (g |x| + 1)` steps with `query f g 1^{|x|}`.

**Proof sketch.** The kit (`qy_kit_exists`); `n ≤ g n` from `Complexity.timeConstructible_iff`;
on each input, `qy_main_long` or `qy_main_short`, read through `Turing.FinTM.computesInTime_iff`
and widened to the bound by `Turing.FinTM.ComputesInTime.mono`. -/
private theorem qy_main {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Complexity.TimeConstructible f)
    (hg : Complexity.TimeConstructible g) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (A : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => query f g (List.replicate x.length true))
        (fun n => A * (g n + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨κ⟩ := qy_kit_exists hf hg
  have hle := ((Complexity.timeConstructible_iff g).mp hg).1
  refine ⟨qyM₁ κ, qyMainA κ, (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mpr fun x => ?_⟩
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge x.length 3 with h | h
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, h1, h2⟩ := qy_main_short κ hle (x := x) (by omega)
    exact ((FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩).mono ht
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, h1, h2⟩ := qy_main_long κ hle h
    exact ((FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩).mono ht

/-- **The stage query in linear time** (C1-E; [the P3.3 gate's round 2, §2]): for
time-constructible `f` and `g` there is a deterministic machine computing the stage query within
`C · (g n + 1)`.

**Proof sketch.**
- Reject a non-unary input or one shorter than `3` by a scan, output `[]`.
- Otherwise run the **capped locator** of the gate's round 2, §2, from `ℓ₀ = 2`. At each stage
  prepare `1^a`, with `a = ℓ + 1 ≤ n`, and run `f`'s witness capped at `c_f · (n + 1)` steps (the
  step clock `Turing.exists_stepClockTMVia`). A timeout, or an output above `n`, places `n` inside
  the current stage. Otherwise compare `(f a + a + 1)⁴` with `⌊log₂ n⌋`, testing whether `n` is a
  power of two at equality, and either stop (`n` is inside the stage, or is its top, keeping `T*`)
  or write `ℓᵢ₊₁` in binary and advance.
- At the stage found, compute `j = (Nat.unpair i).1` and the code `(Nat.bits (j + 1)).dropLast`.
- For the middle, run `g`'s witness.
- Materialize the query with the `pairEncode` writer: bit doubling, the separator, the unary tail.

The ledger is the gate's: preparations and completed witness runs sum to less than `2n`, the last
capped run is `O(n)`, and the binary arithmetic is `O(log³ n)` over `O(log n)` stages. So the
locator is `O(n + 1) ≤ O(g n + 1)` by `n ≤ g n`, and `g`'s witness and the materialization add
`O(g n + 1)`. Fill obligations, named: the locator and its private arithmetic rows (numeric `≤`,
fixed-degree binary arithmetic, the `⌊log₂⌋` comparison, the power-of-two test, `Nat.unpair` on
binary words, the unranking); the `pairEncode` writer; the ledger.

**Implementation status.** Proved. The guard reduces the query to a machine computing it on the
unary word of every input's length. That machine is a phase host of: a linear-time setup
(`bits n` by the input call, `1^{n+1}`, the first rung, the test `n ≥ 3`, the input seek's tape
and an all-ones clock counter); the locator, whose rounds run `f`'s witness under the step clock
on the rung `1^a` and build the next rung `2 ^ (f a + a + 1)⁴` in unary only when it is at most
`n`, each a round at the locator's anchor with interior, top and timeout escapes, the passed
rungs summing to less than `2n`; and two writers, which seek the input head home, compute the
stage code, run `g`'s witness or the budget's square, and emit the `pairEncode` word. -/
theorem exists_queryTM {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Complexity.TimeConstructible f)
    (hg : Complexity.TimeConstructible g) :
    ∃ (G : FinTM Bool) (C : ℕ), G.ComputesFunInTime (query f g) fun n => C * (g n + 1) := by
  suffices hmain : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (A : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => query f g (List.replicate x.length true))
        (fun n => A * (g n + 1)) by
    obtain ⟨M, A, hM⟩ := hmain
    exact qy_query_of_main hg hM
  exact qy_main hf hg

/-- **The diagonalizer** (C1-E; [AB09, proof of Theorem 3.2]; the route of C1's design §2.5 and the
P3.3 gate's round 2, §§3–5): for time-constructible `f`, `g`, an effective scheme `c` and a
deterministic decider of the coded machines' bounded acceptance in exponential time (`hBF`, the
conclusion of `Turing.exists_ndAcceptsWithin_decider`) there are a nondeterministic machine `D` and
a constant `K` with:
- every branch of `D` on every input `x` halts within `K · (g |x| + 1)`;
- for every code `α` a constant `C` such that, on `1ⁿ` with `n ≥ 3` in a stage of `α`:
  - in the middle (`n` not the stage's top): if `D` accepts `1ⁿ` within `K · (g n + 1)`, the coded
    machine accepts `1^{n + 1}` within `g n`; and if the coded machine accepts `1^{n + 1}` within
    some `t'` with `C · (t' + 1) ≤ g n`, `D` accepts `1ⁿ` within `K · (g n + 1)`;
  - at the top (`n = ℓᵢ₊₁`), when `C · 2^{C · (T* + 1)} ≤ n`: `D` accepts `1ⁿ` within
    `K · (g n + 1)` iff the coded machine does not accept the bottom `1^{ℓᵢ + 1}` within
    `T* = budget f ℓᵢ`.

**Why the decider is a hypothesis.** It is stated in
`TCSlib.Complexity.Diagonalization.NTimeHierarchy`, whose `ntime_hierarchy` needs this module,
so this module cannot import it. That proof supplies it from
`Turing.exists_ndAcceptsWithin_decider`; taking it as a hypothesis keeps the two modules' imports
acyclic.

**Proof sketch.** `D` is assembled by the nondeterministic phase host
`Turing.NDTM.phaseHostND`:
- **query:** the stage query by `Turing.NTimeDiag.exists_queryTM`'s machine, called on the native
  input (`Turing.FinTM.exists_inputCallTM`);
- **guess:** `bits (g n)` by `g`'s witness, expanded to a block (`Turing.expandTM`), overwritten by
  the choice writer (`Turing.ndWriterTM_run_block`) and rewound: the stream `s`, with `|s| = g n`.
  In the middle, also a **nominal budget** `b` (C1's design §3.6, the fallback): a word of the
  width of `bits (g n)` from the choice writer, rejected unless its value is at most `g n`, and
  normalized to `bits b`;
- **middle:** the query word with its budget field rewritten from `bits (g n)` to `bits b`, that
  is `⟨⟨bits b, α⟩, 1^{n + 1}⟩`, run by the interpreter core `Turing.exists_ndInterpreterCore` with
  the stream `s` (`b ≤ |s|`), under the step clock (`Turing.exists_stepClockTMVia`) with the body
  allowance `g n` (its counter is `bits (g n)`), accepting iff the interpreter accepts in time;
- **top:** the exponential decider of `hBF` on the query word
  (hosted by `Turing.vhostSilentTM`), under the same clock, accepting iff it completes with
  `[false]`;
- default reject.

**Time.** Every phase before the simulators is code-independent and costs at most `P · (g n + 1)`
for a uniform `P`: the query, the stream, and the budget's guess, test, normalization and rewrite.
The clock runs a simulator for at most its body allowance, `g n` steps, at a physical cost of at
most `5 · g n + 2 · |bits (g n)| + 2 ≤ 7 · (g n + 1)`, and the final dispatch costs a constant `P'`.
So `K = P + 7 + P'` bounds every branch; the body allowance and `K` are distinct quantities.
- **Middle completeness:** if the coded machine accepts `1^{n + 1}` along a word of length `t'`
  with `C · (t' + 1) ≤ g n`, take `b = t'` and a stream whose first `t'` bits are that word. The
  interpreter's total-time clause, `T ≤ C_R · (b + 1)` with no `|x|` term, gives
  `T ≤ C · (t' + 1) ≤ g n` when `C ≥ C_R`: inside the allowance, with the verdict `accept`.
- **Middle soundness:** an accepting interpreter run is an accepting branch along `s.take b` (the
  replay lemma), and acceptance within `b ≤ g n` is acceptance within `g n`
  (`Turing.FinNDTM.AcceptsWithin.mono`). A guess `b` below every acceptance time sees no halted
  accepting branch and rejects.
- **Top:** the decider's time is `C_BF · 2^{C_BF · (T* + 1)} ≤ n ≤ g n`, inside the allowance.

The interpreter's prefix clause is not used: its `|x|` term (`|x| = n + 1`) carries the per-code
constant, which the uniform `K` cannot absorb when `g n = n` (the statement gate, finding 1).

Fill obligations, named: the assembly; the budget's guess, test, normalization and rewrite (a
private leaf in `O(g n + 1)`); the transfer to every branch
(`Turing.NDTM.runWith_mapState_of_agreeOn_det`); the clock's two exits per rung; the per-code
constant `C = max 1 (max C_R C_BF)`. -/
theorem exists_diagonalizer {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Complexity.TimeConstructible f)
    (hg : Complexity.TimeConstructible g) (c : EffectiveNDMachineCode)
    (hBF : ∃ BF : FinTM Bool, ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
      ((c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin x t →
        BF.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) [true]
          (C * 2 ^ (C * (t + 1)))) ∧
      (¬(c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin x t →
        BF.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) [false]
          (C * 2 ^ (C * (t + 1))))) :
    ∃ (D : FinNDTM Bool) (K : ℕ),
      (∀ x : List Bool, D.tm.HaltsWithin x (K * (g x.length + 1))) ∧
      ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, 3 ≤ n → stageCode (stage f n) = α →
        (n ≠ ladder f (stage f n + 1) →
          (D.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate n true) (K * (g n + 1)) →
            (c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate (n + 1) true) (g n)) ∧
          (∀ t' : ℕ, (c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate (n + 1) true) t' →
            C * (t' + 1) ≤ g n →
            D.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate n true) (K * (g n + 1)))) ∧
        (n = ladder f (stage f n + 1) →
          C * 2 ^ (C * (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)) + 1)) ≤ n →
          (D.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate n true) (K * (g n + 1)) ↔
            ¬(c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin
              (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true)
              (budget f (ladder f (stage f n))))) := by
  sorry

end Turing.NTimeDiag

/-! Review probe appendix (not library code): axioms of E-Q's leaves in #176's file, and the
core's input word without the flag, derived from `qy_writer_word` (no second writer lemma). -/
namespace Turing.NTimeDiag

private theorem rv_core_word (B α N : List Bool) :
    qyBody false 3 B ++ [false, false, true, true] ++ qyBody false 1 α ++ [false, true] ++
      qyBody false 0 N = pairEncode (pairEncode B α) N := by
  have h := qy_writer_word true B (α ++ [true]) N
  have hb : qyBody true 1 (α ++ [true]) = qyBody false 1 α := by
    unfold qyBody
    rw [if_pos rfl, if_neg Bool.false_ne_true, List.dropLast_concat]
  rw [hb, List.dropLast_concat] at h
  simp only [List.nil_append, List.append_nil, List.singleton_append, List.cons_append,
    List.append_assoc] at h
  simpa only [List.append_assoc] using (List.cons.inj h).2

end Turing.NTimeDiag

## ===== campaign/fills/eq/reviews/ed-brief/probe/RVRouteRows.lean.txt =====

/-
Review probe for the E-D brief draft (`eq-fill-diagonalizer.DRAFT.md` at 615e56b4). A probe record,
not library code. It imports what the fill's file sees after its overlay and checks:
* (A) every public row the route needs, cited or proposed, resolves and is free of `sorryAx`;
* (B) the split obstruction: the framed copy/transfer/clear rows need a blank at relative
  position `-1`, which a suffix of a contiguous nonblank block never has;
* (C) the positioning that published rows do allow: skip back over the empty word, then the
  lockstep walk with a ruler `1^G`, lands a head on cell `G` of the block;
* (D) `α` from the query's tail by a function-level composite (an install call's argument), its
  value on the tail, and `1^{n+1}` by the prepend row;
* (E) the core's stream needs no clearing: `(s ++ w).take b = s.take b` for `b ≤ |s|`.
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.Diagonalization.NTimeDiagonalizer
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.NDHost
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.NDCodeSimulator
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.VirtualInput

set_option autoImplicit false

open Turing

namespace RVProbe

/-! ### (B) The split obstruction -/

/-- The framed rows' delimiter hypothesis (`copyMapTM_run_ofCfg`, `transferMapTM_run_ofCfg`,
`clearTM_run_ofCfg`, and the counters of `expandTM_run_ofCfg` and the step clock) fails for the
suffix `w` of a block `s ++ w` read from the suffix's first cell, whenever `s ≠ []`: the cell at
relative position `-1` is `s`'s last symbol, not a blank. -/
theorem rv_no_left_delim (s w : List Bool) (hs : s ≠ []) :
    ¬ (∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      FinTM.bufferTape (s ++ w) ((s.length : ℤ) + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) := by
  intro h
  have hlen : 0 < s.length := by
    cases s with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl hs
    | cons a t => exact Nat.succ_pos _
  have h1 := h (-1) le_rfl (by omega)
  rw [FinTM.bufferTape_left] at h1
  have hc : ((s.length : ℤ) + -1) = ((s.length - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by omega
  rw [hc, FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_append_left (by omega),
    List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)] at h1
  exact Option.some_ne_none _ h1

/-- The same at the query tape: the tail after the flag has the flag as its left neighbour. -/
theorem rv_flag_no_left_delim (b : Bool) (tail : List Bool) :
    ¬ (∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (tail.length : ℤ) →
      FinTM.bufferTape (b :: tail) (1 + p) = FinTM.bufferTape tail p) := by
  have h := rv_no_left_delim [b] tail (List.cons_ne_nil _ _)
  simpa only [List.singleton_append, List.length_singleton, Nat.cast_one] using h

/-! ### (C) Positioning by published rows -/

/-- Skip back over the empty word: from cell `0` of a tape holding a buffer word, the head of
`skipBackTM` ends on cell `-1` (cells `-2` and `-1` are blank). -/
theorem rv_skipBack_empty {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (j : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Bool SeekPhase x)
    (hst : d.state = some .run) (v : List Bool) (hT : d.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape v)
    (hP : d.workTapePos j = 0) :
    ((skipBackTM k j).runFrom d (([] : List Bool).length + 3)).workTapePos j = -1 := by
  obtain ⟨h1, -, -⟩ := skipBackTM_run_ofCfg j ([] : List Bool) d hst (fun p hp1 hp2 => by
    rw [hT, hP, FinTM.bufferTape_of_neg v (by simp only [List.length_nil, Nat.cast_zero] at hp2 ⊢; omega),
      FinTM.bufferTape_eq_none_of_not_mem ([] : List Bool) (by
        simp only [List.length_nil, Nat.cast_zero]; omega)])
  rw [h1]
  show Function.update d.workTapePos j (d.workTapePos j - (([] : List Bool).length : ℤ) - 1) j = -1
  rw [Function.update_self, hP]
  simp only [List.length_nil, Nat.cast_zero]
  omega

/-- The lockstep walk with the ruler `1^G` (tape `A`, head on its first cell) carries a head that
starts on cell `-1` to cell `G`, the first cell after `G` stream cells. -/
theorem rv_walk_to_boundary {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (A j : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool SeekPhase x) (hst : d.state = some .run) (G : ℕ)
    (hA : d.workTapes A = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate G true)) (hPA : d.workTapePos A = 0)
    (hPj : d.workTapePos j = -1) :
    ((walkTM k A (fun i => i = A ∨ i = j) .pos).runFrom d (G + 1)).workTapePos j = G := by
  obtain ⟨h1, -, -⟩ := walkTM_run_ofCfg A (fun i => i = A ∨ i = j) (Or.inl rfl) .pos
    (List.replicate G true) d hst (fun p _ => by
      rw [hA, hPA, show ((SignType.pos : SignType) : ℤ) = 1 from rfl, one_mul, zero_add])
  rw [List.length_replicate] at h1
  rw [h1]
  show d.workTapePos j + (if (j = A ∨ j = j) then ((SignType.pos : SignType) : ℤ) *
    ((G + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) else 0) = G
  rw [if_pos (Or.inr rfl), hPj, show ((SignType.pos : SignType) : ℤ) = 1 from rfl, one_mul]
  push_cast
  ring

/-! ### (D) `α` and `1^{n+1}` from function-level rows -/

/-- The inner second component as a function-level composite of the published extractors
(`Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_comp`): linear time, hence an install call's argument row. -/
theorem rv_alpha_row : ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
    M.ComputesFunInTime
      (fun z => ((pairDecode (((pairDecode z).map Prod.fst).getD [])).map Prod.snd).getD [])
      (fun n => c * (5 * (n + 1) + 5 * (5 * (n + 1) + 1) + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨M, c, h⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_comp FinTM.pairExtractTM_fst FinTM.pairExtractTM_snd
    (fun a b hab => by show 5 * (a + 1) ≤ 5 * (b + 1); omega)
  exact ⟨M, c, h⟩

/-- On the query's middle tail `⟨⟨bits b, α⟩, N⟩` the composite returns `α`. -/
theorem rv_alpha_value (B α N : List Bool) :
    ((pairDecode (((pairDecode (pairEncode (pairEncode B α) N)).map Prod.fst).getD [])).map
      Prod.snd).getD [] = α := by
  simp only [pairDecode_pairEncode, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some]

/-- `1^{n+1}` by the published prepend row: `[true] ++ 1ⁿ = 1^{n+1}`. -/
theorem rv_tail_ones : (∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
    M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [true] ++ x) (fun n => c * (n + 1))) ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, [true] ++ List.replicate n true = List.replicate (n + 1) true := by
  refine ⟨FinTM.computesFunInTime_prepend [true], fun n => ?_⟩
  rw [List.replicate_succ]
  rfl

/-! ### (E) The core's stream -/

/-- The core reads only `stream.take b`, so the whole block (stream, then budget word) serves as
its stream when `b ≤ |s|`. -/
theorem rv_stream_take (s w : List Bool) (b : ℕ) (hb : b ≤ s.length) :
    (s ++ w).take b = s.take b :=
  List.take_append_of_le_length hb

end RVProbe

/-! ### (A) The rows: resolution and axioms -/

## ===== campaign/fills/eq/reviews/ed-brief/tools/apply_edits.py =====

```
"""Apply the review's proposed edits to the E-D draft, every replacement asserted.
usage: python3 -I apply_edits.py <draft.md>   (edits in place)"""
import sys

p = sys.argv[1]
s = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read()


def rep(old, new):
    global s
    n = s.count(old)
    assert n == 1, (n, old[:120])
    s = s.replace(old, new)


def rep_between(start, end, new):
    """Replace the text from `start` (inclusive) through `end` (inclusive)."""
    global s
    assert s.count(start) == 1, start[:80]
    assert s.count(end) == 1, end[:80]
    i = s.index(start)
    j = s.index(end) + len(end)
    assert i < j
    s = s[:i] + new + s[j:]
```

## ===== campaign/fills/eq/reviews/ed-brief/tools/closure.py =====

```
"""Independent import-closure derivation for the E-D review (reads files only).
usage: python3 -I closure.py <worktree> <overlay-file> <target-module>"""
import os, re, sys
wt, overlay, target = sys.argv[1:4]
IMP = re.compile(r'^\s*import\s+(\S+)', re.M)
def strip_comments(s):
    s = re.sub(r'/-.*?-/', '', s, flags=re.S)
    return re.sub(r'--[^\n]*', '', s)
def imports_of_text(s):
    head = strip_comments(s)
    out = []
    for line in head.split('\n'):
        m = re.match(r'^\s*import\s+(\S+)', line)
        if m: out.append(m.group(1))
        elif line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith('import') and out:
            # imports precede everything else; stop at first non-import, non-blank line
            if not line.strip().startswith('set_option') and not line.strip().startswith('/-'):
                pass
    return out
def mod_path(m):
    return os.path.join(wt, *m.split('.')) + '.lean'
cache = {}
def imps(m):
    if m in cache: return cache[m]
    if m == target:
        txt = open(overlay, encoding='utf-8').read()
    else:
        p = mod_path(m)
        txt = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read() if os.path.exists(p) else ''
    cache[m] = imports_of_text(txt)
    return cache[m]
# forward closure (TCSlib modules) and Mathlib roots
seen, order, stack = set(), [], []
def visit(m):
    if m in seen: return
    seen.add(m)
    for d in imps(m):
        if d.startswith('TCSlib'): visit(d)
    order.append(m)
visit(target)
tcs = [m for m in order]
mathlib = set()
for m in tcs:
    for d in imps(m):
        if d.startswith('Mathlib'): mathlib.add(d)
print('FORWARD_CLOSURE', len(tcs))
for m in tcs: print('  F', m)
print('MATHLIB_DIRECT_IMPORTS', len(mathlib))
for m in sorted(mathlib): print('  M', m)
# reverse dependents of target across the tree
allmods = []
for root, _, files in os.walk(os.path.join(wt, 'TCSlib')):
    for f in files:
        if f.endswith('.lean'):
            rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, f), wt)[:-5]
            allmods.append(rel.replace(os.sep, '.'))
if os.path.exists(os.path.join(wt, 'TCSlib.lean')): allmods.append('TCSlib')
rev = set([target]); changed = True
while changed:
    changed = False
    for m in allmods:
        if m not in rev and any(d in rev for d in imps(m)):
            rev.add(m); changed = True
print('REVERSE_DEPENDENTS', len(rev) - 1)
for m in sorted(rev - {target}): print('  R', m)
```

## ===== campaign/fills/eq/reviews/ed-brief/tools/closure2.py =====

```
"""Forward closure of a start module, with one module's text replaced by an overlay file.
usage: python3 -I closure2.py <worktree> <overlay-file> <overlaid-module> <start-module>"""
import os, re, sys
wt, overlay, target, start = sys.argv[1:5]
def strip_comments(s):
    s = re.sub(r'/-.*?-/', '', s, flags=re.S)
    return re.sub(r'--[^\n]*', '', s)
def imps(m):
    if m == target: txt = open(overlay, encoding='utf-8').read()
    else:
        p = os.path.join(wt, *m.split('.')) + '.lean'
        txt = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read() if os.path.exists(p) else ''
    return [mm.group(1) for mm in re.finditer(r'^\s*import\s+(\S+)', strip_comments(txt), re.M)]
seen, order = set(), []
def visit(m):
    if m in seen: return
    seen.add(m)
    for d in imps(m):
        if d.startswith('TCSlib'): visit(d)
    order.append(m)
visit(start)
ml = sorted({d for m in order for d in imps(m) if d.startswith('Mathlib')})
print('CLOSURE', len(order))
for m in order: print('  F', m.replace('.', '/'))
print('MATHLIB', len(ml))
for d in ml: print('  M', d)
```

## ===== campaign/fills/eq/reviews/ed-brief/tools/sorries.py =====

```
"""Topological check of an order list and a comment-stripped sorry census over it.
usage: python3 -I sorries.py <worktree> <order.txt> <overlay-file> <overlaid-path>"""
import os, re, sys
wt, orderf, overlay, opath = sys.argv[1:5]
order = [l.strip() for l in open(orderf) if l.strip()]
def text(m):
    if m == opath: return open(overlay, encoding='utf-8').read()
    return open(os.path.join(wt, m + '.lean'), encoding='utf-8').read()
def strip(s):
    # keep line structure: blank out block comments (nested-unaware but adequate here) and line comments
    out = []; i = 0; depth = 0; n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        if s.startswith('/-', i):
            depth += 1; i += 2; out.append('  '); continue
        if depth and s.startswith('-/', i):
            depth -= 1; i += 2; out.append('  '); continue
        if depth:
            out.append('\n' if s[i] == '\n' else ' '); i += 1; continue
        if s.startswith('--', i):
            j = s.find('\n', i); j = n if j < 0 else j
            out.append(' ' * (j - i)); i = j; continue
        if s[i] == '"':
            j = i + 1
            while j < n and s[j] != '"':
                j += 2 if s[j] == '\\' else 1
            out.append(' ' * (j + 1 - i)); i = j + 1; continue
        out.append(s[i]); i += 1
    return ''.join(out)
pos = {m: k for k, m in enumerate(order)}
bad = 0
for m in order:
    for mm in re.finditer(r'^\s*import\s+(TCSlib\S*)', strip(text(m)), re.M):
        d = mm.group(1).replace('.', '/')
        if d not in pos or pos[d] > pos[m]:
            bad += 1; print('ORDER VIOLATION', m, '<-', d)
print('order violations:', bad)
DECL = re.compile(r'^(?:@\[[^\]]*\]\s*)?(?:private\s+|protected\s+|noncomputable\s+)*(?:theorem|lemma|def|instance|abbrev|structure|example)\s+([^\s:({\[]+)', re.M)
TOK = re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.'])sorry(?![A-Za-z0-9_'])")
tot = 0
for m in order:
    s = strip(text(m)); lines = s.split('\n')
    decls = [(s[:mm.start()].count('\n') + 1, mm.group(1)) for mm in DECL.finditer(s)]
    names = []
    for ln, l in enumerate(lines, 1):
        for _ in TOK.finditer(l):
            owner = '?'
            for dl, dn in decls:
                if dl <= ln: owner = dn
                else: break
            names.append(owner)
    if names:
        tot += len(set(names))
        print(f"{m}: {len(set(names))}: {', '.join(sorted(set(names), key=names.index))}")
print('TOTAL sorried declarations', tot)
```

## The construction

`D = dzD κ = ⟨κ.K, _, guessRunTM (dzSet κ) (dzPexit κ) (κ.tp 6) (dzQ κ) ⟨.flag, none⟩ (dzAcc κ)
(dzRej κ)⟩` (`Turing.guessRunTM`, bundled as a `FinNDTM`), `κ : DzKit f g c BF` the kit
(`dz_kit_exists`). One guessed block of `m = g n + 1 + |bits (g n)|` cells on tape 6 (`dzBlk`):
the stream, one separator cell, the budget word. Halting by `guessRunTM_haltsWithin`, acceptance
by `guessRunTM_accepts_iff` (not the clean-setup `guessRunTM_silent_spec`). No `phaseHostND` is
composed by hand; no writer, handoff or acceptance lemma is re-proved.

### Tape plan (`DzKit.K = 14 + |qc| + |gc| + |pc| + |lc| + |ac| + kR + |BF|`)

Named tapes (`DzKit.tp i`, layouts `dzLay`): 0 the query (the query call's tape 0); 1 `bits (g n)`
(`g`'s call tape 0; consumed by the ruler's expansion); 2 `1^{n+1}` (the prepend call's tape 0);
3 the clock's counter `bits (g n)`; 4 the block's first expansion counter; 5 the separator's counter
`[true]`; 6 the block (the guess; the core's stream tape); 7 the ruler `1^{g n}`; 8 the query's tail
(the extractor call's tape 0; the decider's virtual-input buffer); 9 the budget word; 10 its
expansion `1^b`, then `bits b` (the `lengthBits` call's tape 0); 11 the core's input (capture tape of
the emissions; the core's virtual-input buffer); 12 the hosted capture tape (both simulators);
13 the decider's tape 0. Every call's other tapes, the core's tapes other than its stream, and the
decider's other tapes are in their own blocks from index 14 (`qyBank`, E-Q's same-file bank map),
never written by any other phase (`dz_bank_off`, `dzLay_off`), hence blank with heads at 0 whenever
used.

**Injections of the embedded machines.**
- Calls (`embedEmitTM` of `seamReleaseTM`, all released): query `κ.bQ` (tape 0 → 0), `g`'s witness
  `κ.bG` (→ 1), prepend `κ.bP` (→ 2), `lengthBits` `κ.bL` (→ 10), extractor `κ.bA` (→ 8).
- Expansions (`embedEmitTM (qyEmb2 dst ctr) (expandTM 1 0 [true])`): block `6 ← 4`, separator
  `6 ← 5`, ruler `7 ← 1`, budget `10 ← 9`.
- Emissions (`embedSilentTM (dzOne src) 11 (qyEmitTM 1 0 [] suf rr false)`): `src` = 10, 8, 2.
- The two clocked, hosted runs (`embedEmitTM σ H`, `σ = dzClkEmb buf cap ctr β`, `H` the step clock
  over `vhostSilentTM M`): the core `κ.sR` (buffer 11, `β = κ.bR` with the stream tape `jR ↦ 6`,
  capture 12, counter 3); the decider `κ.sB` (buffer 8, `β = κ.bB`, capture 12, counter 3).

### `P` (`dzSet`, 12 phases, `dz_setup`)

q (query input call) → g (`g`'s witness input call) → p (`[true] ++ x` input call) → c1 (copy
`bits (g n)` 1→3) → c2 (copy 1→4) → e1 (expand 4 into 6: `1^{g n}`) → w (`[true]` on 5) → e2
(expand 5 into 6: the separator) → cb (copy `bits (g n)` 1→6, appended) → rb (rewind 6) → e3
(expand 1 into 7: the ruler) → rr (rewind 7; its `done` is `pexit`). First exit at
`TP ≤ dzSetB κ G = (qcA + gcA + pcA + 40)(G + 1)`, uniform, the layout `dzSetL f g z`, every head
at 0, nothing emitted (`dz_setup_facts` gives `guessRunTM`'s block hypotheses).

### `Q` (`dzQ`, 23 phases, dispatch `dzQRed`)

1. **flag** `dzTakeTM` on tape 0: `none` → reject; `some true` → tt; `some false` → mt (`dz_flag`).
2. **tail** (mt / tt) `copyMapTM 0→8` from cell 1 (`dz_tail_run`, `copyMapTM_run_ofCfg` directly).
3. **middle preparation**: sb0 `skipBackTM 6` (0 → −1); walk `walkTM 7 {7, 6} pos` (tape 6's head
   lands on cell `G`); sep `dzTakeTM 6` (separator blanked); xfer `transferMapTM 6→9` (tape 6 is
   `bufferTape s₁`); sb1 `skipBackTM 6` (head 0) (`dz_split`); exp `expandTM` 9 into 10 (`1^b`);
   rwU; cmp `qyCmpTM 10 6`: `gt` → reject (`dz_test`); lb `lengthBits` call on 10 (`dz_norm`); al
   extractor call on 8 (`α`); e1/e2/e3 emissions onto 11 under `embedSilentTM`; rwZ rewind 11
   (`dz_rewrite`).
4. **middle run** runR: `embedEmitTM κ.sR κ.HR`; `finish (accept, _)` → accept; any other `finish`
   or `timeout` → reject (`dz_runR`).
5. **top run** runB: `embedEmitTM κ.sB κ.HB`; `finish` → rwK (rewind 12) → rd `dzTakeTM 12`:
   `some false` → accept, otherwise reject; `timeout` → reject (`dz_top_run`).
6. verdict phases acc / rej (`dzAcc`, `dzRej`, distinct: `dz_acc_ne_rej`).

`Q` is silent: both simulators are hosted silently (`vhostSilentTM`), the emissions are captured
(`embedSilentTM`), every other phase emits nothing; every segment lemma keeps the output `[]`.

**The clocked, hosted run is stated once** (`DzClockSpec`, `dz_clock_exists`), generic in the hosted
machine `M` and its stop predicate: the step clock `exists_stepClockTMVia` (identity digits) over
`vhostSilentTM M`, stopped on the hosted state's predicate, transported through `embedEmitTM` along
`dzClkEmb`. It is a composition of two registered hosts, not a new host, and a promotion
candidate. Both runs use it (`κ.cR` for the core with `stop q = (q = accept ∨ q = reject)`,
`κ.cB` for the decider with `stop = false`, i.e. its halt).

## `K`, term by term, and the per-code `C`

`K = dzK κ = (qcA + gcA + pcA + 40) + (qcA (7 acA + 8) + 2 lcA + 140) + 15`, uniform:
- `TP ≤ (qcA + gcA + pcA + 40)(G + 1)` (`dz_setup`: the three input calls' bounds
  `qcA (G + 1)`, `gcA (G + 1)`, `pcA (G + 1)`; copies `2|bits G| + 2`; expansions `2d + overhead
  ≤ 6G + 2|bits G| + 2`, `counterOverhead_le`; rewinds `G + 3`; one step per dispatch);
- `2m = 2(G + 1 + |bits G|) ≤ 4(G + 1)`;
- `T = dzQB κ G = (qcA (7 acA + 8) + 2 lcA + 140)(G + 1)` bounds every stream's run
  (`dz_qoff`: 2; `dz_qtop`: `2|tail| + 5 + 6G + 2|bits G| + 10`; `dz_qmid`: flag 2, tail
  `2|tail| + 3`, split `2G + 2|w| + 15`, test `9b + 2|w| + 12`, normalization `lcA (b + 1) + 1`,
  rewrite `acA (|tail| + 1) + 10|bits b| + 6|α| + 4n + 40`, core `5G + 2|bits G| + 3`; with
  `b ≤ 2G` (`dz_budget_le`, `qy_two_pow_bits_le`), `|tail| + 1 ≤ qcA (G + 1)` (`qcL`),
  `|α| ≤ acA (|tail| + 1)` (`acL`), `n ≤ G`);
- `+ 11 ≤ 11 (G + 1)`; so `TP + 2m + T + 11 ≤ K (G + 1)` (`dz_halts`, `dz_accepts_iff`).

Per code `α`: `C = max 1 (max C_R C_BF)`, `C_R` the core's total-time constant for `α`
(`κ.hR α`, from `exists_ndInterpreterCore`), `C_BF` `hBF`'s constant for `α`.
- Middle completeness: `C (t' + 1) ≤ g n` gives `C_R (t' + 1) ≤ g n` and, as `C ≥ 1`, `t' ≤ g n`.
- Top: `C_BF 2^{C_BF (T* + 1)} ≤ C 2^{C (T* + 1)} ≤ n ≤ g n` (`κ.hg`, from
  `timeConstructible_iff`).
The interpreter's prefix clause is not used.

## Edge cases

| Case | What happens | Lemma |
|---|---|---|
| `n ≤ 2`, non-unary input | the query is `[]`, the flag reads a blank: reject at time 2 | `dz_qoff` (`query_of_not_guard` via `query`'s cases in `dz_hQ`) |
| budget word above `g n` | `qyCmpTM`'s `gt`: reject | `dz_test` (the `else` branch), `dz_qmid` |
| `b = 0` | `1^0 = []`: the expansion writes nothing, `qyCmpTM` compares `[]`, `lengthBits` on `[]` gives `bits 0 = []` | `dz_test`, `dz_norm` (general in `b`) |
| stream shorter than an acceptance | the core rejects or the clock times out: reject | `dz_runR` (`if TR ≤ G ∧ v = accept`) |
| `BF` halts with a word other than `[false]`/`[true]` | the captured cell 0 is not `false`: reject | `dz_top_run` (`out.head? = some false` test) |
| clock `timeout` (either run) | reject | `dz_runR`, `dz_top_run` |
| `g n = 0` (only `n = 0`) | the block is the separator alone; ruler, `w_b`, counters empty; the walk moves one cell; allowance 0 | all lemmas are stated for arbitrary `G` (`dz_setup`, `dz_split` with `s₁ = []`, `dz_test`, `dz_runR`), and `dz_qoff` applies since `n = 0 ≤ 2` |
| any separator bit | `dzQRed .sep` sends every `some _` on | `dz_split` |
| every stream at a top | the same verdict (the decider reads only the tail) | `dz_qtop`, `dz_top_iff` |

## Calls and releases

Every call is run released (`seamReleaseTM` at its entry; `qy_callHost`), as E-Q's review F1
found necessary (a call's entry may equal its exit): the three input calls of `P` (query, `g`'s
witness, prepend) and the two install calls of `Q` (`lengthBits`, the extractor). The hosted
simulators are not calls; the clock stops them by its own stop predicate.

## E-Q's leaves cited (same-file privates), and where

`qyC` (every normal form), `qy_hosted` (every hosted phase), `qy_hosted_last` (`dz_setup`'s last
phase), `qy_guard_of_cut` (every guard), `qy_run_one` (`dz_take_run`), `qy_copy` (`dz_setup`),
`qy_rewind` (`dz_setup`, `dz_test`, `dz_rewrite`, `dz_top_run`), `qy_writeConst` (`dz_setup`),
`qy_expandHost` (`dz_setup`, `dz_test`), `qy_cmp_run`/`qyCmpTM`/`QyCmp` (`dz_test`, `dzQM`),
`qy_emit_run`/`qyEmitTM`/`QyEm`/`qyBody` (`dz_emit_run`, `dzQM`), `qy_writer_word` (`dz_core_word`),
`qy_callHost` (every call), `qy_embed_gen`, `qy_embed_state` (`dz_clock_exists`), `QyInSpec`,
`QySpec`, `QySpec.mono`, `qy_inputSpec`, `qy_installSpec` (`DzKit`, `dz_kit_exists`), `qy_arg_bank`

`qyBank_val`, `qyEmb2`. No E-Q leaf is copied: no second comparison, emitter, word lemma, call,
clock-of-a-call, expansion or rewind wrapper.

## The own leaf `dzTakeTM`

States `Option (Option Bool)` (`none` reading, `some o` holding the read symbol; existing types,
so no new inductive). From `none` it reads the cell under tape `i`'s head, writes a blank there
(`(some none, .pos)`), moves right, enters `some (w i)`. Its docstring names the missing row: "no
public row writes a blank at one cell (`Turing.writeConstTM` writes symbols, `Turing.clearTM` and
`Turing.transferMapTM` blank a whole delimited word)". Its step lemma `dz_take_run` is its own
(`qy_step` covers only steps that write nothing), proved by `MultiTapeTM.step_of_some` and the
`Action.apply_*` equations (`Action.apply_workTapes`), never by `show`/`change`/`rfl` on `step` or
`Action.apply`. It is used three times: the flag (tape 0), the separator (tape 6), the captured
bit (tape 12).

## Proposed `**Implementation.**` paragraph (for the maintainer to land in the target's docstring)

> **Implementation.** `D` is `Turing.guessRunTM` over a deterministic setup and a deterministic
> run. The setup calls the stage query, `g`'s witness and `x ↦ true :: x` on the native input
> (released input calls), and writes the block `1^{g n} ++ [true] ++ bits (g n)` (two expansions and
> a copy), the ruler `1^{g n}` and the clock's counter `bits (g n)`. The guess overwrites the block
> with a stream, a separator and a budget word. The run is a phase host: a one-cell take reads the
> query's flag; in the middle it splits the block (a skip back, the lockstep walk over the ruler, a
> take of the separator, a move of the budget word), tests the budget `b ≤ g n` (its expansion and
> the length comparison with the stream), normalizes it to `bits b` (an install call), extracts `α`
> from the query's tail (the install call of the composite pair extractor), writes the core's input
> `⟨⟨bits b, α⟩, 1^{n + 1}⟩` by three emissions under the capture wrapper, and runs the interpreter
> core under the step clock over the virtual-input host, accepting at its `accept` within the
> allowance `g n`; at a top it runs the decider of `hBF` on the query's tail under the same clocked
> host and accepts iff its captured output starts with `false`. All-branch halting is
> `Turing.guessRunTM_haltsWithin` and acceptance `Turing.guessRunTM_accepts_iff`; `K` is uniform and,
> per code, `C = max 1 (max C_R C_BF)`.

# Semantic search per new private (E-D fill)

**By name.** None of the 106 names below, nor any identifier starting with `dz`/`Dz`, occurs in any
`.lean` file of the base tree or of the 182 pull-request heads visible on the remote
(`refs/pull/*/head`, open and closed; the REST API is not available to this session, so all were
searched), and in the current tree only the owned file has them (pr-and-base-hits.txt: empty).

**By statement.** `evidence/probes/DzExactProbe.lean` restates every new lemma whose statement
involves only public definitions and runs `exact?` (evidence/logs/exact-probe.out). It found one
re-derivation, a former `dz_pairEncode_length` = the published `Turing.length_pairEncode`: it was
removed and the published lemma is cited. Every other new lemma states a run of this file's own
machines (`dzQ`, `dzSet`, `dzTakeTM`, …) over its own layout (`qyC`, `dzLay`, `DzKit`), so no library
statement can match it; the text screens cover copying.

@NTimeDiag.exists_diagonalizer : ∀ {f g : ℕ → ℕ},
  TimeConstructible f →
    TimeConstructible g →
      ∀ (c : EffectiveNDMachineCode),
        (∃ BF,
            ∀ (α : List Bool),
              ∃ C,
                ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
                  ((c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin x t →
                      BF.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode t.bits α) x) [true] (C * 2 ^ (C * (t + 1)))) ∧
                    (¬(c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin x t →
                      BF.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode t.bits α) x) [false] (C * 2 ^ (C * (t + 1))))) →
          ∃ D K,
            (∀ (x : List Bool), D.tm.HaltsWithin x (K * (g x.length + 1))) ∧
              ∀ (α : List Bool),
                ∃ C,
                  ∀ (n : ℕ),
                    3 ≤ n →
                      NTimeDiag.stageCode (NTimeDiag.stage f n) = α →
                        (n ≠ NTimeDiag.ladder f (NTimeDiag.stage f n + 1) →
                            (D.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate n true) (K * (g n + 1)) →
                                (c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate (n + 1) true) (g n)) ∧
                              ∀ (t' : ℕ),
                                (c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate (n + 1) true) t' →
                                  C * (t' + 1) ≤ g n → D.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate n true) (K * (g n + 1))) ∧
                          (n = NTimeDiag.ladder f (NTimeDiag.stage f n + 1) →
                            C * 2 ^ (C * (NTimeDiag.budget f (NTimeDiag.ladder f (NTimeDiag.stage f n)) + 1)) ≤ n →
                              (D.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate n true) (K * (g n + 1)) ↔
                                ¬(c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin
                                    (List.replicate (NTimeDiag.ladder f (NTimeDiag.stage f n) + 1) true)
                                    (NTimeDiag.budget f (NTimeDiag.ladder f (NTimeDiag.stage f n)))))
@NTimeDiag.exists_queryTM : ∀ {f g : ℕ → ℕ},
  TimeConstructible f → TimeConstructible g → ∃ G C, G.ComputesFunInTime (NTimeDiag.query f g) fun n => C * (g n + 1)
NTimeDiag.query : (ℕ → ℕ) → (ℕ → ℕ) → List Bool → List Bool
NTimeDiag.query_eq : ∀ (f g : ℕ → ℕ) {n : ℕ},
  3 ≤ n →
    NTimeDiag.query f g (List.replicate n true) =
      if n = NTimeDiag.ladder f (NTimeDiag.stage f n + 1) then
        true ::
          pairEncode
            (pairEncode (NTimeDiag.budget f (NTimeDiag.ladder f (NTimeDiag.stage f n))).bits
              (NTimeDiag.stageCode (NTimeDiag.stage f n)))
            (List.replicate (NTimeDiag.ladder f (NTimeDiag.stage f n) + 1) true)
      else
        false ::
          pairEncode (pairEncode (g n).bits (NTimeDiag.stageCode (NTimeDiag.stage f n))) (List.replicate (n + 1) true)
NTimeDiag.query_of_not_guard : ∀ (f g : ℕ → ℕ) {x : List Bool},
  ¬(x = List.replicate x.length true ∧ 3 ≤ x.length) → NTimeDiag.query f g x = []
NTimeDiag.budget_eq : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (ℓ : ℕ), NTimeDiag.budget f ℓ = (f (ℓ + 1) + (ℓ + 1) + 1) ^ 2
NTimeDiag.ladder_zero : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ), NTimeDiag.ladder f 0 = 2
NTimeDiag.ladder_succ : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ),
  NTimeDiag.ladder f (i + 1) = 2 ^ NTimeDiag.budget f (NTimeDiag.ladder f i) ^ 2
NTimeDiag.two_mul_lt_ladder_succ : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ), 2 * NTimeDiag.ladder f i < NTimeDiag.ladder f (i + 1)
NTimeDiag.le_ladder : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ), i + 2 ≤ NTimeDiag.ladder f i
NTimeDiag.ladder_strictMono : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono (NTimeDiag.ladder f)
NTimeDiag.stage_spec : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) {n : ℕ},
  3 ≤ n → NTimeDiag.ladder f (NTimeDiag.stage f n) < n ∧ n ≤ NTimeDiag.ladder f (NTimeDiag.stage f n + 1)
NTimeDiag.stage_eq : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) {n i : ℕ},
  NTimeDiag.ladder f i < n → n ≤ NTimeDiag.ladder f (i + 1) → NTimeDiag.stage f n = i
NTimeDiag.stage_of_le_two : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) {n : ℕ}, n ≤ 2 → NTimeDiag.stage f n = 0
NTimeDiag.stageCode_eq : ∀ (i : ℕ), NTimeDiag.stageCode i = ((Nat.unpair i).1 + 1).bits.dropLast
@guessRunTM : {k : ℕ} →
  {SP SQ : Type} →
    [DecidableEq SP] →
      [DecidableEq SQ] →
        MultiTapeTM k Bool SP →
          SP →
            Fin k →
              MultiTapeTM k Bool SQ → SQ → SQ → SQ → NDTM k Bool ((i : GuessRunPhase) × GuessRunPhase.State SP SQ i)
@guessRunCfg : {k : ℕ} → {S S' : Type} → {z : List Bool} → Cfg k Bool S z → Fin k → List Bool → S' → Cfg k Bool S' z
@guessRunCfg_state : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {z : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool S z) (j : Fin k) (s : List Bool) (q : S'),
  (guessRunCfg c j s q).state = some q
@guessRunCfg_inputPos : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {z : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool S z) (j : Fin k) (s : List Bool)
  (q : S'), (guessRunCfg c j s q).inputPos = c.inputPos
@guessRunCfg_workTapes : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {z : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool S z) (j : Fin k) (s : List Bool)
  (q : S') (a : Fin k) (a_1 : ℤ),
  (guessRunCfg c j s q).workTapes a a_1 =
    Function.update c.workTapes j
      (fun p =>
        if c.workTapePos j ≤ p ∧ p < c.workTapePos j + ↑s.length then bufferTape s (p - c.workTapePos j)
        else c.workTapes j p)
      a a_1
@guessRunCfg_workTapePos : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {z : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool S z) (j : Fin k) (s : List Bool)
  (q : S') (a : Fin k), (guessRunCfg c j s q).workTapePos a = c.workTapePos a
@guessRunCfg_output : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {z : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool S z) (j : Fin k) (s : List Bool) (q : S'),
  (guessRunCfg c j s q).output = c.output
@guessRunTM_haltsWithin : ∀ {k : ℕ} {SP SQ : Type} [inst : DecidableEq SP] [inst_1 : DecidableEq SQ]
  (P : MultiTapeTM k Bool SP) (pexit : SP) (j : Fin k) (Q : MultiTapeTM k Bool SQ) (qentry acc rej : SQ) {z : List Bool}
  (TP : ℕ) (cP : Cfg k Bool SP z),
  runFrom (initCfg z) TP = cP →
    cP.state = some pexit →
      (∀ u < TP, (runFrom (initCfg z) u).state ≠ some pexit) →
        ∀ (m : ℕ),

  (P : MultiTapeTM k Bool SP) (pexit : SP) (j : Fin k) (Q : MultiTapeTM k Bool SQ) (qentry acc rej : SQ) {z : List Bool}
  (TP : ℕ) (cP : Cfg k Bool SP z),

                ∀ (T : ℕ),

                            ∀ u < TQ,
                              (runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) u).state ≠ some acc ∧
                                (runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) u).state ≠ some rej) →
                    ∀ (B : ℕ),
                      TP + 2 * m + T + 11 ≤ B →
                        ((∃ w,
                            w.length = B ∧
                              (NDTM.runWith w (NDTM.initCfg z)).state = none ∧
                                (NDTM.runWith w (NDTM.initCfg z)).output = [true]) ↔
                          ∃ s,
                            s.length = m ∧

                                (runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) TQ).state = some acc ∧
                                  (∀ u < TQ,
                                      (runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) u).state ≠ some acc ∧
                                        (runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) u).state ≠ some rej) ∧

  (ι : Fin K ↪ Fin k),

exists_ndInterpreterCore : ∀ (c : EffectiveNDMachineCode),
  ∃ K Q x x R j entry accept reject,
    accept ≠ reject ∧
      ∀ (α : List Bool),
        ∃ C,
          ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (s : List Bool),
            t ≤ s.length →
              have z := pairEncode (pairEncode t.bits α) x;
              have N := (c.decode α).toFinNDTM;
              have start :=
                { state := some entry, inputPos := 1,
                  workTapes := fun i => if i = j then bufferTape s else fun x => none, workTapePos := fun x => 0,
                  output := [] };
              have e := NDTM.runWith (List.take t s) (NDTM.initCfg x);

                      T ≤ C * (t' + x.length + t.bits.length + 1)) ∧
                  T ≤ C * (t + 1) ∧
                    (runFrom start T).state = some (if e.state = none ∧ e.output = [true] then accept else reject) ∧
                      ∀ u < T, (runFrom start u).state ≠ some accept ∧ (runFrom start u).state ≠ some reject
@exists_stepClockTMVia : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] [DecidableEq Γ] (e : Bool ↪ Γ)
  (M : MultiTapeTM k Γ S) (stopAt : S → Bool),

                    (∀ τ ≤ Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w),

                              ∃ w',
                                w'.length = w.length ∧
                                  runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) T =
                                      clockCfg (some (finish (runFrom c τ).state)) (runFrom c τ)
                                        (wordPatch ct cp (List.map (⇑e) w')) cp ∧
                                    (∀ u < T,
                                        ∀ (r : Option S),
                                          (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).state ≠ some (finish r) ∧
                                            (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).state ≠ some (timeout r)) ∧
                                      ∀ u ≤ T,
                                        ∃ v ≤ τ,
                                          (∀ (j : Fin k),
                                              (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).workTapes j.castSucc =
                                                  (runFrom c v).workTapes j ∧
                                                (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).workTapePos j.castSucc =
                                                  (runFrom c v).workTapePos j) ∧
                                            (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).inputPos =
                                                (runFrom c v).inputPos ∧
                                              (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).output =
                                                  (runFrom c v).output ∧
                                                (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).workTapePos (Fin.last k) ∈
                                                  Finset.Icc (cp - 1) (cp + ↑w.length)) ∧
                      ((∀ u ≤ Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w), ¬Cfg.Stopped stopAt (runFrom c u)) →
                        ∃ T ≤ 5 * Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w) + 2 * w.length + 2,
                          ∃ w',
                            w'.length = w.length ∧
                              runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) T =
                                  clockCfg (some (timeout (runFrom c (Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w))).state))
                                    (runFrom c (Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w)))
                                    (wordPatch ct cp (List.map (⇑e) w')) cp ∧
                                (∀ u < T,
                                    ∀ (r : Option S),
                                      (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).state ≠ some (finish r) ∧
                                        (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).state ≠ some (timeout r)) ∧
                                  ∀ u ≤ T,
                                    ∃ v ≤ Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w),
                                      (∀ (j : Fin k),
                                          (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).workTapes j.castSucc =
                                              (runFrom c v).workTapes j ∧
                                            (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).workTapePos j.castSucc =
                                              (runFrom c v).workTapePos j) ∧
                                        (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).inputPos =
                                            (runFrom c v).inputPos ∧
                                          (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).output = (runFrom c v).output ∧
                                            (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).workTapePos (Fin.last k) ∈
                                              Finset.Icc (cp - 1) (cp + ↑w.length))
@exists_stepClockTM : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (stopAt : S → Bool),
  ∃ Q x x H inj finish timeout,
    ∀ {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (q : S),
      c.state = some q →
        ∀ (w : List Bool) (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ),
          (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → ct (cp + p) = bufferTape w p) →
            have d := Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w);
            have stopped := fun e => e.state = none ∨ ∃ s, e.state = some s ∧ stopAt s = true;
            (∀ τ ≤ d,
                stopped (runFrom c τ) →
                  (∀ u < τ, ¬stopped (runFrom c u)) →
                    ∃ T ≤ 5 * τ + 2 * w.length + 2,
                      ∃ ct',
                        runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) T =
                            clockCfg (some (finish (runFrom c τ).state)) (runFrom c τ) ct' cp ∧
                          ∀ u < T,
                            ∀ (r : Option S),
                              (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).state ≠ some (finish r) ∧
                                (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).state ≠ some (timeout r)) ∧
              ((∀ u ≤ d, ¬stopped (runFrom c u)) →
                ∃ T ≤ 5 * d + 2 * w.length + 2,
                  ∃ ct',
                    runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) T =
                        clockCfg (some (timeout (runFrom c d).state)) (runFrom c d) ct' cp ∧
                      ∀ u < T,
                        ∀ (r : Option S),
                          (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).state ≠ some (finish r) ∧
                            (runFrom (clockCfg (some (inj q)) c ct cp) u).state ≠ some (timeout r))

@expandTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (pat : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (pat.length + 1)) x),

    ∀ (w : List Bool) (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ),

        ∀ (d : ℕ),

            runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp)
                  (d * (pat.length + 1) + counterOverhead w (d + 1)) =
                counterLoopCfg (some CounterLoopState.done)
                  { state := c.state, inputPos := c.inputPos,
                    workTapes := fun j q =>
                      if j = i ∧ c.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < c.workTapePos j + ↑(d * pat.length) then
                        bufferTape (List.replicate d pat).flatten (q - c.workTapePos j)
                      else c.workTapes j q,

                    output := c.output }
                  (fun q => if cp ≤ q ∧ q < cp + ↑w.length then some true else ct q) cp ∧

                  (runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp) t).state ≠
                      some CounterLoopState.done ∧

                            j.castSucc ∈
                          Finset.Icc (c.workTapePos j) (c.workTapePos j + ↑(d * pat.length))
                      else
                        (runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp) t).workTapePos
                            j.castSucc =

@copyMapTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {Δ : Type u_2} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k),
  src ≠ dst →
    ∀ (extract : Symbol → Δ) (merge : Option Symbol → Δ → Symbol) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x),
      d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep →
        (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = bufferTape w p) →
          runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
              { state := some SweepPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos,
                workTapes := fun j q =>
                  if j = dst ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then
                    Option.map (fun γ => merge (d.workTapes j q) (extract γ)) (bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j))
                  else d.workTapes j q,
                workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
            (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, (runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧
              ∀ (j : Fin k),
                ∀ t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2,
                  if j = src ∨ j = dst then
                    (runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length)
                  else (runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@transferMapTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {Δ : Type u_2} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k),
  src ≠ dst →
    ∀ (extract : Symbol → Δ) (merge : Option Symbol → Δ → Symbol) (rest : Symbol → Option Symbol) (w : List Symbol)
      (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x),
      d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep →
        (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = bufferTape w p) →
          runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
              { state := some SweepPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos,
                workTapes := fun j q =>
                  if j = src ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then
                    (bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)).bind rest
                  else
                    if j = dst ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then
                      Option.map (fun γ => merge (d.workTapes j q) (extract γ)) (bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j))
                    else d.workTapes j q,
                workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
            (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, (runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧
              ∀ (j : Fin k),
                ∀ t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2,
                  if j = src ∨ j = dst then
                    (runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length)
                  else (runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@clearTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol)
  (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x),
  d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep →

            workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
        (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, (runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin k),
            ∀ t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2,
              if j = i then (runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length)
              else (runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@skipBackTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (u : List Symbol)
  (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x),

@rewindTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (u : List Symbol),

            (∀ t < n + 2, (runFrom d t).state ≠ some RewindPhase.done) ∧

 contract

The overlay's three imports; in region (b): the one-cell take dzTakeTM and its
step, the silent-capture normal form, the generic clocked hosted run
(dz_clock_exists), the kit and tape layout, and the setup dz_setup with its
uniform bound. The target stays sorried.

index 852931eb..f01fb051 100644
--- a/TCSlib/Complexity/Diagonalization/NTimeDiagonalizer.lean
+++ b/TCSlib/Complexity/Diagonalization/NTimeDiagonalizer.lean
@@ -15,6 +15,9 @@ import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Primitives
 import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Rewind
 import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.BufferWords
 import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.WordTests
