+/-! ### The run's three cases -/
+
+/-- A word's binary value is below `2 ^ |w|`. -/
+private theorem dz_word_lt (w : List Bool) : Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) < 2 ^ w.length := by
+  have h := Nat.ofDigits_lt_base_pow_length (b := 2) (l := w.map Bool.toNat) (by norm_num)
+    (by
+      intro d hd
+      obtain ⟨a, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hd
+      cases a <;> decide)
+  rwa [List.length_map] at h
+
+/-- A budget word as wide as `bits G` is worth at most `2G` (`qy_two_pow_bits_le`). -/
+private theorem dz_budget_le (G : ℕ) (w : List Bool) (hw : w.length = (Nat.bits G).length) :
+    Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) ≤ 2 * G := by
+  have h1 := dz_word_lt w
+  have h2 := qy_two_pow_bits_le G
+  rw [hw] at h1
+  omega
+
+/-- The zero-padded bits of `t` are worth `t`. -/
+private theorem dz_padded_value (t r : ℕ) :
+    Nat.ofDigits 2 ((Nat.bits t ++ List.replicate r false).map Bool.toNat) = t := by
+  have h0 : ∀ r : ℕ, Nat.ofDigits 2 ((List.replicate r false).map Bool.toNat) = 0 := by
+    intro r
+    induction r with
+    | zero => rfl
+    | succ r ih =>
+      rw [List.replicate_succ, List.map_cons, Nat.ofDigits_cons, ih]
+      rfl
+  rw [List.map_append, Nat.ofDigits_append, h0, mul_zero, add_zero, qy_bits_val]
+
+/-- The run's time bound for `g n = G`. -/
+private def dzQB {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
+    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (G : ℕ) : ℕ :=
+  (κ.qcA * (7 * κ.acA + 8) + 2 * κ.lcA + 140) * (G + 1)
+
+/-- The run's entry layout's named tapes, as the setup leaves them with the block overwritten. -/
+private theorem dz_entry_vals (f g : ℕ → ℕ) (z s : List Bool) :
+    let L := Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6 (FinTM.bufferTape s)
+    L 0 = FinTM.bufferTape (query f g z) ∧ L 2 = FinTM.bufferTape ([true] ++ z) ∧
+      L 3 = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits (g z.length)) ∧ L 6 = FinTM.bufferTape s ∧
+      L 7 = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate (g z.length) true) ∧ L 8 = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧
+      L 9 = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ L 10 = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ L 11 = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧
+      L 12 = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ L 13 = FinTM.bufferTape [] := by
+  intro L
+  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [L, dzSetL]
+
+/-- **The run off the stages.** When the query is empty, the run rejects at its flag. -/
+private theorem dz_qoff {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
+    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (z s : List Bool) (hq : query f g z = []) :
+    ∃ t ≤ dzQB κ (g z.length), ∃ (T' : Fin κ.K → ℤ → Option Bool) (P' : Fin κ.K → ℤ),
+      Segment (dzQ κ) (dzQF κ) (fun _ => True)
+        (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
+          (FinTM.bufferTape s)) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) [])
+        (qyC (dzRej κ) 1 T' P' []) t := by
+  obtain ⟨h0, -⟩ := dz_entry_vals f g z s
+  rw [dzLay_const (0 : ℤ)]
+  refine ⟨2, ?_, _, _, dz_flag κ _ (fun _ => 0) (query f g z) h0 rfl (dzRej κ) ?_⟩
+  · unfold dzQB
+    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (g z.length + 1)
+      (show 140 ≤ κ.qcA * (7 * κ.acA + 8) + 2 * κ.lcA + 140 by omega)
+    omega
+  · rw [hq, FinTM.bufferTape_nil]
+    rfl
+
+/-- The query's first cell after its flag. -/
+private theorem dz_cell0 (b : Bool) (tail : List Bool) :
+    FinTM.bufferTape (b :: tail) 0 = some b := by
+  rw [FinTM.bufferTape_eq, if_pos le_rfl]
+  rfl
+
+/-- **The run at a top.** When the query is `true :: tail`, the run copies the tail and runs the
+hosted decider on it (`dz_top_run`): it reaches a verdict within `dzQB κ (g n)` steps, the
+acceptance exactly when the decider, halted by some `τ ≤ g n`, has an output starting with `false`.
+
+**Proof sketch.** The flag (`dz_flag`, the first cell `true`), the tail's copy (`dz_tail_run`,
+hosted), and `dz_top_run` over the entry layout's tapes (`dz_entry_vals`). The tail is shorter than
+the query, whose length is at most `qcA (g n + 1)` (the kit's `qcL`). -/
+private theorem dz_qtop {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
+    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (z tail s : List Bool) (hq : query f g z = true :: tail) :
+    ∃ t ≤ dzQB κ (g z.length), ∃ (v : Σ i, DzQPh κ i) (T' : Fin κ.K → ℤ → Option Bool)
+      (P' : Fin κ.K → ℤ), (v = dzAcc κ ∨ v = dzRej κ) ∧
+      Segment (dzQ κ) (dzQF κ) (fun _ => True)
+        (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
+          (FinTM.bufferTape s)) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) [])
+        (qyC v 1 T' P' []) t ∧
+      ∀ τ ≤ g z.length, (BF.tm.runFrom (BF.tm.initCfg tail) τ).state = none →
+        (v = dzAcc κ ↔ (BF.tm.runFrom (BF.tm.initCfg tail) τ).output.head? = some false) := by
+  obtain ⟨h0, -, h3, -, -, h8, -, -, -, h12, h13⟩ := dz_entry_vals f g z s
+  rw [dzLay_const (0 : ℤ)]
+  set L0 := Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6 (FinTM.bufferTape s) with hL0
+  -- the flag
+  have seg1 := dz_flag κ (z := z) L0 (fun _ => 0) (query f g z) h0 rfl ⟨.tt, SweepPhase.sweep⟩
+    (by rw [hq, dz_cell0]; rfl)
+  -- the tail's copy
+  obtain ⟨L1, hL1⟩ : ∃ L1 : Fin 14 → ℤ → Option Bool,
+      L1 = Function.update L0 0 (Function.update (FinTM.bufferTape (query f g z)) 0 none) :=
+    ⟨_, rfl⟩
+  obtain ⟨Z1, hZ1⟩ : ∃ Z1 : Fin 14 → ℤ, Z1 = Function.update (fun _ => 0) 0 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
+  rw [← hL1, ← hZ1] at seg1
+  have c2 := dz_tail_run (x := z) (κ.tp 0) (κ.tp 8) (κ.tp_ne (by decide)) 1
+    (dzLay L1 (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (dzLay Z1 0) [] true tail
+    (by rw [dzLay_tp, hL1, Function.update_self, hq])
+    (by rw [dzLay_tp, hZ1, Function.update_self])
+    (by rw [dzLay_tp, hL1, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), h8])
+    (by rw [dzLay_tp, hZ1, Function.update_of_ne (by decide)])
+  rw [dzLay_update] at c2
+  have seg2 := qy_hosted (dzQM κ) ⟨.flag, none⟩ (dzQRed κ) .tt .sweep .done
+    ⟨.runB, κ.iB (BF.tm.q₀, true)⟩ 1 1 _ _ _ _ [] [] _ c2.1 (by simp [dzQRed])
+    (qy_guard_of_cut SweepPhase.done (dzQRed κ .tt) (fun s hs => by simp [dzQRed, hs]) c2.2)
+    (dzQF κ) (fun s => dz_notF κ .tt s (by simp) (by simp))
+  -- the hosted decider and its read
+  have hZ : ∀ i : Fin 14, i ≠ 0 → Z1 i = 0 := fun i hi => by rw [hZ1, Function.update_of_ne hi]
+  obtain ⟨t3, ht3, v, T', P', hv, seg3, hsem⟩ := dz_top_run κ (z := z)
+    (Function.update L1 8 (FinTM.bufferTape tail)) Z1 tail (g z.length)
+    (by rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide), hL1, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), h3])
+    (by rw [Function.update_self])
+    (by rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide), hL1, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), h12])
+    (by rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide), hL1, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), h13])
+    (hZ 3 (by decide)) (hZ 8 (by decide)) (hZ 12 (by decide)) (hZ 13 (by decide))
+  refine ⟨_, ?_, v, T', P', hv, seg1.trans (seg2.trans seg3), hsem⟩
+  have hqL := κ.qcL z
+  rw [hq, List.length_cons] at hqL
+  have hb := length_bits_le_self (g z.length)
+  have hA : κ.qcA * (g z.length + 1) ≤ κ.qcA * (7 * κ.acA + 8) * (g z.length + 1) := by
+    rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm (7 * κ.acA + 8), ← mul_assoc]
+    exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
+  unfold dzQB
+  nlinarith
+
+/-- **The run in a middle.** When the query is `false :: tail`, `α = dzAlpha tail`, and the guessed
+block is the stream `s₁` (of length `g n`), a separator and the budget word `w` (value `b`), the run
+reaches a verdict within `dzQB κ (g n)` steps; it accepts only if `b ≤ g n` and the coded machine of
+`α` accepts `1ⁿ` prefixed by `true` along `s₁.take b`, and it does accept when moreover the core's
+constant `C` (its total-time clause for `α`, `hC`) has `C (b + 1) ≤ g n`.
+
+**Proof sketch.** The flag (`dz_flag`), the tail's copy (`dz_tail_run`), the split (`dz_split`) and
+the test (`dz_test`), which rejects when `g n < b`. Otherwise the normalization (`dz_norm`), the
+rewrite (`dz_rewrite`, `α` by the extractor) and the hosted core (`dz_runR`) at the core's first
+verdict time `T ≤ C (b + 1)` (`hC` with `t = b ≤ |s₁|`): the run accepts iff `T ≤ g n` and the
+verdict is `accept`, i.e. the branch along `s₁.take b` halts with `[true]`. The times sum to at
+most the bound: `b ≤ 2 g n` (`dz_budget_le`), `|bits b| ≤ b`, `|α| ≤ acA (|tail| + 1)` (the kit's
+`acL`), `|tail| < |query| ≤ qcA (g n + 1)` and `n ≤ g n`. -/
+private theorem dz_qmid {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
+    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (z tail : List Bool) (hq : query f g z = false :: tail) (C : ℕ)
+    (hC : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (s : List Bool), t ≤ s.length →
+      ∃ T, T ≤ C * (t + 1) ∧
+        (κ.R.runFrom (streamStartCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) (dzAlpha tail)) x) κ.jR
+            κ.rE s) T).state =
+          some (if ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith (s.take t)
+                ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg x)).state = none ∧
+              ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith (s.take t)
+                ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg x)).output = [true]
+            then κ.rA else κ.rJ) ∧
+        ∀ u < T,
+          (κ.R.runFrom (streamStartCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) (dzAlpha tail)) x)
+              κ.jR κ.rE s) u).state ≠ some κ.rA ∧
+            (κ.R.runFrom (streamStartCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) (dzAlpha tail)) x)
+              κ.jR κ.rE s) u).state ≠ some κ.rJ)
+    (s₁ w : List Bool) (sp : Bool) (hs₁ : s₁.length = g z.length)
+    (hw : w.length = (Nat.bits (g z.length)).length) :
+    ∃ t ≤ dzQB κ (g z.length), ∃ (v : Σ i, DzQPh κ i) (T' : Fin κ.K → ℤ → Option Bool)
+      (P' : Fin κ.K → ℤ), (v = dzAcc κ ∨ v = dzRej κ) ∧
+      Segment (dzQ κ) (dzQF κ) (fun _ => True)
+        (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
+          (FinTM.bufferTape (s₁ ++ [sp] ++ w))) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) [])
+        (qyC v 1 T' P' []) t ∧
+      (v = dzAcc κ → Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) ≤ g z.length ∧
+        ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith
+          (s₁.take (Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat)))
+          ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg ([true] ++ z))).state = none ∧
+        ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith
+          (s₁.take (Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat)))
+          ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg ([true] ++ z))).output = [true]) ∧
+      (Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) ≤ g z.length →
+        C * (Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) + 1) ≤ g z.length →
+        ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith
+          (s₁.take (Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat)))
+          ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg ([true] ++ z))).state = none →
+        ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith
+          (s₁.take (Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat)))
+          ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg ([true] ++ z))).output = [true] →
+        v = dzAcc κ) := by
+  obtain ⟨h0, h2, h3, h6, h7, h8, h9, h10, h11, h12, -⟩ := dz_entry_vals f g z (s₁ ++ [sp] ++ w)
+  rw [dzLay_const (0 : ℤ)]
+  set G := g z.length with hG
+  set b := Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) with hb
+  set L0 := Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6 (FinTM.bufferTape (s₁ ++ [sp] ++ w)) with hL0
+  -- the flag
+  have seg1 := dz_flag κ (z := z) L0 (fun _ => 0) (query f g z) h0 rfl ⟨.mt, SweepPhase.sweep⟩
+    (by rw [hq, dz_cell0]; rfl)
+  obtain ⟨L1, hL1⟩ : ∃ L1 : Fin 14 → ℤ → Option Bool,
+      L1 = Function.update L0 0 (Function.update (FinTM.bufferTape (query f g z)) 0 none) :=
+    ⟨_, rfl⟩
+  obtain ⟨Z1, hZ1⟩ : ∃ Z1 : Fin 14 → ℤ, Z1 = Function.update (fun _ => 0) 0 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
+  rw [← hL1, ← hZ1] at seg1
+  have hZ1' : ∀ i : Fin 14, i ≠ 0 → Z1 i = 0 := fun i hi => by rw [hZ1, Function.update_of_ne hi]
+  -- the tail's copy
+  have c2 := dz_tail_run (x := z) (κ.tp 0) (κ.tp 8) (κ.tp_ne (by decide)) 1
+    (dzLay L1 (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (dzLay Z1 0) [] false tail
+    (by rw [dzLay_tp, hL1, Function.update_self, hq])
+    (by rw [dzLay_tp, hZ1, Function.update_self])
+    (by rw [dzLay_tp, hL1, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), h8])
+    (by rw [dzLay_tp, hZ1' 8 (by decide)])
+  rw [dzLay_update] at c2
+  have seg2 := qy_hosted (dzQM κ) ⟨.flag, none⟩ (dzQRed κ) .mt .sweep .done ⟨.sb0, SeekPhase.run⟩
+    1 1 _ _ _ _ [] [] _ c2.1 (by simp [dzQRed])
+    (qy_guard_of_cut SweepPhase.done (dzQRed κ .mt) (fun s hs => by simp [dzQRed, hs]) c2.2)
+    (dzQF κ) (fun s => dz_notF κ .mt s (by simp) (by simp))
+  obtain ⟨L2, hL2⟩ : ∃ L2 : Fin 14 → ℤ → Option Bool,
+      L2 = Function.update L1 8 (FinTM.bufferTape tail) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
+  rw [← hL2] at seg2
+  -- the split
+  obtain ⟨t3, ht3, seg3⟩ := dz_split κ (z := z) L2 Z1 s₁ w sp
+    (by simp [hL2, hL1, h6]) (by simp [hL2, hL1, h7, hs₁]) (by simp [hL2, hL1, h9])
+    (hZ1' 6 (by decide)) (hZ1' 7 (by decide)) (hZ1' 9 (by decide))
+  obtain ⟨L3, hL3⟩ : ∃ L3 : Fin 14 → ℤ → Option Bool, L3 = Function.update
+      (Function.update L2 6 (FinTM.bufferTape s₁)) 9 (FinTM.bufferTape w) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
+  obtain ⟨Z3, hZ3⟩ : ∃ Z3 : Fin 14 → ℤ, Z3 = Function.update Z1 7 ((s₁.length : ℤ) + 1) :=
+    ⟨_, rfl⟩
+  rw [← hL3, ← hZ3] at seg3
+  have hZ3' : ∀ i : Fin 14, i ≠ 0 → i ≠ 7 → Z3 i = 0 := fun i hi h7 => by
+    rw [hZ3, Function.update_of_ne h7, hZ1' i hi]
+  -- the test
+  obtain ⟨t4, ht4, seg4⟩ := dz_test κ (z := z) L3 Z3 s₁ w (by simp [hL3])
+    (by simp [hL3]) (by simp [hL3, hL2, hL1, h10]) (hZ3' 6 (by decide) (by decide))
+    (hZ3' 9 (by decide) (by decide)) (hZ3' 10 (by decide) (by decide))
+  rw [← hb] at seg4
+  obtain ⟨L4, hL4⟩ : ∃ L4 : Fin 14 → ℤ → Option Bool, L4 = Function.update (Function.update L3 10
+      (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate b true))) 9
+      (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate w.length true)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
+  rw [← hL4] at seg4
+  -- the bounds common to both branches
+  have hqL := κ.qcL z
+  rw [hq, List.length_cons] at hqL
+  have hbG := length_bits_le_self G
+  have hb2 : b ≤ 2 * G := dz_budget_le G w hw
+  have hA : κ.qcA * (G + 1) ≤ κ.qcA * (7 * κ.acA + 8) * (G + 1) := by
+    rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm (7 * κ.acA + 8), ← mul_assoc]
+    exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
+  by_cases hbG' : b ≤ G
+  · rw [if_pos (by omega)] at seg4
+    -- the normalization
+    obtain ⟨t5, ht5, seg5⟩ := dz_norm κ (z := z) L4 Z3 b (by simp [hL4])
+      (hZ3' 10 (by decide) (by decide))
+    -- the rewrite
+    obtain ⟨t6, ht6, seg6⟩ := dz_rewrite κ (z := z) (Function.update L4 10
+      (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits b))) Z3 tail (Nat.bits b)
+      (by simp [hL4, hL3, hL2, hL1, h2]) (by simp [hL4, hL3, hL2])
+      (by simp) (by simp [hL4, hL3, hL2, hL1, h11]) (hZ3' 2 (by decide) (by decide))
+      (hZ3' 8 (by decide) (by decide)) (hZ3' 10 (by decide) (by decide))
+      (hZ3' 11 (by decide) (by decide))
+    -- the hosted core
+    obtain ⟨T, hT, hst, hcut⟩ := hC ([true] ++ z) b s₁ (by omega)
+    obtain ⟨L6, hL6⟩ : ∃ L6 : Fin 14 → ℤ → Option Bool, L6 = Function.update (Function.update
+        (Function.update L4 10 (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits b))) 8
+        (FinTM.bufferTape (dzAlpha tail))) 11
+        (FinTM.bufferTape (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits b) (dzAlpha tail)) ([true] ++ z))) :=
+      ⟨_, rfl⟩
+    obtain ⟨Z6, hZ6⟩ : ∃ Z6 : Fin 14 → ℤ, Z6 = Function.update (Function.update (Function.update
+        Z3 10 ((Nat.bits b).length : ℤ)) 8 ((dzAlpha tail).length : ℤ)) 2
+        ((([true] ++ z).length : ℕ) : ℤ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
+    rw [← hL6, ← hZ6] at seg6
+    have hZ6' : ∀ i : Fin 14, i ≠ 0 → i ≠ 7 → i ≠ 10 → i ≠ 8 → i ≠ 2 → Z6 i = 0 :=
+      fun i h0 h7 h10 h8 h2 => by
+        rw [hZ6, Function.update_of_ne h2, Function.update_of_ne h8, Function.update_of_ne h10,
+          hZ3' i h0 h7]
+    obtain ⟨t7, ht7, T', P', seg7⟩ := dz_runR κ (z := z) L6 Z6
+      (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits b) (dzAlpha tail)) ([true] ++ z)) s₁ G
+      (by rw [hL6]; simp [hL4, hL3, hL2, hL1, h3])
+      (by rw [hL6]; simp [hL4, hL3])
+      (by rw [hL6, Function.update_self])
+      (by rw [hL6]; simp [hL4, hL3, hL2, hL1, h12])
+      (hZ6' 3 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide))
+      (hZ6' 6 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide))
+      (hZ6' 11 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide))
+      (hZ6' 12 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide))
+      T _ (by split_ifs <;> simp) hst hcut
+    refine ⟨_, ?_, _, T', P', by split_ifs <;> simp, seg1.trans (seg2.trans (seg3.trans
+      (seg4.trans (seg5.trans (seg6.trans seg7))))), fun hv => ?_, fun _ hCb hacc1 hacc2 => ?_⟩
+    · have hα := κ.acL tail
+      have hbb := length_bits_le_self b
+      have hz := κ.hg z.length
+      have hAa : κ.acA * (tail.length + 1) ≤ κ.acA * (κ.qcA * (G + 1)) :=
+        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
+      unfold dzQB
+      nlinarith
+    · by_cases hacc : ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith (s₁.take b)
+          ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg ([true] ++ z))).state = none ∧
+        ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith (s₁.take b)
+          ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg ([true] ++ z))).output = [true]
+      · exact ⟨hbG', hacc.1, hacc.2⟩
+      · exfalso
+        rw [if_neg hacc, if_neg (fun h => κ.hAJ h.2.symm)] at hv
+        exact (dz_acc_ne_rej κ).symm hv
+    · rw [if_pos (And.intro hacc1 hacc2), if_pos (And.intro (show T ≤ G by omega) rfl)]
+  · rw [if_neg (by omega)] at seg4
+    refine ⟨_, ?_, dzRej κ, _, _, Or.inr rfl, seg1.trans (seg2.trans (seg3.trans seg4)),
+      fun hv => absurd hv (dz_acc_ne_rej κ).symm, fun h => absurd h hbG'⟩
+    unfold dzQB
+    nlinarith
+
+/-! ### The diagonalizer `D` and its time bound -/
+
+/-- **The diagonalizer** `D`: the guess-then-run host over the setup, the block tape, and the run,
+entered at the flag, with its two verdicts, bundled as a finite nondeterministic machine. -/
+private noncomputable def dzD {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
+    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) : FinNDTM Bool :=
+  ⟨κ.K, Σ i, GuessRunPhase.State (Σ i, DzPPh κ i) (Σ i, DzQPh κ i) i,
+    guessRunTM (dzSet κ) (dzPexit κ) (κ.tp 6) (dzQ κ) ⟨.flag, none⟩ (dzAcc κ) (dzRej κ)⟩
+
+/-- The diagonalizer's uniform constant: the setup's, the block's and the run's. -/
+private def dzK {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
+    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) : ℕ :=
+  (κ.qcA + κ.gcA + κ.pcA + 40) + (κ.qcA * (7 * κ.acA + 8) + 2 * κ.lcA + 140) + 15
+
+/-- The setup's initial configuration is the blank seam in normal form. -/
+private theorem dz_initCfg {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
+    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (z : List Bool) :
+    (dzSet κ).initCfg z =
+      qyC ⟨.q, Sum.inl ()⟩ 1 (fun _ => FinTM.bufferTape []) (fun _ => 0) [] := by
+  rw [initCfg_ofWords]
+  show Cfg.ofWords (phaseHostTM (dzSetM κ) ⟨.q, Sum.inl ()⟩ (dzSetRed κ)).q₀ (fun _ => []) = _
+  rw [phaseHostTM_q₀]
+  apply Cfg.ext
+  · rw [Cfg.ofWords_state]
+    rfl
+  · rw [Cfg.ofWords_inputPos]
+    rfl
+  · funext j q
+    rw [Cfg.ofWords_workTapes]
+    rfl
+  · funext j
+    rw [Cfg.ofWords_workTapePos]
+    rfl
+  · rw [Cfg.ofWords_output]
+    rfl
+
+/-- A word longer than `G` is its first `G` symbols, one symbol and the rest. -/
+private theorem dz_split_stream (s : List Bool) (G : ℕ) (h : G < s.length) :
+    s = s.take G ++ [s[G]] ++ s.drop (G + 1) := by
+  rw [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append, ← List.drop_eq_getElem_cons h,
+    List.take_append_drop]
+
+/-- **Every stream's run reaches a verdict** within `dzQB κ (g |z|)` steps, and none earlier: the
+run's condition of `Turing.guessRunTM`'s lemmas.
+
+**Proof sketch.** The entry configuration is the setup's layout with the stream on the block tape
+(`dz_handoff`). Cases on the query: empty (`dz_qoff`), `true :: tail` (`dz_qtop`), `false :: tail`
+(`dz_qmid`, the stream split as `s₁ ++ [sp] ++ w` with `|s₁| = g n`, `dz_split_stream`, and the
+core's clause for `α = dzAlpha tail`). Each gives a segment to a verdict, avoiding both verdicts
+before. -/
+private theorem dz_hQ {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
+    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (z s : List Bool) (hs : s.length = (dzBlk (g z.length)).length) :
+    ∃ TQ ≤ dzQB κ (g z.length),
+      (((dzQ κ).runFrom (guessRunCfg (qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z)
+          (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) (κ.tp 6) s ⟨.flag, none⟩) TQ).state =
+          some (dzAcc κ) ∨
+        ((dzQ κ).runFrom (guessRunCfg (qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z)
+          (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) (κ.tp 6) s ⟨.flag, none⟩) TQ).state =
+          some (dzRej κ)) ∧
+      ∀ u < TQ,
+        ((dzQ κ).runFrom (guessRunCfg (qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z)
+          (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) (κ.tp 6) s ⟨.flag, none⟩) u).state ≠
+          some (dzAcc κ) ∧
+        ((dzQ κ).runFrom (guessRunCfg (qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z)
+          (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) (κ.tp 6) s ⟨.flag, none⟩) u).state ≠
+          some (dzRej κ) := by
+  rw [dz_handoff κ z s hs]
+  have fin : ∀ (t : ℕ) (v : Σ i, DzQPh κ i) (T' : Fin κ.K → ℤ → Option Bool) (P' : Fin κ.K → ℤ)
+      (s' : List Bool), (v = dzAcc κ ∨ v = dzRej κ) →
+      Segment (dzQ κ) (dzQF κ) (fun _ => True)
+        (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
+          (FinTM.bufferTape s')) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) (qyC v 1 T' P' []) t →
+      (((dzQ κ).runFrom (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
+          (FinTM.bufferTape s')) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) t).state =
+          some (dzAcc κ) ∨
+        ((dzQ κ).runFrom (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
+          (FinTM.bufferTape s')) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) t).state =
+          some (dzRej κ)) ∧
+      ∀ u < t,
+        ((dzQ κ).runFrom (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
+          (FinTM.bufferTape s')) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) u).state ≠
+          some (dzAcc κ) ∧
+        ((dzQ κ).runFrom (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
+          (FinTM.bufferTape s')) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) u).state ≠
+          some (dzRej κ) := by
+    intro t v T' P' s' hv seg
+    obtain ⟨hrun, havoid, -⟩ := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp seg
+    refine ⟨?_, fun u hu => ⟨fun h => havoid u hu (by rw [h]; exact Or.inl rfl),
+      fun h => havoid u hu (by rw [h]; exact Or.inr rfl)⟩⟩
+    rw [hrun]
+    rcases hv with rfl | rfl
+    · exact Or.inl rfl
+    · exact Or.inr rfl
+  rcases hq : query f g z with _ | ⟨b, tail⟩
+  · obtain ⟨t, ht, T', P', seg⟩ := dz_qoff κ z s hq
+    exact ⟨t, ht, fin t _ T' P' s (Or.inr rfl) seg⟩
+  · cases b
+    · have hlen : g z.length < s.length := by
+        rw [hs, dzBlk_length]
+        omega
+      have hsplit := dz_split_stream s (g z.length) hlen
+      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := κ.hR (dzAlpha tail)
+      have hw : (s.drop (g z.length + 1)).length = (Nat.bits (g z.length)).length := by
+        rw [List.length_drop, hs, dzBlk_length]
+        omega
+      obtain ⟨t, ht, v, T', P', hv, seg, -, -⟩ := dz_qmid κ z tail hq C hC (s.take (g z.length))
+        (s.drop (g z.length + 1)) s[g z.length] (by rw [List.length_take]; omega) hw
+      rw [← hsplit] at seg
+      exact ⟨t, ht, fin t v T' P' s hv seg⟩
+    · obtain ⟨t, ht, v, T', P', hv, seg, -⟩ := dz_qtop κ z tail s hq
+      exact ⟨t, ht, fin t v T' P' s hv seg⟩
+
+/-- The setup's facts for `Turing.guessRunTM`'s lemmas: its run to the exit, the exit's first
+arrival, and the block, nonblank on its `|dzBlk (g n)|` cells from the head and blank on both
+sides. -/
+private theorem dz_setup_facts {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
+    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (z : List Bool) :
+    ∃ TP ≤ dzSetB κ (g z.length),
+      (dzSet κ).runFrom ((dzSet κ).initCfg z) TP =
+        qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) [] ∧
+      (∀ u < TP, ((dzSet κ).runFrom ((dzSet κ).initCfg z) u).state ≠ some (dzPexit κ)) ∧
+      (∀ p : ℕ, p < (dzBlk (g z.length)).length →
+        (qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0)
+          []).workTapes (κ.tp 6) ((qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z)
+          (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []).workTapePos (κ.tp 6) + p) ≠ none) ∧
+      (qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0)
+          []).workTapes (κ.tp 6) ((qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z)
+          (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []).workTapePos (κ.tp 6) +
+          (dzBlk (g z.length)).length) = none ∧
+      (qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0)
+          []).workTapes (κ.tp 6) ((qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z)
+          (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []).workTapePos (κ.tp 6) - 1) = none := by
+  obtain ⟨TP, hTP, seg⟩ := dz_setup κ z
+  obtain ⟨hrun, havoid, -⟩ := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp seg
+  have h6 : dzSetL f g z 6 = FinTM.bufferTape (dzBlk (g z.length)) := by simp [dzSetL]
+  refine ⟨TP, hTP, by rw [dz_initCfg]; exact hrun, fun u hu h => havoid u hu ?_, fun p hp => ?_,
+    ?_, ?_⟩
+  · rw [dz_initCfg] at h
+    rw [h]
+    rfl
+  · show dzLay (dzSetL f g z) (FinTM.bufferTape []) (κ.tp 6) (0 + p) ≠ none
+    rw [dzLay_tp, h6, zero_add, FinTM.bufferTape_eq, if_pos (by omega),
+      show ((p : ℤ)).toNat = p by omega, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hp]
+    exact Option.some_ne_none _
+  · show dzLay (dzSetL f g z) (FinTM.bufferTape []) (κ.tp 6)
+      (0 + ((dzBlk (g z.length)).length : ℤ)) = none
+    rw [dzLay_tp, h6, zero_add, FinTM.bufferTape_eq_none_of_not_mem _ (by omega)]
+  · show dzLay (dzSetL f g z) (FinTM.bufferTape []) (κ.tp 6) (0 - 1) = none
+    rw [dzLay_tp, h6, FinTM.bufferTape_eq_none_of_not_mem _ (by omega)]
+
+/-- **All-branch halting.** Every branch of `D` on every input `z` halts within
+`K (g |z| + 1)`, `K = dzK κ` uniform.
+
+**Proof sketch.** `Turing.guessRunTM_haltsWithin` with the setup's facts (`dz_setup_facts`) and
+every stream's verdict (`dz_hQ`) gives `TP + 2m + T + 11` with `TP ≤ dzSetB`, `m = g n + 1 +
+|bits (g n)| ≤ 2 (g n + 1)` and `T ≤ dzQB`; `Turing.NDTM.HaltsWithin.mono` reaches the bound. -/
+private theorem dz_halts {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
+    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (z : List Bool) :
+    (dzD κ).tm.HaltsWithin z (dzK κ * (g z.length + 1)) := by
+  obtain ⟨TP, hTP, hP, hPfirst, hblock, hend, hleft⟩ := dz_setup_facts κ z
+  have h := guessRunTM_haltsWithin (dzSet κ) (dzPexit κ) (κ.tp 6) (dzQ κ) ⟨.flag, none⟩ (dzAcc κ)
+    (dzRej κ) TP _ hP rfl hPfirst _ hblock hend hleft (dzQB κ (g z.length))
+    (fun s hs => dz_hQ κ z s hs)
+  refine h.mono ?_
+  have hb := length_bits_le_self (g z.length)
+  rw [dzBlk_length]
+  unfold dzSetB at hTP
+  unfold dzK dzQB
+  nlinarith
+
 /-- **The diagonalizer** (C1-E; [AB09, proof of Theorem 3.2]; the route of C1's design §2.5 and the
 P3.3 gate's round 2, §§3–5): for time-constructible `f`, `g`, an effective scheme `c` and a
 deterministic decider of the coded machines' bounded acceptance in exponential time (`hBF`, the
--

index 925022e7..ba9fbd3f 100644
--- a/TCSlib/Complexity/Diagonalization/NTimeDiagonalizer.lean
+++ b/TCSlib/Complexity/Diagonalization/NTimeDiagonalizer.lean
@@ -8174,6 +8174,270 @@ private theorem dz_halts {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF :
   unfold dzK dzQB
   nlinarith
 
+/-! ### The middle and the top -/
+
+/-- **`D`'s acceptance, read on its streams.** `D` accepts `z` within `K (g |z| + 1)` iff some
+stream as wide as the block makes the run's first verdict the acceptance, with nothing emitted.
+
+**Proof sketch.** `Turing.FinNDTM.acceptsWithin_iff` and `Turing.guessRunTM_accepts_iff` at the
+budget `K (g |z| + 1)`, which is at least `TP + 2m + T + 11` (as in `dz_halts`); the entry
+configuration is `dz_handoff`'s. -/
+private theorem dz_accepts_iff {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
+    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (z : List Bool) :
+    (dzD κ).AcceptsWithin z (dzK κ * (g z.length + 1)) ↔
+      ∃ s : List Bool, s.length = (dzBlk (g z.length)).length ∧ ∃ TQ : ℕ,
+        ((dzQ κ).runFrom (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
+          (FinTM.bufferTape s)) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) TQ).state =
+          some (dzAcc κ) ∧
+        (∀ u < TQ,
+          ((dzQ κ).runFrom (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
+            (FinTM.bufferTape s)) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) u).state ≠
+            some (dzAcc κ) ∧
+          ((dzQ κ).runFrom (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
+            (FinTM.bufferTape s)) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) u).state ≠
+            some (dzRej κ)) ∧
+        ((dzQ κ).runFrom (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
+          (FinTM.bufferTape s)) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) TQ).output = [] := by
+  obtain ⟨TP, hTP, hP, hPfirst, hblock, hend, hleft⟩ := dz_setup_facts κ z
+  have hB : TP + 2 * (dzBlk (g z.length)).length + dzQB κ (g z.length) + 11 ≤
+      dzK κ * (g z.length + 1) := by
+    have hb := length_bits_le_self (g z.length)
+    rw [dzBlk_length]
+    unfold dzSetB at hTP
+    unfold dzK dzQB
+    nlinarith
+  have h := guessRunTM_accepts_iff (dzSet κ) (dzPexit κ) (κ.tp 6) (dzQ κ) ⟨.flag, none⟩
+    (dzAcc κ) (dzRej κ) TP _ hP rfl hPfirst _ hblock hend hleft (dzQB κ (g z.length))
+    (fun s hs => dz_hQ κ z s hs) _ hB
+  rw [FinNDTM.acceptsWithin_iff]
+  refine h.trans ?_
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨s, hs, TQ, h1, h2, h3⟩
+    rw [dz_handoff κ z s hs] at h1 h2 h3
+    exact ⟨s, hs, TQ, h1, h2, h3⟩
+  · rintro ⟨s, hs, TQ, h1, h2, h3⟩
+    refine ⟨s, hs, TQ, ?_⟩
+    rw [dz_handoff κ z s hs]
+    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
+
+/-- **The first verdict is unique.** If the run's first verdict is the acceptance at `TQ`, and a
+segment avoiding both verdicts reaches the verdict `v` at `t`, then `v` is the acceptance. -/
+private theorem dz_first {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
+    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) {z : List Bool} (st : Cfg κ.K Bool (Σ i, DzQPh κ i) z) (TQ t : ℕ)
+    (v : Σ i, DzQPh κ i) (T' : Fin κ.K → ℤ → Option Bool) (P' : Fin κ.K → ℤ)
+    (hacc : ((dzQ κ).runFrom st TQ).state = some (dzAcc κ))
+    (hcut : ∀ u < TQ, ((dzQ κ).runFrom st u).state ≠ some (dzAcc κ) ∧
+      ((dzQ κ).runFrom st u).state ≠ some (dzRej κ))
+    (hv : v = dzAcc κ ∨ v = dzRej κ)
+    (seg : Segment (dzQ κ) (dzQF κ) (fun _ => True) st (qyC v 1 T' P' []) t) : v = dzAcc κ := by
+  obtain ⟨hrun, havoid, -⟩ := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp seg
+  rcases lt_trichotomy TQ t with h | rfl | h
+  · exact absurd (Or.inl hacc) (havoid TQ h)
+  · rw [hrun] at hacc
+    exact Option.some_inj.mp hacc
+  · have hs : ((dzQ κ).runFrom st t).state = some v := by rw [hrun]; rfl
+    rcases hv with rfl | rfl
+    · exact absurd hs (hcut t h).1
+    · exact absurd hs (hcut t h).2
+
+/-- The middle's query: on `1ⁿ` with `n ≥ 3` off the stage's top, the query is `false` and the
+pair `⟨⟨bits (g n), α⟩, 1^{n + 1}⟩` (`Turing.NTimeDiag.query_eq`), `α` its stage's code, which the
+extractor recovers (`dz_alpha_eq`). -/
+private theorem dz_query_mid (f g : ℕ → ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n)
+    (hmid : n ≠ ladder f (stage f n + 1)) :
+    query f g (List.replicate n true) = false :: pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (g n))
+      (stageCode (stage f n))) (List.replicate (n + 1) true) := by
+  rw [query_eq f g hn, if_neg hmid]
+
+/-- `1^{n + 1}` is `true` prepended to `1ⁿ`. -/
+private theorem dz_ones_succ (n : ℕ) :
+    [true] ++ List.replicate n true = List.replicate (n + 1) true := by
+  rw [List.replicate_succ]
+  rfl
+
+/-- **The middle, soundness.** On `1ⁿ` off its stage's top, if `D` accepts within `K (g n + 1)`,
+the code `α` of the stage accepts `1^{n + 1}` within `g n`.
+
+**Proof sketch.** An accepting stream (`dz_accepts_iff`) splits as `s₁ ++ [sp] ++ w`
+(`dz_split_stream`); its run's first verdict is `dz_qmid`'s (`dz_first`), so `b ≤ g n` and the
+branch along `s₁.take b` halts with `[true]`: acceptance within `b`
+(`Turing.FinNDTM.acceptsWithin_iff`), hence within `g n` (`Turing.FinNDTM.AcceptsWithin.mono`). -/
+private theorem dz_mid_sound {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
+    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hmid : n ≠ ladder f (stage f n + 1))
+    (h : (dzD κ).AcceptsWithin (List.replicate n true) (dzK κ * (g n + 1))) :
+    (c.decode (stageCode (stage f n))).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate (n + 1) true)
+      (g n) := by
+  have hz : (List.replicate n true).length = n := List.length_replicate
+  have hd := (dz_accepts_iff κ (List.replicate n true)).mp (by rw [hz]; exact h)
+  obtain ⟨s, hs, TQ, hacc, hcut, -⟩ := hd
+  have hq := dz_query_mid f g hn hmid
+  have hα : dzAlpha (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (g n)) (stageCode (stage f n)))
+      (List.replicate (n + 1) true)) = stageCode (stage f n) := dz_alpha_eq _ _ _
+  have hlen : g (List.replicate n true).length < s.length := by
+    rw [hs, dzBlk_length]
+    omega
+  have hsplit := dz_split_stream s _ hlen
+  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := κ.hR (dzAlpha (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (g n))
+    (stageCode (stage f n))) (List.replicate (n + 1) true)))
+  have hw : (s.drop (g (List.replicate n true).length + 1)).length =
+      (Nat.bits (g (List.replicate n true).length)).length := by
+    rw [List.length_drop, hs, dzBlk_length]
+    omega
+  obtain ⟨t, -, v, T', P', hv, seg, hsound, -⟩ := dz_qmid κ (List.replicate n true) _ hq C hC
+    (s.take (g (List.replicate n true).length)) (s.drop (g (List.replicate n true).length + 1))
+    s[g (List.replicate n true).length] (by rw [List.length_take]; omega) hw
+  rw [← hsplit] at seg
+  obtain ⟨hbG, h1, h2⟩ := hsound (dz_first κ _ TQ t v T' P' hacc hcut hv seg)
+  rw [hα, dz_ones_succ] at h1 h2
+  have hbG' := hbG.trans (le_of_eq (congrArg g hz))
+  have hlt : (List.take (Nat.ofDigits 2 ((s.drop (g (List.replicate n true).length + 1)).map
+      Bool.toNat)) (s.take (g (List.replicate n true).length))).length =
+      Nat.ofDigits 2 ((s.drop (g (List.replicate n true).length + 1)).map Bool.toNat) := by
+    rw [List.length_take, List.length_take]
+    omega
+  exact (FinNDTM.acceptsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨_, hlt, h1, h2⟩).mono hbG'
+
+/-- A segment of the run to the acceptance gives `D`'s acceptance condition on that stream: the
+first verdict is the acceptance, with nothing emitted. -/
+private theorem dz_seg_acc {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
+    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) {z : List Bool} (st : Cfg κ.K Bool (Σ i, DzQPh κ i) z) (t : ℕ)
+    (T' : Fin κ.K → ℤ → Option Bool) (P' : Fin κ.K → ℤ)
+    (seg : Segment (dzQ κ) (dzQF κ) (fun _ => True) st (qyC (dzAcc κ) 1 T' P' []) t) :
+    ((dzQ κ).runFrom st t).state = some (dzAcc κ) ∧
+      (∀ u < t, ((dzQ κ).runFrom st u).state ≠ some (dzAcc κ) ∧
+        ((dzQ κ).runFrom st u).state ≠ some (dzRej κ)) ∧
+      ((dzQ κ).runFrom st t).output = [] := by
+  obtain ⟨hrun, havoid, -⟩ := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp seg
+  refine ⟨by rw [hrun]; rfl, fun u hu => ⟨fun h => havoid u hu (by rw [h]; exact Or.inl rfl),
+    fun h => havoid u hu (by rw [h]; exact Or.inr rfl)⟩, by rw [hrun]; rfl⟩
+
+/-- **The middle, completeness.** On `1ⁿ` off its stage's top, with the core's constant `C` for the
+stage's code `α`: if `α` accepts `1^{n + 1}` within `t'` with `C (t' + 1) ≤ g n` and `t' ≤ g n`,
+`D` accepts `1ⁿ` within `K (g n + 1)`.
+
+**Proof sketch.** Take the accepting word `v₀` (`Turing.FinNDTM.acceptsWithin_iff`), the stream
+`v₀` padded with `false` to `g n` cells, any separator, and the budget word `bits t'` padded with
+zeros to the width `|bits (g n)|` (`qy_bits_len_mono`), worth `t'` (`dz_padded_value`). The stream's
+first `t'` bits are `v₀`, so `dz_qmid`'s completeness clause gives the acceptance, and its segment
+gives `D`'s acceptance condition (`dz_seg_acc`, `dz_accepts_iff`). -/
+private theorem dz_mid_complete {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
+    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hmid : n ≠ ladder f (stage f n + 1)) (C : ℕ)
+    (hC : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (s : List Bool), t ≤ s.length →
+      ∃ T, T ≤ C * (t + 1) ∧
+        (κ.R.runFrom (streamStartCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t)
+            (stageCode (stage f n))) x) κ.jR κ.rE s) T).state =
+          some (if ((c.decode (stageCode (stage f n))).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith (s.take t)
+                ((c.decode (stageCode (stage f n))).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg x)).state = none ∧
+              ((c.decode (stageCode (stage f n))).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith (s.take t)
+                ((c.decode (stageCode (stage f n))).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg x)).output = [true]
+            then κ.rA else κ.rJ) ∧
+        ∀ u < T,
+          (κ.R.runFrom (streamStartCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t)
+              (stageCode (stage f n))) x) κ.jR κ.rE s) u).state ≠ some κ.rA ∧
+            (κ.R.runFrom (streamStartCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t)
+              (stageCode (stage f n))) x) κ.jR κ.rE s) u).state ≠ some κ.rJ)
+    (t' : ℕ) (hacc : (c.decode (stageCode (stage f n))).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin
+      (List.replicate (n + 1) true) t') (hCt : C * (t' + 1) ≤ g n) (ht' : t' ≤ g n) :
+    (dzD κ).AcceptsWithin (List.replicate n true) (dzK κ * (g n + 1)) := by
+  have hz : (List.replicate n true).length = n := List.length_replicate
+  have hq := dz_query_mid f g hn hmid
+  have hα : dzAlpha (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (g n)) (stageCode (stage f n)))
+      (List.replicate (n + 1) true)) = stageCode (stage f n) := dz_alpha_eq _ _ _
+  rw [← hα] at hC hacc
+  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀, h1, h2⟩ := FinNDTM.acceptsWithin_iff.mp hacc
+  have hgz : g (List.replicate n true).length = g n := congrArg g hz
+  set s₁ := v₀ ++ List.replicate (g n - t') false with hs₁
+  set w := Nat.bits t' ++ List.replicate ((Nat.bits (g n)).length - (Nat.bits t').length) false
+    with hw
+  have hs₁l : s₁.length = g (List.replicate n true).length := by
+    rw [hs₁, hgz, List.length_append, List.length_replicate]
+    omega
+  have hwl : w.length = (Nat.bits (g (List.replicate n true).length)).length := by
+    have := qy_bits_len_mono ht'
+    rw [hw, hgz, List.length_append, List.length_replicate]
+    omega
+  have hb : Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) = t' := dz_padded_value _ _
+  have htake : s₁.take t' = v₀ := by
+    rw [hs₁, ← hv₀]
+    exact List.take_left' rfl
+  obtain ⟨t, -, v, T', P', -, seg, -, hcomp⟩ := dz_qmid κ (List.replicate n true) _ hq C hC s₁ w
+    false hs₁l hwl
+  rw [hb] at hcomp
+  have hv := hcomp (by rw [hgz]; exact ht') (by rw [hgz]; exact hCt)
+    (by rw [htake, dz_ones_succ]; exact h1) (by rw [htake, dz_ones_succ]; exact h2)
+  subst hv
+  have hfin := (dz_accepts_iff κ (List.replicate n true)).mpr ⟨s₁ ++ [false] ++ w, by
+    rw [dzBlk_length, List.length_append, List.length_append, hs₁l, hwl, List.length_singleton],
+    t, dz_seg_acc κ _ t T' P' seg⟩
+  rwa [hz] at hfin
+
+/-- **The top.** On `1ⁿ` at its stage's top, with `BF`'s constant `CB` for the stage's code `α`
+(`hBF`'s clause at the stage's budget and bottom), when `CB 2^{CB (T* + 1)} ≤ g n`: `D` accepts
+`1ⁿ` within `K (g n + 1)` iff `α` does not accept the bottom `1^{ℓ + 1}` within `T*`.
+
+**Proof sketch.** The query is `true :: ⟨⟨bits T*, α⟩, 1^{ℓ + 1}⟩` (`Turing.NTimeDiag.query_eq`),
+`hBF`'s input. `BF` computes `[b]`, `b` the acceptance's truth, by its time
+`CB 2^{CB (T* + 1)} ≤ g n` (`Turing.FinTM.computesInTime_iff`), so every stream's run
+(`dz_qtop`) accepts iff `b = false`. Forward: an accepting stream's first verdict is `dz_qtop`'s
+(`dz_first`). Backward: any stream (the block itself) gives `D`'s acceptance condition
+(`dz_seg_acc`, `dz_accepts_iff`). -/
+private theorem dz_top_iff {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
+    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (htop : n = ladder f (stage f n + 1)) (CB : ℕ)
+    (hCB : ((c.decode (stageCode (stage f n))).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin
+        (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true) (budget f (ladder f (stage f n))) →
+        BF.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (budget f (ladder f (stage f n))))
+          (stageCode (stage f n))) (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true)) [true]
+          (CB * 2 ^ (CB * (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)) + 1)))) ∧
+      (¬(c.decode (stageCode (stage f n))).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin
+        (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true) (budget f (ladder f (stage f n))) →
+        BF.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (budget f (ladder f (stage f n))))
+          (stageCode (stage f n))) (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true)) [false]
+          (CB * 2 ^ (CB * (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)) + 1)))))
+    (hle : CB * 2 ^ (CB * (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)) + 1)) ≤ g n) :
+    (dzD κ).AcceptsWithin (List.replicate n true) (dzK κ * (g n + 1)) ↔
+      ¬(c.decode (stageCode (stage f n))).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin
+        (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true) (budget f (ladder f (stage f n))) := by
+  have hz : (List.replicate n true).length = n := List.length_replicate
+  have hgz : g (List.replicate n true).length = g n := congrArg g hz
+  have hq : query f g (List.replicate n true) = true :: pairEncode (pairEncode
+      (Nat.bits (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)))) (stageCode (stage f n)))
+      (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true) := by
+    rw [query_eq f g hn, if_pos htop]
+  -- the decider's answer on the tail, inside the allowance
+  have hans : ∀ b : Bool, BF.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode
+      (Nat.bits (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)))) (stageCode (stage f n)))
+      (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true)) [b]
+      (CB * 2 ^ (CB * (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)) + 1))) →
+      ∀ (v : Σ i, DzQPh κ i), (∀ τ ≤ g (List.replicate n true).length,
+        (BF.tm.runFrom (BF.tm.initCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode
+          (Nat.bits (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)))) (stageCode (stage f n)))
+          (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true))) τ).state = none →
+        (v = dzAcc κ ↔ (BF.tm.runFrom (BF.tm.initCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode
+          (Nat.bits (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)))) (stageCode (stage f n)))
+          (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true))) τ).output.head? = some false)) →
+      (v = dzAcc κ ↔ b = false) := by
+    intro b hb v hsem
+    obtain ⟨hst, hout⟩ := (FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp hb
+    rw [hsem _ (by rw [hgz]; exact hle) hst, hout]
+    cases b <;> simp
+  constructor
+  · intro hD
+    obtain ⟨s, hs, TQ, hacc, hcut, -⟩ := (dz_accepts_iff κ (List.replicate n true)).mp
+      (by rw [hz]; exact hD)
+    obtain ⟨t, -, v, T', P', hv, seg, hsem⟩ := dz_qtop κ (List.replicate n true) _ s hq
+    have hvacc := dz_first κ _ TQ t v T' P' hacc hcut hv seg
+    intro hA
+    have := (hans true (hCB.1 hA) v hsem).mp hvacc
+    exact Bool.noConfusion this
+  · intro hA
+    obtain ⟨t, -, v, T', P', -, seg, hsem⟩ := dz_qtop κ (List.replicate n true) _
+      (dzBlk (g (List.replicate n true).length)) hq
+    have hv := (hans false (hCB.2 hA) v hsem).mpr rfl
+    subst hv
+    have hfin := (dz_accepts_iff κ (List.replicate n true)).mpr
+      ⟨dzBlk (g (List.replicate n true).length), rfl, t, dz_seg_acc κ _ t T' P' seg⟩
+    rwa [hz] at hfin
+
 /-- **The diagonalizer** (C1-E; [AB09, proof of Theorem 3.2]; the route of C1's design §2.5 and the
 P3.3 gate's round 2, §§3–5): for time-constructible `f`, `g`, an effective scheme `c` and a
 deterministic decider of the coded machines' bounded acceptance in exponential time (`hBF`, the
--

Subject: [PATCH 12/12] NTimeDiagonalizer: the diagonalizer's landing edits

- qy_call_bound's bound hb cites Turing.length_bits_le_self.
- dz_padded_value cites Nat.ofDigits_append_replicate_zero; dz_top_run's first halt cites
  MultiTapeTM.exists_first_halt (both replace inline re-derivations).
- dz_test rewrites with ne_eq rather than the definition Ne.
- Docstrings: the prepend row named by its lemma; dz_cell0 and four bare labels state their
  equations; an Implementation paragraph at the end of exists_diagonalizer's docstring.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

 Fill obligations, named: the assembly; the budget's guess, test, normalization and rewrite (a
 private leaf in `O(g n + 1)`); the transfer to every branch

+constant `C = max 1 (max C_R C_BF)`.
+
+**Implementation.** `D` is `Turing.guessRunTM` over a deterministic setup and a deterministic
+run. The setup calls the stage query, `g`'s witness and `x ↦ true :: x` on the native input
+(released input calls), and writes the block `1^{g n} ++ [true] ++ bits (g n)` (two expansions and
+a copy), the ruler `1^{g n}` and the clock's counter `bits (g n)`. The guess overwrites the block
+with a stream, a separator and a budget word. The run is a phase host: a one-cell take reads the
+query's flag; in the middle it splits the block (a skip back, the lockstep walk over the ruler, a
+take of the separator, a move of the budget word), tests the budget `b ≤ g n` (its expansion and
+the length comparison with the stream), normalizes it to `bits b` (an install call), extracts `α`
+from the query's tail (the install call of the composite pair extractor), writes the core's input
+`⟨⟨bits b, α⟩, 1^{n + 1}⟩` by three emissions under the capture wrapper, and runs the interpreter
+core under the step clock over the virtual-input host, accepting at its `accept` within the
+allowance `g n`; at a top it runs the decider of `hBF` on the query's tail under the same clocked
+host and accepts iff its captured output starts with `false`. All-branch halting is
+`Turing.guessRunTM_haltsWithin` and acceptance `Turing.guessRunTM_accepts_iff`; `K` is uniform and,
+per code, `C = max 1 (max C_R C_BF)`. -/
 theorem exists_diagonalizer {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Complexity.TimeConstructible f)
     (hg : Complexity.TimeConstructible g) (c : EffectiveNDMachineCode)
     (hBF : ∃ BF : FinTM Bool, ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),

## ===== campaign/gates/93-ed-diagonalizer-fill/evidence/screen/README.md =====

# The landing head's screen (gate 93)

`screen-ed-pairs.py` is the v3 copy-text screen (`scripts/copy-text-screen-v3.py`) restricted to pairs
with an `NTimeDiagonalizer` declaration on one side (one added line; the NF cont1 review's
`screen-nf-pairs.py` with the file name changed). It ran over the brief's 38-file population
(`population.txt`) on a `git archive` export of #188's head `dae7929c` (`status.txt`).

Result: 177 pairs with the owned file (`screen-land-ed-pairs.txt`). The review's full head screen
(`campaign/fills/eq/reviews/ed-fill/out/17-screen-head.txt`) restricted to the same pairs gives the
same 177 lines (`head-ed-pairs.txt`, `land-ed-pairs.txt`; `head-vs-land.diff` shows only the
summary line, which the filtered head list lacks). The landing edits E1–E7 and the merge add and
remove no pair.

## ===== campaign/gates/93-ed-diagonalizer-fill/evidence/screen/screen-ed-pairs.py =====

```
# The v3 copy-text screen (scripts/copy-text-screen-v3.py at the head), restricted to pairs with an
# NTimeDiagonalizer declaration on one side (the only file the delivery changes). Reviewer-generated.
"""Text-level copy screen for retrofit deliveries, v3 (declaration-keyed).

Identical to audits/evidence/retrofit/copy-text-screen-v2.py except in how declarations are told
apart. v2 skipped a pair when (path, extracted name) coincided, so two distinct declarations in one
file with the same short name were never compared: the same name in two namespaces (a generic
`DiagSimulator.time_hierarchy_of_pos` beside the received `Complexity.time_hierarchy_of_pos`, both
written `theorem time_hierarchy_of_pos`), or two anonymous instances (Diagonal Part 1 gate, m2).
v3 identifies each declaration by its path and source position and skips a pair only when both
sides are the same declaration. Labels: as in v2 (`<file>::<name>`) when the extracted name is
unique among the file's screened declarations; otherwise the namespace-qualified name, with `#k`
appended (k-th in source order) when that is still not unique. Namespaces are tracked through
`namespace`, `section`, `noncomputable section`, `mutual` and `end`; a dotted `namespace A.B`
opens two scopes, as in Lean, and `_root_.` is honoured. Hence, when no file in the argument list
has two screened declarations with the same extracted name, v3's output is byte-identical to
v2's. An `end` that closes no matching scope stops the screen (exit 1, message on stderr).

For the given Lean files it lists every like-kind pair (proof vs proof, term vs term) in which one
declaration reproduces at least half of another's extracted body (at least 60 characters, greedy
tiling with blocks of at least 25), within a file and across the given files. It also prints the
total reproduced text. Run it before and after a change: a pair present after but not before is
new duplication; inlining a deleted copy into a consumer shows up as such a pair.
Usage: python3 -I copy-text-screen-v3.py <repo-root> <file.lean> [<file.lean> ...]
"""
import os, re, sys
root, files = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:]
paths = list(dict.fromkeys(os.path.normpath(f) for f in files))
nbase = {}
for p in paths: nbase[os.path.basename(p)] = nbase.get(os.path.basename(p), 0) + 1
label = lambda p: os.path.basename(p) if nbase[os.path.basename(p)] == 1 else p
def strip(src):
    out = []; i = 0; depth = 0; n = len(src)
    while i < n:
        if src.startswith('/-', i): depth += 1; i += 2; continue
        if depth and src.startswith('-/', i): depth -= 1; i += 2; continue
        if depth: i += 1; continue
        if src.startswith('--', i):
            j = src.find('\n', i); i = n if j < 0 else j; continue
        out.append(src[i]); i += 1
    return ''.join(out)
DECL = re.compile(r"^(?:@\[[^\]]*\]\s*)?((?:(?:noncomputable|private|protected)\s+)*)"
                  r"(def|theorem|lemma|abbrev|instance|structure|inductive)\s+(\S+)", re.M)
SCOPE = re.compile(r"^[ \t]*(?:(namespace)[ \t]+(\S+)|(?:noncomputable[ \t]+)?(section)\b[ \t]*([^\s]*)"
                   r"|(mutual)\b|(end)\b[ \t]*([^\s]*))", re.M)
def scopes(p, t):
    """(offset, namespace) after each scope command of the stripped text `t`, in source order."""
    stack = []; ev = [(0, '')]
    for m in SCOPE.finditer(t):
        if m.group(1): stack += [('namespace', c) for c in m.group(2).split('.')]
        elif m.group(3): stack.append(('section', m.group(4)))
        elif m.group(5): stack.append(('mutual', ''))
        else:  # `end A.B` closes the innermost scopes B, then A; a bare `end` an anonymous one
            for c in reversed(m.group(7).split('.')):
                if not stack or stack[-1][1] != c:
                    sys.exit(f"copy-text-screen-v3: {p}:{t.count(chr(10), 0, m.start()) + 1}: "
                             f"`end {m.group(7)}` does not close {stack[-1] if stack else 'any scope'}")
                stack.pop()
        ev.append((m.end(), '.'.join(n for k, n in stack if k == 'namespace')))
    return ev
def qualify(ns, name):
    if name.startswith('_root_.'): return name[len('_root_.'):]
    return f'{ns}.{name}' if ns else name
def body(b):
    d = 0
    for i, ch in enumerate(b):
        if ch in '([{⟨': d += 1
        elif ch in ')]}⟩': d -= 1
        elif b.startswith(':=', i) and d == 0: return b[i + 2:]
    d = 0
    for i, ch in enumerate(b):
        if ch in '([{⟨': d += 1
        elif ch in ')]}⟩': d -= 1
        elif d == 0 and (ch == '|' or re.match(r'\bwhere\b', b[i:i + 6])): return b[i:]
    return ''
def lcs(a, b):
    lo, hi, best = 0, min(len(a), len(b)), ''
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi + 1) // 2
        subs = {b[i:i + mid] for i in range(len(b) - mid + 1)}
        hit = next((a[i:i + mid] for i in range(len(a) - mid + 1) if a[i:i + mid] in subs), None)
        if hit is not None: lo, best = mid, hit
        else: hi = mid - 1
    return lo, best
def tiled(a, b):
    c = 0
    while True:
        n, seg = lcs(a, b)
        if n < 25: return c
        c += n; a = a.replace(seg, '\x00', 1); b = b.replace(seg, '\x01', 1)
grams = lambda x: {x[i:i + 25] for i in range(len(x) - 24)}
decls = []
for p in paths:
    t = strip(open(f'{root}/{p}', encoding='utf-8').read()); ms = list(DECL.finditer(t))
    ev = scopes(p, t); found = []
    for i, m in enumerate(ms):
        end = ms[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(ms) else len(t)
        kind = 'proof' if m.group(2) in ('theorem', 'lemma') else 'term'
        bd = re.sub(r'\s+', '', body(t[m.start():end]))
        ns = [n for o, n in ev if o <= m.start()][-1]
        if len(bd) >= 60: found.append((m.start(), m.group(3), qualify(ns, m.group(3)), kind, bd))
    short = {}; qual = {}
    for (_, nm, qn, _, _) in found: short[nm] = short.get(nm, 0) + 1; qual[qn] = qual.get(qn, 0) + 1
    seen = {}
    for (pos, nm, qn, kind, bd) in found:
        if short[nm] == 1: name = nm
        elif qual[qn] == 1: name = qn
        else: seen[qn] = seen.get(qn, 0) + 1; name = f'{qn}#{seen[qn]}'
        decls.append(((p, pos), name, kind, bd, grams(bd)))
pairs = []; total = 0
for (fa, a, ka, ta, ga) in decls:
    for (fb, b, kb, tb, gb) in decls:
        if fa == fb or ka != kb or not (ga & gb): continue
        if 'NTimeDiagonalizer' not in fa[0] and 'NTimeDiagonalizer' not in fb[0]: continue
        sh = tiled(tb, ta)
        if sh >= 60 and 2 * sh >= len(tb):
            pairs.append((sh / len(tb), sh, len(tb), f'{label(fa[0])}::{a}', f'{label(fb[0])}::{b}')); total += sh
pairs.sort(reverse=True)
print(f"declarations screened: {len(decls)}; copy pairs (target reproduces >= half of source): {len(pairs)}; reproduced text: {total:,} chars")
for frac, sh, ln, a, b in pairs:
    print(f"   {a}  reproduces  {b}: {sh}/{ln} = {frac:.0%}")
```

/-!
# The lazy diagonalizer of the nondeterministic time hierarchy

[AB09, §3.2, proof of Theorem 3.2 and Figure 3.1] ([Coo72]): the machine `D` of the lazy
diagonalization, as two contracts over a pure description of its stages. C1-E's statement phase
(C1's fill plan, `audits/evidence/c1/C1-fill-plan.md`; the route of
`audits/evidence/c1/C1-design.md` §2.5 and the P3.3 gate's round 2,
`audits/ch3-p33-r2-findings.md` §§1–5).

* **The stages** are pure. The ladder is `ℓ₀ = 2` and `ℓᵢ₊₁ = 2 ^ (T*ᵢ)²`, with bottom `aᵢ = ℓᵢ + 1`
  and budget `T*ᵢ = (f aᵢ + aᵢ + 1)²` (`Turing.NTimeDiag.ladder`, `Turing.NTimeDiag.budget`). An
  input `1ⁿ` with `n ≥ 3` lies in the stage `i` with `ℓᵢ < n ≤ ℓᵢ₊₁` (`Turing.NTimeDiag.stage`).
  That stage diagonalizes against the code `αⱼ` with `j = (Nat.unpair i).1`
  (`Turing.NTimeDiag.stageCode`), so every code recurs at unboundedly many stages: the P3.3 gate's
  fixed-code schedule.
* **The stage query** (`Turing.NTimeDiag.query`) is the word that `D` hands to its simulators.
  - At the top `n = ℓᵢ₊₁` it is the flag `true` and the exponential decider's input
    `⟨⟨bits T*, α⟩, 1^a⟩`.
  - In the middle it is the flag `false` and `⟨⟨bits (g n), α⟩, 1^{n+1}⟩`; `D` rewrites its budget.
  - Off unary inputs of length at least `3` it is `[]`.

  One deterministic machine computes it in time linear in `g n + 1`
  (`Turing.NTimeDiag.exists_queryTM`). Its fill is the capped locator of the gate's round 2, `g`'s
  witness and the materialization.
* **The diagonalizer's contract** (`Turing.NTimeDiag.exists_diagonalizer`) is exactly what the chain
  of [AB09, Figure 3.1] reads:
  - every branch halts within a uniform `K · (g n + 1)`;
  - per code `α` there is a constant `C`;
  - in the middle of a stage of `α`, `D` accepts `1ⁿ` only if the coded machine accepts `1^{n+1}`
    within `g n`, and it does whenever the coded machine accepts within some `t'` with
    `C · (t' + 1) ≤ g n`;
  - at a top, once `C · 2^{C·(T* + 1)} ≤ n`, `D` accepts `1ⁿ` iff the coded machine does not accept
    the bottom `1^a` within `T*`.

## Main definitions

* `Turing.NTimeDiag.budget`, `Turing.NTimeDiag.ladder`, `Turing.NTimeDiag.stage`,
  `Turing.NTimeDiag.stageCode`, `Turing.NTimeDiag.query`.

## Main results

* `Turing.NTimeDiag.budget_eq`, `ladder_zero`, `ladder_succ`, `two_mul_lt_ladder_succ`,
  `stage_spec`, `stage_eq`, `stage_of_le_two`, `stageCode_eq`, `stageCode_frequently`, `query_eq`,
  `query_of_not_guard` — the stages' laws (proved).
* `Turing.NTimeDiag.acceptLang_mem_NTIME` — a halting NDTM's bounded language is in `NTIME`
  (proved).
* `Turing.NTimeDiag.exists_queryTM` — the stage query in linear time (proved).
* `Turing.NTimeDiag.exists_diagonalizer` — the diagonalizer (proved).

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§3.2, Theorem 3.2 and Figure 3.1.)
* [Coo72] S. Cook, *A hierarchy for nondeterministic time complexity*,
  STOC 1972. (Cited through [AB09]; no external text is required.)
-/

namespace Turing.NTimeDiag

/-- **The budget of a stage** with bottom ladder value `ℓ`: with the bottom `a = ℓ + 1`, the
budget is `T* = (f a + a + 1)²` [the P3.3 gate's round 2, §1]. -/
def budget (f : ℕ → ℕ) (ℓ : ℕ) : ℕ := (f (ℓ + 1) + (ℓ + 1) + 1) ^ 2

/-- The budget, unfolded: `budget f ℓ = (f (ℓ + 1) + (ℓ + 1) + 1) ^ 2`. -/
theorem budget_eq (f : ℕ → ℕ) (ℓ : ℕ) : budget f ℓ = (f (ℓ + 1) + (ℓ + 1) + 1) ^ 2 := rfl

/-- **The ladder** [AB09, Figure 3.1; the P3.3 gate's round 2, §1]: `ℓ₀ = 2` and
`ℓᵢ₊₁ = 2 ^ (T*ᵢ)²`, where `T*ᵢ = budget f ℓᵢ`. -/
def ladder (f : ℕ → ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => 2
  | i + 1 => 2 ^ budget f (ladder f i) ^ 2

/-- The ladder starts at `2`: `ladder f 0 = 2`. -/
theorem ladder_zero (f : ℕ → ℕ) : ladder f 0 = 2 := rfl

/-- One more rung: `ladder f (i + 1) = 2 ^ (budget f (ladder f i)) ^ 2`. -/
theorem ladder_succ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ) :
    ladder f (i + 1) = 2 ^ budget f (ladder f i) ^ 2 := rfl

/-- **The ladder more than doubles**: `2 · ℓᵢ < ℓᵢ₊₁`.

**Proof sketch.** The budget is at least `(ℓᵢ + 2)²`, so its square exceeds `ℓᵢ + 1`, and
`2 · ℓᵢ < 2 ^ (ℓᵢ + 1)` (`Nat.lt_two_pow`). -/
theorem two_mul_lt_ladder_succ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ) : 2 * ladder f i < ladder f (i + 1) := by
  rw [ladder_succ]
  have hb : ladder f i + 1 ≤ budget f (ladder f i) ^ 2 := by
    unfold budget
    have h1 : ladder f i + 1 ≤ f (ladder f i + 1) + (ladder f i + 1) + 1 := by omega
    have h2 : f (ladder f i + 1) + (ladder f i + 1) + 1 ≤
        (f (ladder f i + 1) + (ladder f i + 1) + 1) ^ 2 := Nat.le_self_pow (by norm_num) _
    have h3 : (f (ladder f i + 1) + (ladder f i + 1) + 1) ^ 2 ≤
        ((f (ladder f i + 1) + (ladder f i + 1) + 1) ^ 2) ^ 2 := Nat.le_self_pow (by norm_num) _
    omega
  calc 2 * ladder f i < 2 * 2 ^ ladder f i := by
        have := Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := ladder f i); omega
    _ = 2 ^ (ladder f i + 1) := by rw [Nat.pow_succ]; ring
    _ ≤ 2 ^ budget f (ladder f i) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hb

/-- The ladder is above its index: `i + 2 ≤ ℓᵢ`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `i`, by `Turing.NTimeDiag.two_mul_lt_ladder_succ`. -/
theorem le_ladder (f : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ) : i + 2 ≤ ladder f i := by
  induction i with
  | zero => exact le_of_eq (ladder_zero f).symm
  | succ i ih => have := two_mul_lt_ladder_succ f i; omega

/-- The ladder is strictly increasing.

**Proof sketch.** `Turing.NTimeDiag.two_mul_lt_ladder_succ` at each step. -/
theorem ladder_strictMono (f : ℕ → ℕ) : StrictMono (ladder f) :=
  strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun i => by have := two_mul_lt_ladder_succ f i; omega

/-- Every length is below some rung: `n ≤ ladder f (n + 1)`. -/
theorem exists_le_ladder_succ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ∃ i, n ≤ ladder f (i + 1) :=
  ⟨n, by have := le_ladder f (n + 1); omega⟩

/-- **The stage of a length** `n`: the least `i` with `n ≤ ℓᵢ₊₁`. For `n ≥ 3` it is the unique `i`
with `ℓᵢ < n ≤ ℓᵢ₊₁` (`Turing.NTimeDiag.stage_spec`, `Turing.NTimeDiag.stage_eq`). -/
def stage (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.find (exists_le_ladder_succ f n)

/-- **The stage brackets its length**: for `n ≥ 3`, `ℓ_{stage n} < n ≤ ℓ_{stage n + 1}`.

**Proof sketch.** The upper bound is `Nat.find_spec`. For the lower bound, stage `0` has
`ℓ₀ = 2 < n`; a positive stage `i` has `n > ℓᵢ` by `Nat.find_min` at `i - 1`. -/
theorem stage_spec (f : ℕ → ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ladder f (stage f n) < n ∧ n ≤ ladder f (stage f n + 1) := by
  refine ⟨?_, Nat.find_spec (exists_le_ladder_succ f n)⟩
  unfold stage
  rcases h : Nat.find (exists_le_ladder_succ f n) with _ | i
  · rw [ladder_zero]; omega
  · have hmin := Nat.find_min (exists_le_ladder_succ f n) (m := i) (by omega)
    omega

/-- **The stage is determined by its bracket**: `ℓᵢ < n ≤ ℓᵢ₊₁` gives `stage f n = i`.

**Proof sketch.** `Nat.find` is at most `i` by the upper bound, and a smaller stage `i'` would
give `n ≤ ℓ_{i'+1} ≤ ℓᵢ < n` by monotonicity. -/
theorem stage_eq (f : ℕ → ℕ) {n i : ℕ} (hlo : ladder f i < n) (hhi : n ≤ ladder f (i + 1)) :
    stage f n = i := by
  have hle : stage f n ≤ i := Nat.find_min' (exists_le_ladder_succ f n) hhi
  rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le hle with hlt | heq
  · exfalso
    have hs := Nat.find_spec (exists_le_ladder_succ f n)
    have hm : ladder f (stage f n + 1) ≤ ladder f i :=
      (ladder_strictMono f).monotone (by unfold stage at hlt ⊢; omega)
    unfold stage at hm
    omega
  · exact heq

/-- **Short lengths are in stage `0`** (the statement gate, finding 3): for `n ≤ 2`,
`stage f n = 0`.

**Proof sketch.** `n ≤ 2 < 3 ≤ ℓ₁` (`Turing.NTimeDiag.le_ladder`), so `0` already satisfies the
search. -/
theorem stage_of_le_two (f : ℕ → ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ 2) : stage f n = 0 :=
  (Nat.find_eq_zero (exists_le_ladder_succ f n)).2 (le_trans (by omega) (le_ladder f 1))

/-- **The code a stage diagonalizes against**: the binary word of index `j = (Nat.unpair i).1`,
`(Nat.bits (j + 1)).dropLast` (the binary expansion of `j + 1` without its top bit). Every word
arises for exactly one `j`, and every `j` for unboundedly many stages
(`Turing.NTimeDiag.stageCode_frequently`). -/
def stageCode (i : ℕ) : List Bool := (Nat.bits ((Nat.unpair i).1 + 1)).dropLast

/-- The scheduled code, unfolded: `stageCode i = (Nat.bits ((Nat.unpair i).1 + 1)).dropLast`. -/
theorem stageCode_eq (i : ℕ) : stageCode i = (Nat.bits ((Nat.unpair i).1 + 1)).dropLast := rfl

/-- **Every code recurs at unboundedly many stages** [the P3.3 gate's round 2, §1: the fixed-code
schedule]: for every word `α` and bound `N` some stage `i ≥ N` has `stageCode i = α`.

**Proof sketch.** Take `j + 1 = Nat.ofBits (α ++ [true])`, whose binary expansion is `α` followed
by its top bit, and `i = Nat.pair j N ≥ N` (`Nat.right_le_pair`, `Nat.unpair_pair`). -/
theorem stageCode_frequently (α : List Bool) (N : ℕ) : ∃ i, N ≤ i ∧ stageCode i = α := by
  obtain ⟨m, hm1, hm⟩ : ∃ m, 1 ≤ m ∧ Nat.bits m = α ++ [true] := by
    induction α with
    | nil => exact ⟨1, le_rfl, by simp⟩
    | cons b α ih =>
      obtain ⟨m, hm1, hm⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨Nat.bit b m, ?_, ?_⟩
      · cases b <;> simp only [Nat.bit, cond_true, cond_false] <;> omega
      · rw [Nat.bits_append_bit _ _ (fun h => absurd h (by omega)), hm, List.cons_append]
  refine ⟨Nat.pair (m - 1) N, Nat.right_le_pair _ _, ?_⟩
  simp only [stageCode, Nat.unpair_pair, Nat.sub_add_cancel hm1, hm, List.dropLast_concat]

/-- **The stage query** on an input `x`: the word the diagonalizer builds its rungs from. On a
unary `x = 1ⁿ` with `n ≥ 3`, in the stage `i = stage f n` with code `α = stageCode i` and bottom
`ℓ = ladder f i`:
- at the top `n = ladder f (i + 1)`: `true :: ⟨⟨bits (budget f ℓ), α⟩, 1^{ℓ + 1}⟩`;
- otherwise: `false :: ⟨⟨bits (g n), α⟩, 1^{n + 1}⟩`.

On every other input it is `[]`. -/
def query (f g : ℕ → ℕ) (x : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  if x = List.replicate x.length true ∧ 3 ≤ x.length then
    if x.length = ladder f (stage f x.length + 1) then
      true :: pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (budget f (ladder f (stage f x.length))))
        (stageCode (stage f x.length))) (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f x.length) + 1) true)
    else
      false :: pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (g x.length)) (stageCode (stage f x.length)))
        (List.replicate (x.length + 1) true)
  else []

/-- **The stage query on `1ⁿ`, unfolded**: for `n ≥ 3`, with `i = stage f n`, it is
`true :: ⟨⟨bits (budget f ℓᵢ), αᵢ⟩, 1^{ℓᵢ + 1}⟩` at the top `n = ℓᵢ₊₁` and
`false :: ⟨⟨bits (g n), αᵢ⟩, 1^{n + 1}⟩` otherwise. -/
theorem query_eq (f g : ℕ → ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    query f g (List.replicate n true) =
      if n = ladder f (stage f n + 1) then
        true :: pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (budget f (ladder f (stage f n))))
          (stageCode (stage f n))) (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true)
      else
        false :: pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (g n)) (stageCode (stage f n)))
          (List.replicate (n + 1) true) := by
  simp only [query, List.length_replicate, true_and, hn, ↓reduceIte]

/-- **The stage query off its guard is empty** (the statement gate, finding 3): unless `x` is
unary of length at least `3`, `query f g x = []`. With `Turing.NTimeDiag.query_eq` it covers every
input. -/
theorem query_of_not_guard (f g : ℕ → ℕ) {x : List Bool}
    (hx : ¬(x = List.replicate x.length true ∧ 3 ≤ x.length)) : query f g x = [] := by
  unfold query
  exact if_neg hx

/-- **A halting NDTM's bounded language is in `NTIME`**: if every branch of `D` on every `x` halts
within `K · (g |x| + 1)`, then the language `{x | D accepts x within K · (g |x| + 1)}` is in
`NTIME (g + 1)`. It is the first half of the hierarchy's strictness argument, read off
`Turing.NTimeDiag.exists_diagonalizer`'s time clause.

**Proof sketch.** `Complexity.mem_NTIME_iff` at the constant `K`: the halting clause is the
hypothesis, and membership is acceptance by definition. -/
theorem acceptLang_mem_NTIME (D : FinNDTM Bool) (K : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ x : List Bool, D.tm.HaltsWithin x (K * (g x.length + 1))) :
    {x : List Bool | D.AcceptsWithin x (K * (g x.length + 1))} ∈
      Complexity.NTIME fun n => g n + 1 :=
  ⟨K, D, fun x => ⟨h x, Iff.rfl⟩⟩

/-- The query of a word is the query of the unary word of the same length when the word is unary
of length at least three, and is empty otherwise. -/
private theorem qy_guard (f g : ℕ → ℕ) (x : List Bool) :
    query f g x = if x = List.replicate x.length true ∧ 3 ≤ x.length then
      query f g (List.replicate x.length true) else [] := by
  by_cases h : x = List.replicate x.length true ∧ 3 ≤ x.length
  · rw [if_pos h]
    exact congrArg (query f g) h.1
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact query_of_not_guard f g h

/-- A linear-time decider recognizes all-true words of length at least three. It composes the
published all-true test `Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_allTrue` with three fixed-word tests
`Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_decideEq` by the timed conditional; it introduces no input scan
beyond those rows. No public row decides the length bound.

**Proof sketch.** The all-true test decides unarity. Three fixed-word tests reject the empty word
and the all-true words of lengths one and two. Each conditional preserves a linear time bound. -/
private theorem qy_guard_decider :
    ∃ (D : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      D.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun x => [decide (x = List.replicate x.length true ∧ 3 ≤ x.length)])
        (fun n => c * (n + 1)) := by
  have hcut (w : List Bool) {M : FinTM Bool} {p : List Bool → Bool} {C : ℕ}
      (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) (fun n => C * (n + 1))) :
      ∃ (D : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
        D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [decide (x ≠ w) && p x])
          (fun n => c * (n + 1)) := by
    obtain ⟨E, a, hE'⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_decideEq w
    obtain ⟨F, b, hF⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_const [false]
    obtain ⟨D, d, hD⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond hE' hF hM
    refine ⟨D, d * (a + b + C + 1), (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mpr ?_⟩
    intro x
    have hx := (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mp hD x
    have hout : (if decide (x = w) then [false] else [p x]) =
        [decide (x ≠ w) && p x] := by
      by_cases he : x = w <;> simp [he]
    rw [hout] at hx
    apply hx.mono
    calc
      _ ≤ d * ((a + b + C + 1) * (x.length + 1)) := by
        apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
        have hm : max (b * (x.length + 1)) (C * (x.length + 1)) ≤
            b * (x.length + 1) + C * (x.length + 1) :=
          max_le (Nat.le_add_right _ _) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
        nlinarith
      _ = _ := by ring
  obtain ⟨U, c, hU'⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_allTrue
  obtain ⟨D₀, c₀, h₀⟩ := hcut [] hU'
  obtain ⟨D₁, c₁, h₁⟩ := hcut [true] h₀
  obtain ⟨D₂, c₂, h₂⟩ := hcut [true, true] h₁
  refine ⟨D₂, c₂, ?_⟩
  convert h₂ using 1
  funext x
  refine congrArg (fun b => [b]) ?_
  apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hu, hn⟩
    have hz : x ≠ [] := by
      intro h
      have := congrArg List.length h
      simp only [List.length_nil] at this
      omega
    have ho : x ≠ [true] := by
      intro h
      have := congrArg List.length h
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at this
      omega
    have ht : x ≠ [true, true] := by
      intro h
      have := congrArg List.length h
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at this
      omega
    exact ⟨ht, ho, hz, hu⟩
  · rintro ⟨ht, ho, hz, hu⟩
    refine ⟨hu, ?_⟩
    by_contra hn
    have hlen : x.length = 0 ∨ x.length = 1 ∨ x.length = 2 := by omega
    rcases hlen with hlen | hlen | hlen
    · exact hz (by simpa only [hlen, List.replicate_zero] using hu)
    · exact ho (by simpa only [hlen, List.replicate_succ, List.replicate_zero] using hu)
    · exact ht (by simpa only [hlen, List.replicate_succ, List.replicate_zero] using hu)

/-- A machine for the query on the unary word of every input's length suffices for the full
query. The guard and the empty-output branch add only a uniform multiple of `g n + 1`.

**Proof sketch.** Use the linear guard to choose the supplied machine or the constant empty
output. The guard equation identifies the output. Since `n ≤ g n`, both the guard and the empty
branch fit the same bound as the supplied machine; absorb the conditional's constant. -/
private theorem qy_query_of_main {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (hg : Complexity.TimeConstructible g)
    {M : FinTM Bool} {A : ℕ}
    (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => query f g (List.replicate x.length true))
      (fun n => A * (g n + 1))) :
    ∃ (G : FinTM Bool) (C : ℕ),
      G.ComputesFunInTime (query f g) (fun n => C * (g n + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨D, a, hD⟩ := qy_guard_decider
  obtain ⟨E, b, hE⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_const []
  obtain ⟨G, c, hG⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond hD hM hE
  have hle := ((Complexity.timeConstructible_iff g).mp hg).1
  refine ⟨G, c * (a + A + b + 1), (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mpr ?_⟩
  intro x
  have hx := (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mp hG x
  have hout : (if decide (x = List.replicate x.length true ∧ 3 ≤ x.length) then
      query f g (List.replicate x.length true) else []) = query f g x := by
    simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq] using (qy_guard f g x).symm
  rw [hout] at hx
  apply hx.mono
  calc
    _ ≤ c * ((a + A + b + 1) * (g x.length + 1)) := by
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
      have ha := Nat.mul_le_mul_left a (Nat.add_le_add_right (hle x.length) 1)
      have hb := Nat.mul_le_mul_left b (Nat.add_le_add_right (hle x.length) 1)
      have hm : max (A * (g x.length + 1)) (b * (x.length + 1)) ≤
          A * (g x.length + 1) + b * (g x.length + 1) :=
        max_le (Nat.le_add_right _ _) (hb.trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _))
      nlinarith
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- The next rung in terms of `X = f a + a + 1`: `ladder f (i + 1) = 2 ^ X ^ 4`. -/
private theorem qy_ladder_succ_eq (f : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ) :
    ladder f (i + 1) = 2 ^ (f (ladder f i + 1) + (ladder f i + 1) + 1) ^ 4 := by
  rw [ladder_succ, budget_eq, ← pow_mul]

/-- The ledger: the rungs passed before stage `s` sum to at most twice its bottom. -/
private theorem qy_ledger (f : ℕ → ℕ) (s : ℕ) :
    ∑ h ∈ Finset.range s, ladder f (h + 1) ≤ 2 * ladder f s := by
  induction s with
  | zero => simp
  | succ s ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    have := two_mul_lt_ladder_succ f s
    omega

/-- **The all-ones counter's value**: `m` ones are worth `2 ^ m - 1`. -/
private theorem qy_ones_val (m : ℕ) :
    Nat.ofDigits 2 ((List.replicate m true).map Bool.toNat) = 2 ^ m - 1 := by
  induction m with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [List.replicate_succ, List.map_cons, Nat.ofDigits_cons, ih, Bool.toNat_true, pow_succ]
    have := Nat.one_le_two_pow (n := m)
    omega

/-- **The next rung's counter value**: `m` zeros then a one are worth `2 ^ m`. -/
private theorem qy_rung_val (m : ℕ) :
    Nat.ofDigits 2 ((List.replicate m false ++ [true]).map Bool.toNat) = 2 ^ m := by
  induction m with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [List.replicate_succ, List.cons_append, List.map_cons, Nat.ofDigits_cons, ih,
      Bool.toNat_false, pow_succ]
    ring

/-- **The counter is large enough**: the all-ones word of width `|bits n| + |bits D|` is worth at
least `D (n + 1)`. -/
private theorem qy_ones_ge (n D : ℕ) :
    D * (n + 1) ≤ 2 ^ ((Nat.bits n).length + (Nat.bits D).length) - 1 := by
  rw [Nat.size_eq_bits_len, Nat.size_eq_bits_len, pow_add]
  have hn := Nat.lt_size_self n
  have hD := Nat.lt_size_self D
  have hprod : (n + 1) * (D + 1) ≤ 2 ^ Nat.size n * 2 ^ Nat.size D :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul hn hD
  have : D * (n + 1) + 1 ≤ (n + 1) * (D + 1) := by nlinarith
  omega

/-- **The counter is not too large**: `2 ^ |bits n| ≤ 2 n + 1`. -/
private theorem qy_two_pow_bits_le (n : ℕ) : 2 ^ (Nat.bits n).length ≤ 2 * n + 1 := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · simp
  · rw [Nat.size_eq_bits_len]
    have hsz : Nat.size n = Nat.log 2 n + 1 := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · exact Nat.size_le.mpr (Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by norm_num) n)
      · by_contra h
        have hlt : n < 2 ^ Nat.log 2 n :=
          Nat.size_le.mp (by omega)
        exact absurd (Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 (by omega)) (not_le.mpr hlt)
    rw [hsz, pow_succ]
    have := Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 (show n ≠ 0 by omega)
    omega

/-- **`⌊log₂ n⌋` from `bits n`**: for `n ≥ 1`, `Nat.log 2 n + 1 = |bits n|`. -/
private theorem qy_log_bits {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : Nat.log 2 n + 1 = (Nat.bits n).length := by
  rw [Nat.size_eq_bits_len]
  apply le_antisymm
  · by_contra h
    have hlt : n < 2 ^ Nat.log 2 n := Nat.size_le.mp (by omega)
    exact absurd (Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 (by omega)) (not_le.mpr hlt)
  · exact Nat.size_le.mpr (Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by norm_num) n)

/-- **The install call's bound under `f a ≤ n`** (the timeout certificate's arithmetic): with
`a ≤ n` and `f a ≤ n`, the call's time bound `c' (c (f a + 1) + a + |bits (f a)| + 1)` is at most
`c' (c + 2) (n + 1)`. -/
private theorem qy_call_bound (f : ℕ → ℕ) (c c' a n : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ n) (hfa : f a ≤ n) :
    c' * (c * (f a + 1) + a + (Nat.bits (f a)).length + 1) ≤ c' * (c + 2) * (n + 1) := by
  have hb := Turing.length_bits_le_self (f a)
  have h1 : c * (f a + 1) ≤ c * (n + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (by omega)
  have h2 : c * (f a + 1) + a + (Nat.bits (f a)).length + 1 ≤ (c + 2) * (n + 1) := by nlinarith
  calc c' * (c * (f a + 1) + a + (Nat.bits (f a)).length + 1) ≤ c' * ((c + 2) * (n + 1)) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left c' h2
    _ = c' * (c + 2) * (n + 1) := by ring

/-- The ladder is at least `2 ^ (i + 1)`. -/
private theorem qy_two_pow_le_ladder (f : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ) : 2 ^ (i + 1) ≤ ladder f i := by
  induction i with
  | zero => rw [ladder_zero]; norm_num
  | succ i ih =>
    have := two_mul_lt_ladder_succ f i
    rw [pow_succ]
    omega

/-- **The stage index is below `log₂ n`**: for `n ≥ 3`, `stage f n < Nat.log 2 n`. -/
private theorem qy_stage_lt_log (f : ℕ → ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) : stage f n < Nat.log 2 n := by
  have hlo := (stage_spec f hn).1
  have hp := qy_two_pow_le_ladder f (stage f n)
  have : stage f n + 1 ≤ Nat.log 2 n := Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by norm_num) (by omega)
  omega

/-- **The timeout certificate.** If the install call's exit time `t` is within its published
bound `c' (c (f a + 1) + a + |bits (f a)| + 1)`, `a ≤ n`, and the clock's all-ones counter of
width `|bits n| + |bits (c' (c + 2))|` (value `2 ^ m - 1`) runs out before `t`, then `n < f a`. -/
private theorem qy_timeout_cert (f : ℕ → ℕ) (c c' a n t : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ n)
    (ht : t ≤ c' * (c * (f a + 1) + a + (Nat.bits (f a)).length + 1))
    (hlate : 2 ^ ((Nat.bits n).length + (Nat.bits (c' * (c + 2))).length) - 1 < t) :
    n < f a := by
  by_contra h
  have hfa : f a ≤ n := by omega
  have h1 := qy_call_bound f c c' a n ha hfa
  have h2 := qy_ones_ge n (c' * (c + 2))
  exact absurd (hlate.trans_le (ht.trans (h1.trans h2))) (lt_irrefl _)

/-- A configuration in the normal form used by the main machine: a live state `s`, the input
head `ip`, the work tapes `T`, the work heads `P` and the output `o`. -/
private def qyC {K : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (s : S) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (T : Fin K → ℤ → Option Bool) (P : Fin K → ℤ) (o : List Bool) : Cfg K Bool S x :=
  ⟨some s, ip, T, P, o⟩

/-- Renaming the state of a normal-form configuration renames its state only. -/
private theorem qyC_mapState {K : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {x : List Bool} (f : S → S') (s : S)
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (T : Fin K → ℤ → Option Bool) (P : Fin K → ℤ) (o : List Bool) :
    (qyC s ip T P o : Cfg K Bool S x).mapState f = qyC (f s) ip T P o := by
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_state]
    rfl
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos]
    rfl
  · funext j q
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes]
    rfl
  · funext j
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]
    rfl
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_output]
    rfl

/-- **A hosted phase is a segment.** If phase `k` of a phase host runs from a normal-form
configuration at `e` to one at the live exit `s'`, which the host redirects to `q'`, with no
redirect earlier, then the host runs, in one more step, from the tagged start to the redirected
endpoint, avoiding every set `F` of host states that contains no state the phase's run visits
up to its end. It is `Turing.phaseHostTM_run` with the tag of every intermediate state read
off.

**Proof sketch.** `Turing.phaseHostTM_run` gives the host's run as the tagged phase run up to `t`
and the redirected endpoint at `t + 1`. Before its end the phase is live
(`MultiTapeTM.runFrom_state_ne_none_of_le`), so each intermediate host state is `some ⟨k, s⟩` for a
state `s` the phase's run visits, which `hF` keeps out of `F`; `Turing.segment_iff` assembles the
segment. -/
private theorem qy_hosted' {K : ℕ} {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type}
    (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM K Bool (Ph i))
    (q0 : Σ i, Ph i) (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) (k : I) {x : List Bool}
    (e s' : Ph k) (q' : Σ i, Ph i) (ip ip' : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (T T' : Fin K → ℤ → Option Bool) (P P' : Fin K → ℤ) (o o' : List Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (h : (M k).runFrom (qyC e ip T P o) t = qyC s' ip' T' P' o')
    (hred : red k s' = some q')
    (hguard : ∀ u < t, ∀ s, ((M k).runFrom (qyC e ip T P o) u).state = some s → red k s = none)
    (F : Set (Option (Σ i, Ph i)))
    (hF : ∀ u ≤ t, ∀ s, ((M k).runFrom (qyC e ip T P o) u).state = some s → some ⟨k, s⟩ ∉ F) :
    Segment (phaseHostTM M q0 red) F (fun _ => True) (qyC ⟨k, e⟩ ip T P o)
      (qyC q' ip' T' P' o') (t + 1) := by
  have H := phaseHostTM_run M q0 red k (qyC e ip T P o) _ t h s' rfl q' hred hguard
  rw [qyC_mapState, qyC_mapState] at H
  refine (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨H.2, fun u hu => ?_, fun _ _ => trivial⟩
  have hlive : ((M k).runFrom (qyC e ip T P o) u).state ≠ none :=
    MultiTapeTM.runFrom_state_ne_none_of_le (M k) _ t (by rw [h]; exact Option.some_ne_none _)
      u (by omega)
  have hu' := H.1 u (by omega)
  rw [hu', Cfg.mapState_state]
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hlive
