```
        with output := if emit then cap else [] } := by
  have hs : (callTM M emit).tm.step
      (emCallBankFrame M emit x arg cap T M.k (.inr (.inl (Fin.last M.k, 0)))) =
      emCallBankFrame M emit x arg cap T M.k (.inr (.inr 0)) := by
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, emCallBankFrame, emCallFrame, callTM,
      Fin.val_last, lt_self_iff_false, ↓reduceDIte]
    rw [controlAction_apply, moveInputPos_zero]
  have he := MultiTapeTM.runFrom_mapState_of_agreeOn (embedEmitTM (emCallPairEmbedding M) (emCallFinishTM emit).tm)
    (callTM M emit).tm
    ⟨fun q => .inr (.inr q), by intro a b h; exact Sum.inr.inj (Sum.inr.inj h)⟩
    (fun _ => True) (by intros; rfl)
    (embedEmitCfg (emCallPairEmbedding M) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) []
      (emCallFinishCfg emit x 1 0 (bufferTape arg) (bufferTape cap) arg.length cap.length []))
    (arg.length + 3 * cap.length + 5) (by intros; trivial)
  rw [embedEmitTM_runFrom] at he
  change (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom (emCallEmbeddedCfg (emCallPairEmbedding M)
    (fun q => .inr (.inr q)) _ _ _) _ =
    emCallEmbeddedCfg (emCallPairEmbedding M) (fun q => .inr (.inr q)) _ _ _ at he
  erw [emCall_finish_initial M emit x arg cap T, emCall_finish_run, emCall_finish_final] at he
  rw [show arg.length + 3 * cap.length + 6 = (arg.length + 3 * cap.length + 5) + 1 by omega,
    MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, hs]
  exact he

/-- Both call modes reach the full clean seam within the audited linear
shape, with `K = 6` (so `6 + 13 M.k + 3K = 24 + 13 M.k`).
**Proof sketch.** Compose the complete prepared evaluation, all sequential
bank cleanups, and result finalization. The bank prefix induction accounts for
every source tape. Each term is charged to the actual argument deadline or a
word length; no native transition reads a numerical deadline. -/
private lemma emCall_complete (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesInTime arg cap T) :
    ∃ t ≤ (24 + 13 * M.k) * (T + arg.length + cap.length + 1),
      (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callTM M emit).tm.q₀ (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) t =
        { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (.inr (.inr (5 : Fin 6)) : emCallState M)
            (stateWord (callTM M emit).k (if emit then arg else cap))
          with output := if emit then cap else [] } := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, he⟩ := emCall_prepare_run M emit x arg cap T hM
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hf⟩ := emCall_banks_run M emit x arg cap T M.k (le_refl _)
  let B := T + arg.length + cap.length + 1
  have hbank : b ≤ (13 * M.k) * B := by
    calc
      b ≤ M.k * (6 * T + 8) := hb
      _ ≤ M.k * (13 * B) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left M.k (by dsimp [B]; omega)
      _ = (13 * M.k) * B := by simp [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_comm]
  have hrest : a + (arg.length + 3 * cap.length + 6) ≤ 24 * B := by
    dsimp [B]; omega
  refine ⟨a + b + (arg.length + 3 * cap.length + 6), ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      a + b + (arg.length + 3 * cap.length + 6) ≤ 24 * B + (13 * M.k) * B := by omega
      _ = (24 + 13 * M.k) * B := (Nat.add_mul _ _ _).symm
  · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add,
      (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom_add _ a b, he, hf]
    exact emCall_finalize_run M emit x arg cap T

/-- The fresh exit control is an absorbing silent state, on every tape
configuration, so cutting at first exit preserves the entire endpoint. -/
private lemma emCall_exit_fixed (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (z : Cfg (callTM M emit).k Bool (callTM M emit).State x)
    (hz : z.state = some (.inr (.inr (5 : Fin 6)))) :
    (callTM M emit).tm.step z = z := by
  let c : Cfg 2 Bool (Fin 6) x :=
    ⟨some 5, z.inputPos, (fun i => z.workTapes (emCallPairEmbedding M i)),
      (fun i => z.workTapePos (emCallPairEmbedding M i)), z.output⟩
  have hframe : emCallEmbeddedCfg (emCallPairEmbedding M)
      (fun q => .inr (.inr q) : Fin 6 → emCallState M) z.workTapes z.workTapePos c = z := by
    refine Cfg.ext hz.symm rfl ?_ ?_ rfl
    · funext j
      simp only [emCallEmbeddedCfg, Cfg.mapState]
      by_cases hj : j ∈ Set.range (emCallPairEmbedding M)
      · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hj
        rw [embedEmitCfg_selected_tape]
      · exact ((embedEmitTM_frame (emCallPairEmbedding M) (emCallFinishTM emit).tm
          z.workTapes z.workTapePos [] c 0).1 j hj).1
    · funext j
      simp only [emCallEmbeddedCfg, Cfg.mapState]
      by_cases hj : j ∈ Set.range (emCallPairEmbedding M)
      · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hj
        rw [embedEmitCfg_selected_pos]
      · exact ((embedEmitTM_frame (emCallPairEmbedding M) (emCallFinishTM emit).tm
          z.workTapes z.workTapePos [] c 0).1 j hj).2
  have hs : (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.runFrom c 1 = c := by
    change (controlAction 0 (some (5 : Fin 6))).apply c = c
    rw [controlAction_apply, moveInputPos_zero]
  have he := MultiTapeTM.runFrom_mapState_of_agreeOn (embedEmitTM (emCallPairEmbedding M) (emCallFinishTM emit).tm)
    (callTM M emit).tm
    ⟨fun q => .inr (.inr q), by intro a b h; exact Sum.inr.inj (Sum.inr.inj h)⟩
    (fun _ => True) (by intros; rfl)
    (embedEmitCfg (emCallPairEmbedding M) z.workTapes z.workTapePos [] c) 1
    (by intros; trivial)
  rw [embedEmitTM_runFrom, hs] at he
  change (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom (emCallEmbeddedCfg (emCallPairEmbedding M)
    (fun q => .inr (.inr q)) z.workTapes z.workTapePos c) 1 =
    emCallEmbeddedCfg (emCallPairEmbedding M) (fun q => .inr (.inr q))
      z.workTapes z.workTapePos c at he
  rw [hframe] at he
  exact he

/-- The complete clean call returns at its actual first positive exit.
**Proof sketch.** Cut the bounded complete run at the least exit visit.
Absorption preserves its full tape/head/output endpoint. The entry and exit
lie in disjoint finite-control summands, excluding time zero. -/
private lemma emCall_first (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesInTime arg cap T) :
    ∃ t ≤ (24 + 13 * M.k) * (T + arg.length + cap.length + 1),
      0 < t ∧
      (∀ j < t, ((callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callTM M emit).tm.q₀ (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) j).state
          ≠ some (.inr (.inr (5 : Fin 6)))) ∧
      (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callTM M emit).tm.q₀ (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) t =
        { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (.inr (.inr (5 : Fin 6)) : emCallState M)
            (stateWord (callTM M emit).k (if emit then arg else cap))
          with output := if emit then cap else [] } := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, he⟩ := emCall_complete M emit x arg cap T hM
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hfirst, hr⟩ := emCall_first_entry (callTM M emit).tm
    (fun q => q = (.inr (.inr (5 : Fin 6)) : emCallState M)) _ _ b
    (by rintro z ⟨q, hz, rfl⟩; exact emCall_exit_fixed M emit x z hz)
    ⟨_, rfl, rfl⟩ he
  have hpos : 0 < t := by
    by_contra hn
    have ht0 : t = 0 := by omega
    have hstate := congrArg Cfg.state hr
    simp [ht0, Cfg.ofWords, callTM] at hstate
  refine ⟨t, ht.trans hb, hpos, ?_, hr⟩
  intro j hj hs
  exact hfirst j hj ⟨_, hs, rfl⟩

/-! ### Forwarding loop controller -/

/-- The forwarding variant retains the fuel capture and every administrative
transition of the existing loop skeleton. Body actions go through
`Turing.emitAction`, with a stationary unused payload tape. -/
private abbrev emLoopHost (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (findMode : Bool) :
    FinTM Bool := loopHostM body F anchor true findMode

/-- **The emitting loop**. The forwarding instance of the shared loop controller in find mode: the
same fuel capture, counter and seam discipline as `loopHostTM`, with each body round's emissions
forwarded to the physical output instead of captured, and no exhaustion verdict, so that the machine
outputs the concatenation of the rounds' chunks. -/
abbrev emitLoopTM (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) : FinTM Bool :=
  emLoopHost body F anchor true

/-- A forwarding round appends its exact chunk, then performs the silent
fixed-width debit. Positive fuel reaches the next clean seam; underflow
halts with the chunk and no verdict bit.
**Proof sketch.** Forward the source round and its anchor-stop action. Its
entire data endpoint is the old clean-payload frame with the chunk in physical
output. Prefix commutation lifts the proved silent countdown to that output.
The underflow transition is charged inside this same final segment. -/
private lemma emLoopHost_round (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    {x : List Bool} (s next chunk word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hanchor : ∀ u, 0 < u → u < t →
      (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) u).state ≠ some anchor)
    (hend : body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
      { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k next) with output := chunk }) :
    ∃ v ≤ t + 2 * word.length + 5,
      if (loopDebit word).2 then
        (emLoopHost body F anchor true).tm.runFrom
          (loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel) v =
          {loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k next))
            true none (loopDebit word).1 fuel with output := chunk}
      else
        ((emLoopHost body F anchor true).tm.runFrom
          (loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel) v).state = none ∧
        ((emLoopHost body F anchor true).tm.runFrom
          (loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel) v).output = chunk := by
  let c := Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)
  let d := Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k next)
  have hguard : ∀ u < t, (u = 0 ∧ true = true) ∨ (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ some anchor := by
    intro u hu
    by_cases hz : u = 0
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hz, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr (hanchor u (by omega) hu)
  have hr := loopHost_anchor_return body F anchor true true false [] c true t word fuel
    (by rw [hend]; rfl) (by intro h; omega) hguard
  change (emLoopHost body F anchor true).tm.runFrom
      (emLoopCall body F anchor [] false c true none word fuel) (t + 1) =
    emLoopCall body F anchor [] false {body.tm.runFrom c t with state := none}
      false (some false) word fuel at hr
  rw [emLoopCall_empty body F anchor false c true none word fuel rfl, hend, emLoopCall_frame] at hr
  change (emLoopHost body F anchor true).tm.runFrom
      (loopCall body F anchor false c true none word fuel) (t + 1) =
      {loopCall body F anchor false {d with state := none} false (some false) word fuel
        with output := chunk} at hr
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hc⟩ := loopHost_reject body F anchor true true
    {d with state := none} word fuel rfl rfl
  let admin := loopCall body F anchor false {d with state := none} false (some false) word fuel
  have hp := MultiTapeTM.runFrom_output_prepend (emLoopHost body F anchor true).tm admin chunk v
  have hao : admin.output = [] := rfl
  rw [hao, List.append_nil] at hp
  refine ⟨(t + 1) + v, by omega, ?_⟩
  by_cases hb : (loopDebit word).2 = true
  · simp only [hb, if_true] at hc ⊢
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hr, hp]
    rw [hc]
    refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl rfl rfl ?_
    change chunk ++ [] = chunk
    exact List.append_nil _
  · simp only [hb, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hc ⊢
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hr, hp]
    have hco : ((emLoopHost body F anchor true).tm.runFrom admin v).output = [] := hc.2
    exact ⟨hc.1, by simp only [hco, List.append_nil]⟩

/-- Sum consecutive emitting segments from arbitrary accumulated output.
Each segment contributes its exact chunk, and the final segment halts.
**Proof sketch.** Induct on the number of rounds. Prefix commutation turns
the next clean-seam segment into a segment after the preceding chunks.
Concatenation follows the same order as the configuration indices. This is
a new summation lemma; the frozen empty-output `loop_run` is not used. -/
private lemma emLoop_sum {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x)
    (chunk : ℕ → List Bool) (B : ℕ) : ∀ N,
    (∀ i < N, (cfg i).output = []) →
    (∀ i < N, ∃ t ≤ B,
      if i + 1 < N then tm.runFrom (cfg i) t = {cfg (i + 1) with output := chunk i}
      else (tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).state = none ∧ (tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).output = chunk i) →
    0 < N → ∀ pre, ∃ t ≤ N * B,
      (tm.runFrom {cfg 0 with output := pre} t).state = none ∧
      (tm.runFrom {cfg 0 with output := pre} t).output =
        pre ++ (List.range N).flatMap chunk := by
  intro N
  induction N generalizing cfg chunk with
  | zero => intro _ _ h; omega
  | succ N ih =>
    intro hout hseg _ pre
    obtain ⟨a, ha, he⟩ := hseg 0 (by omega)
    have hp := MultiTapeTM.runFrom_output_prepend tm (cfg 0) pre a
    rw [hout 0 (by omega), List.append_nil] at hp
    cases N with
    | zero =>
      simp only [Nat.lt_irrefl, ↓reduceIte] at he
      refine ⟨a, by simpa using ha, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hp]; exact he.1
      · rw [hp]; simp [he.2]
    | succ N =>
      simp only [show 0 + 1 < (N + 1) + 1 by omega, ↓reduceIte] at he
      rw [he] at hp
      obtain ⟨b, hb, hh, ho⟩ := ih (fun i => cfg (i + 1)) (fun i => chunk (i + 1))
        (fun i hi => hout (i + 1) (by omega))
        (fun i hi => by
          obtain ⟨t, ht, h⟩ := hseg (i + 1) (by omega)
          exact ⟨t, ht, by simpa only [Nat.add_lt_add_iff_right] using h⟩)
        (by omega) (pre ++ chunk 0)
      refine ⟨a + b, by rw [Nat.succ_mul]; omega, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hp]
        exact hh
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hp, ho]
        rw [List.range_succ_eq_map (n := N + 1), List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_map]
        simp [List.append_assoc, Function.comp_def]

/-- **The emitting loop's time**. Under the hypotheses of `exists_emitLoopTM` (fuel, invariant,
startup, and rounds that advance to the stepped seam in positive time at most `T |x|` while emitting
exactly `emitF x s`), the emitting loop outputs the concatenation of
`emitF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))` over `i = 0, …, R |x|` within `10·(T n + 1)·(R n + 2)` steps.

**Proof sketch.** The body of today's `exists_emitLoopTM`, which fixes `c = 10`: the fuel
preparation and the body startup take at most `10·(T |x| + 1)` steps (`loopHost_prepare`,
`loopHost_start`); each round, its anchor stop and its debit take at most `10·(T |x| + 1)`
(`emLoopHost_round`); the prefix-summation lemma `emLoop_sum` concatenates the `R |x| + 1` chunks.
-/
theorem emitLoopTM_computes (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF emitF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        body.tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
            { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))
                with output := emitF x s }) :
    (emitLoopTM body F anchor).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => (List.range (R x.length + 1)).flatMap
        (fun i => emitF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))))
      (fun n => 10 * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2)) := by
  sorry

/-- **E1, the emitting loop** (design §11; customers:
the Cook-Levin clause-group emitter (4A), 3B-cont's streaming reduction
transducer, 4B's dual-reduction emitter). The emitting sibling of
`Turing.FinTM.exists_loopCfgTM`: the same anchored round discipline —
startup within the envelope and no earlier anchor visit; per-round
positive duration, anchor exclusion, and input-length-only budgets — but
each round, instead of staying silent and either accepting or advancing,
**advances and appends its exact chunk** `emitF x s` to the physical
output. The machine runs all `R + 1` rounds and computes the
concatenation of the chunks in order. There is no verdict bit and no
deciding variant: compose with the existing decision layer instead
(design §11 non-goals).

Each round's seam is stated from the canonical clean configuration; the
round equality itself bounds the chunk length by the round's duration
(output grows by at most one symbol per step), so no separate emission
bound is hypothesized.

**Construction sketch** (corrected per the emitter-infra round-1 audit,
finding 3: the unchanged find-mode host routes body actions through
`captureAction`, whose physical output is always `none`, so captured
chunks never reach the physical output — a one-state self-emitting body
refutes the literal reuse). Build a **forwarding host variant**: the
same skeleton with the body dispatched through `Turing.emitAction`
(chunks land on the physical output), the fuel capture and silent
countdown machinery reused as they stand. Its contracts are proved over
configurations with arbitrary accumulated output (runs commute with
output prefixes — the transition table never reads the output tape),
and the concatenation is threaded through a **new** prefix-summation
lemma modeled on `loop_run`; the frozen empty-output `loop_run` itself
is not reusable for this.

**Batch L completion.** The forwarding host is `emLoopHost`; its body branch
uses `Turing.emitAction`, while fuel capture and the silent debit keep their
original behavior. `Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_output_prepend` proves arbitrary-prefix commutation;
`emLoopHost_round` charges the complete round, anchor stop, debit, and final
underflow. The new `emLoop_sum` concatenates exactly rounds `0..R` (including
one round at zero fuel), without using or changing the empty-output summation
lemma. Silent startup plus these `R + 1` segments satisfies the coefficient
`10` in the audited envelope. Every supporting dependency is proved. -/
theorem exists_emitLoopTM (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF emitF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        body.tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
            { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))
                with output := emitF x s }) :
    ∃ (E : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      E.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun x => (List.range (R x.length + 1)).flatMap
          (fun i => emitF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))))
        (fun n => c * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2)) := by
  let E := emLoopHost body F anchor true
  refine ⟨E, 10, fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨fuel, ftime, hfh, hfo, hft, hprepare⟩ :=
    loopHost_prepare body F anchor true true R T hF x
  obtain ⟨btime, hbt, hbguard, hbend⟩ := hstart x
  let words (i : ℕ) := (fun w => (loopDebit w).1)^[i] (Nat.bits (R x.length))
  let orbit (i : ℕ) := (stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)
  let candidate (i : ℕ) := loopCall body F anchor false
    (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k (orbit i))) true none (words i) fuel
  have hwidth (i : ℕ) : (words i).length ≤ T x.length := by
    dsimp only [words]
    rw [loopDebit_iterate_length]
    exact loop_fuel_width F R T hF x
  have hsuccess (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ R x.length) :
      (loopDebit (words i)).2 = true ↔ i < R x.length := by
    rw [loopDebit_success]
    dsimp only [words]
    rw [loopDebit_iterate_value _ _ hi]
    omega
  have hsegments : ∀ i < R x.length + 1, ∃ t ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1),
      if i + 1 < R x.length + 1 then
        E.tm.runFrom (candidate i) t = {candidate (i + 1) with output := emitF x (orbit i)}
      else
        (E.tm.runFrom (candidate i) t).state = none ∧
        (E.tm.runFrom (candidate i) t).output = emitF x (orbit i) := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨t, htpos, ht, hguard, hend⟩ := hround x (orbit i)
      (loop_orbit_inv Inv stepF s0 hInv0 hInvStep x i)
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hsegment⟩ := emLoopHost_round body F anchor
      (orbit i) (stepF x (orbit i)) (emitF x (orbit i)) (words i) fuel t htpos hguard hend
    refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hw := hwidth i
      omega
    · simpa only [E, candidate, words, orbit, Function.iterate_succ_apply',
        hsuccess i (by omega), Nat.add_lt_add_iff_right] using hsegment
  let startup := ftime + (btime + 2)
  have hs : startup ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1) := by dsimp only [startup]; omega
  have hinit : E.tm.runFrom (E.tm.initCfg x) startup = candidate 0 := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hprepare,
      loopHost_start body F anchor true true (s0 x) btime fuel hbguard hbend]
    simp only [candidate, words, orbit, Function.iterate_zero_apply, hfo]
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hhalt, houtput⟩ := emLoop_sum E.tm candidate
    (fun i => emitF x (orbit i)) (10 * (T x.length + 1)) (R x.length + 1)
    (fun _ _ => rfl) hsegments (by omega) []
  have hclean : {candidate 0 with output := []} = candidate 0 := rfl
  rw [hclean] at hhalt houtput
  have hrun := E.tm.runFrom_add (E.tm.initCfg x) startup t
  rw [hinit] at hrun
  have hcompute : E.ComputesInTime x
      ((List.range (R x.length + 1)).flatMap (fun i => emitF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))))
      (startup + t) := by
    refine ⟨_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
    · rw [hrun]; exact hhalt
    · rw [hrun]; simpa only [List.nil_append, orbit] using houtput
  apply hcompute.mono
  calc startup + t ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1) +
        (R x.length + 1) * (10 * (T x.length + 1)) := Nat.add_le_add hs ht
    _ = 10 * (T x.length + 1) * (R x.length + 2) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_comm (R x.length + 1)]
      simp only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one, Nat.mul_two]
      omega

/-- **The clean call's run**. If `M` halts on `arg` with output `cap` within `T` steps, then from
the entry seam holding `arg`, over any native input `x`, the clean call first enters its exit state
at a positive time `t ≤ (24 + 13·k_M)·(T + |arg| + |cap| + 1)`, and does not visit it at any earlier
time, including time `0`; at `t` it is at the exit seam holding `cap` with empty output (install
mode), or holding `arg` with output `cap` (emit mode).

**Proof sketch.** `emCall_first` itself: `callEntry` and `callExit` unfold to the states that it
names. Its proof is the completion lemma `emCall_complete` (evaluation through tracked banks,
bank clearing, install or replay, capture erasure and rewinds, within the ledger's coefficient
`6 + 13·k_M + 3·6`) followed by the first-visit cut at the fresh absorbing exit. -/
theorem callTM_run (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesInTime arg cap T) :
    ∃ t ≤ (24 + 13 * M.k) * (T + arg.length + cap.length + 1),
      0 < t ∧
      (∀ j < t, ((callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callEntry M emit) (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) j).state
          ≠ some (callExit M emit)) ∧
      (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callEntry M emit) (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) t =
        { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callExit M emit)
            (stateWord (callTM M emit).k (if emit then arg else cap))
          with output := if emit then cap else [] } :=
  emCall_first M emit x arg cap T hM

/-- **E5a, the install-mode clean call** (spec, added at the emitter-infra
round-1 repair — finding 1's prepared-input/clean-return bridge;
customers: loop and emit-loop bodies calling a catalog transducer on
their tape-resident data, in particular `computesFunInTime_splitSolveWith`'s
evaluator rounds and 3B-cont's token/counter installs). A function-level
contract says nothing about a witness's terminal heads or scratch — a
machine may dirty a tape on its final transition and still compute `f`
within `T` — so the bridge supplies what the function contract cannot:
for any such witness, a **callable module** with designated entry and
exit states whose entry and exit are both the canonical clean seam. From
`Cfg.ofWords entry (stateWord C.k arg)` — the argument as the sole
tape-resident word, every other tape blank, input head at one, empty
output, over an **arbitrary, untouched** native input — the module
reaches, at its first positive visit to `exit`, exactly
`Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (f arg))`: the result installed, all
scratch restored, nothing emitted.

**Construction sketch** (attribution corrected per the emitter-infra
round-3 audit, finding 1). Prepare a virtual input from the
tape-resident argument (the relocated-read discipline of the proved
hosts); run the witness through the capture wrapper over **tracked
banks** — the A-continuation's proved visited-interval/origin-marker
family (`e3cTrackTM`/`e3c_track_run`, `e3cClearTM`/`e3c_clear_run`) —
then sequence the per-triple cleaner over the fixed `M.k` banks: at a
clean entry seam the module's scratch starts blank, so clearing the
tracked interval **is** the restoration, and no overwritten-symbol
history is needed; install the captured result on tape zero (or replay
it, in emit mode); erase the capture; rewind. The history/undo
alternative remains valid independently (round-2 audit, finding 4),
but is not what the delivered continuation proves. Every phase is
charged to `T`, the argument length, or the result length.

The `0 < C.k` clause is load-bearing (emitter-infra round-2 audit,
finding 1): at tape count zero, `stateWord 0 a = stateWord 0 b` for all
`a, b` — the empty-domain degeneracy — and a two-state zero-tape machine
would satisfy the rest of this conclusion for an arbitrary, even
noncomputable, `f`. The positive tape count makes the seam equality
yield `bufferTape (f arg)` at the genuine index zero, so the installed
result is actually extractable by the caller.

**Batch L completion.** `callTM M false` reserves a genuine argument tape,
executes the prepared input through tracked banks, and sequences every
triple cleaner after the observed evaluator return. Since scratch starts
blank, clearing the visited intervals restores the complete clean seam.
`emCall_complete` charges evaluation, bank dispatch/cleanup, result install,
capture erasure, and rewinds within coefficient `24 + 13 * M.k` (the ledger's
`6 + 13 * M.k + 3 * K` with `K = 6`). `emCall_first` cuts at the first visit
to a fresh absorbing exit; no time bound occurs in the transition table. -/
theorem exists_installCallTM (M : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool)
    (T : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (c : ℕ), 0 < C.k ∧
      ∀ (x arg : List Bool),
        ∃ t ≤ c * (T arg.length + arg.length + (f arg).length + 1),
          0 < t ∧
          (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
            (C.tm.runFrom
              (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) t').state
                ≠ some exit) ∧
          C.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (f arg)) := by
  refine ⟨callTM M false, (callTM M false).tm.q₀, .inr (.inr 5),
    24 + 13 * M.k, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Nat.zero_lt_succ _
  · intro x arg
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hpos, hfirst, hr⟩ := emCall_first M false x arg (f arg) (T arg.length) (hM arg)
    refine ⟨t, ht, hpos, fun j _ hj => hfirst j hj, ?_⟩
    simpa using hr

/-- **E5b, the emit-mode clean call** (spec, added at the emitter-infra
round-1 repair — the forwarding half of finding 1's bridge; customers:
`exists_emitLoopTM` bodies emitting per-round chunks computed by a
catalog transducer — 3B-cont's clause fragments, 4A's clause groups).
Identical seam discipline to the install call, but the computed word is
**forwarded to the physical output** and the tape-resident argument is
preserved: from `Cfg.ofWords entry (stateWord C.k arg)`, the module
reaches, at its first positive visit to `exit`, exactly the entry seam
with `exit` control and output `f arg` — argument intact, scratch
restored, the chunk emitted.

**Construction sketch.** As the install call, with the captured result
replayed through `Turing.emitAction`-style forwarding and then erased,
instead of installed; the argument word is never consumed. The
`0 < C.k` clause mirrors the install call's (round-2 finding 1): the
physical output prevents the zero-tape degeneracy for nonconstant `f`,
but the preserved tape-resident argument is a promise of this
interface too, and it needs a genuine tape to live on.

**Batch L completion.** `callTM M true` uses the same tracked evaluation
and observed-completion cleanup as install mode. Its finishing pass preserves
the argument, replays the captured result onto physical output, erases the
capture, and restores every head. `emCall_complete` proves the full endpoint
and the same coefficient `24 + 13 * M.k`; `emCall_first` proves the first
positive exit condition, including empty arguments and empty results. -/
theorem exists_emitCallTM (M : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool)
    (T : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (c : ℕ), 0 < C.k ∧
      ∀ (x arg : List Bool),
        ∃ t ≤ c * (T arg.length + arg.length + (f arg).length + 1),
          0 < t ∧
          (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
            (C.tm.runFrom
              (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) t').state
                ≠ some exit) ∧
          C.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) t =
              { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) exit (stateWord C.k arg)
                  with output := f arg } := by
  refine ⟨callTM M true, (callTM M true).tm.q₀, .inr (.inr 5),
    24 + 13 * M.k, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Nat.zero_lt_succ _
  · intro x arg
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hpos, hfirst, hr⟩ := emCall_first M true x arg (f arg) (T arg.length) (hM arg)
    refine ⟨t, ht, hpos, fun j _ hj => hfirst j hj, ?_⟩
    simpa using hr

end Turing.FinTM
```

```
/-

Authors: Seyoon Ragavan

import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.CounterLoop
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Seam

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Machine-construction library: modules on the native input (§12.8)

The two native-input modules of the §12.8 rich-alphabet design
(`machine-library-design.md` §12.8a §3): a call of a function-level machine
on the native input at a clean seam (R8.5e), and a seek of the input head to a
position held in binary on a work tape (R8.5b). Both are `Bool` modules; a
rich host runs them lifted along its digit embedding
(`Turing.MultiTapeTM.liftSymbols`), with unchanged time and space.

**Status: §12.8 fill C (status update; refreshed at the A–C fill gate, minor 4).** The
input seek is proved with its restoration, first-exit and workspace clauses. The clean input
call is proved; it cites stream B's `Turing.inputCopyTM_run_ofCfg`, now proved, and its
interface remains time-only.

## Main results

* `Turing.FinTM.exists_inputCallTM` — compute `f` on the native input from a
  blank seam and install the result on tape `0` (proved; the copier
  `inputCopyTM_run_ofCfg` is a proved dependency; status refreshed at the A–C fill gate).
* `Turing.exists_inputSeekTM` — move the input head to the binary value on a
  counter tape, restoring every work tape (proved; fill-C status update).

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§1.2: the read-only input tape, whose
  head a work-tape counter can position; the space-bounded simulations of
  §4.1 locate the input head of a simulated configuration this way.)
-/

namespace Turing.FinTM

/-- On a blank seam, the public native copier installs exactly the argument seam.
It cites stream B's framed input-copy contract, which is proved. -/
private theorem inputCall_copy (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (x : List Bool) :
    (inputCopyTM k ⟨0, hk⟩).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep (fun _ => []))
        (2 * x.length + 2) = Cfg.ofWords SweepPhase.done (stateWord k x) := by
  rw [(inputCopyTM_run_ofCfg ⟨0, hk⟩ _ rfl rfl).1]
  apply Cfg.ext <;> try rfl
  funext j z
  simp only [Cfg.ofWords, stateWord]
  by_cases hj : j = ⟨0, hk⟩
  · subst j
    simp only [true_and, zero_add, sub_zero, bufferTape_nil, if_true]
    unfold bufferTape
    by_cases hzero : 0 ≤ z <;> by_cases hlen : z < (x.length : ℤ) <;> simp [hzero, hlen]
  · have hjval : (j : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun hz => hj (Fin.ext hz)
    simp [hj, hjval]

/-- **R8.5e, the clean call on the native input** (design §12.8a §3). For any
witness `M` computing `f` within `T`, there is a callable module with entry and
exit states and a positive tape count with the following contract. From the
blank seam `Cfg.ofWords entry` (every tape empty, input head at `1`, empty
output) over the native input `x`, the module reaches, at its first positive
visit to `exit`, exactly the seam with `f x` installed on tape `0`, within
`c·(T |x| + |x| + |f x| + 1)` steps. It is the function-level contract run at a
seam that the next phase of a host can consume.

**Proof sketch.** Seam-compose (`Turing.seamCompTM_run_ofCfg`) the input
copier on tape `0` (`Turing.inputCopyTM_run_ofCfg`, `2|x| + 2` steps, which
from the blank seam yields `Cfg.ofWords` with `x` on tape `0`) with the install
call of `Turing.FinTM.exists_installCallTM` on the argument `x`, whose
coefficient absorbs the copy and the dispatch step. The first-return clause is
`Turing.seamCompTM_firstReturn_ofCfg`, which also needs the callee's exit
excluded at time `0`; the install call's contract excludes it only at positive
times. So split on whether its entry equals its exit. If it does, first wrap it
by `Turing.seamReleaseTM`, whose `Turing.seamReleaseTM_firstReturn` supplies a
fresh entry. The positive tape count is the install call's. -/
theorem exists_inputCallTM (M : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool)
    (T : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (c : ℕ), 0 < C.k ∧
      ∀ x : List Bool,
        ∃ t ≤ c * (T x.length + x.length + (f x).length + 1),
          0 < t ∧
          (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
            (C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])) t').state ≠
              some exit) ∧
          C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])) t =
            Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (f x)) := by
  obtain ⟨C₀, en₀, ex₀, b, hk₀, hC₀⟩ := exists_installCallTM M f T hM
  -- Supply the time-zero cut once, then use the same copier and seam in both cases.
  have hcallee : ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (en ex : C.State), 0 < C.k ∧
      ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ b * (T x.length + x.length + (f x).length + 1),
        0 < t ∧
        (∀ u < t, (C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) en (stateWord C.k x)) u).state ≠
          some ex) ∧
        C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) en (stateWord C.k x)) t =
          Cfg.ofWords ex (stateWord C.k (f x)) := by
    by_cases he : en₀ = ex₀
    · subst ex₀
      let C : FinTM Bool := ⟨C₀.k, Unit ⊕ C₀.State, seamReleaseTM C₀.tm en₀⟩
      refine ⟨C, Sum.inl (), Sum.inr en₀, hk₀, ?_⟩
      intro x
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hpos, hfirst, hrun⟩ := hC₀ x x
      have hr := seamReleaseTM_firstReturn C₀.tm en₀ rfl hpos hrun rfl hfirst
      exact ⟨t, ht, hpos, hr.2, hr.1⟩
    · refine ⟨C₀, en₀, ex₀, hk₀, ?_⟩
      intro x
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hpos, hfirst, hrun⟩ := hC₀ x x
      refine ⟨t, ht, hpos, ?_, hrun⟩
      intro u hu
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos u with rfl | hupos
      · simpa [Cfg.ofWords] using he
      · exact hfirst u hupos hu
  obtain ⟨C, en, ex, hk, hC⟩ := hcallee
  let D : FinTM Bool := ⟨C.k, SweepPhase ⊕ C.State,
    seamCompTM (inputCopyTM C.k ⟨0, hk⟩) .done C.tm en⟩
  refine ⟨D, Sum.inl .sweep, Sum.inr ex, b + 3, hk, ?_⟩
  intro x
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hpos, hfirst, hrun⟩ := hC x
  have hcopy := inputCall_copy C.k hk x
  have hcut := (inputCopyTM_run_ofCfg (x := x) ⟨0, hk⟩
    (Cfg.ofWords SweepPhase.sweep (fun _ => [])) rfl rfl).2.1
  have hall := seamCompTM_run_ofCfg (inputCopyTM C.k ⟨0, hk⟩) .done C.tm en
    hcopy rfl hcut hrun
  have hfirst' := seamCompTM_firstReturn_ofCfg (inputCopyTM C.k ⟨0, hk⟩) .done C.tm en ex
    hcopy rfl hcut hrun rfl hfirst
  refine ⟨2 * x.length + 2 + 1 + t, ?_, by omega, (fun u _ hu => hfirst' u hu), hall⟩
  rw [Nat.add_mul]
  omega

end Turing.FinTM

namespace Turing

/-- The seek's rewind needs one additional left move after the public rewind returns at `1`:
there is no public native-input-head primitive with that exit convention. -/
private inductive InputSeekRw where
  | start | scan | left | done
deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- The four-state input rewind; no public native-input-head primitive finishes at marker `0`.
The public `FinTM.rewind_heads` supplies its scan and all prefix work-head bounds. -/
private def inputSeekRewind : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool InputSeekRw where
  q₀ := .start
  tr := fun q inp _ => match q with
    | .start => FinTM.controlAction .neg (some .scan)
    | .scan => match inp with
      | some _ => FinTM.controlAction .neg (some .scan)
      | none => FinTM.controlAction .pos (some .left)
    | .left => FinTM.controlAction .neg (some .done)
    | .done => FinTM.controlAction 0 (some .done)

/-- Rewind to the left marker, keeping all work heads fixed and excluding an earlier exit.

**Proof sketch.** Invoke the public rewind with exit `left`, then move left once. Since
`done` is stationary, reaching it before the public rewind's `left` endpoint is impossible. -/
private theorem inputSeekRewind_run {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg 2 Bool InputSeekRw x)
    (hd : d.state = some .start) :
    ∃ r ≤ d.inputPos.val + 3,
      inputSeekRewind.runFrom d r = { d with state := some .done, inputPos := 0 } ∧
      (∀ u < r, (inputSeekRewind.runFrom d u).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      ∀ u ≤ r, (inputSeekRewind.runFrom d u).workTapePos = d.workTapePos := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrun, hheads⟩ := FinTM.rewind_heads inputSeekRewind .start .scan
    (some .left) (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun inp _ => by cases inp <;> rfl) d hd
  have hcut (u : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ r) : (inputSeekRewind.runFrom d u).state ≠ some .done := by
    intro hdone
    have hfix : inputSeekRewind.step (inputSeekRewind.runFrom d u) =
        inputSeekRewind.runFrom d u := by
      rw [step_of_inputMoveAction _ _ 0 hdone rfl]
      apply Cfg.ext
      · exact hdone.symm
      · simp
      · rfl
      · rfl
      · rfl
    have hsame : inputSeekRewind.runFrom d r = inputSeekRewind.runFrom d u := by
      rw [show r = u + (r - u) by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add]
      exact Function.iterate_fixed hfix _
    have := congrArg Cfg.state hsame
    simp [hrun, hdone] at this
  have hend : inputSeekRewind.runFrom d (r + 1) =
      { d with state := some .done, inputPos := 0 } := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', hrun]
    change (FinTM.controlAction SignType.neg (some InputSeekRw.done)).apply
      ({ d with state := some .left, inputPos := 1 } : Cfg 2 Bool InputSeekRw x) = _
    rw [FinTM.controlAction_apply]
    apply Cfg.ext rfl _ rfl rfl rfl
    apply Fin.ext
    rw [FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val]
  refine ⟨r + 1, by omega, hend, (fun u hu => hcut u (by omega)), ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  by_cases hur : u ≤ r
  · exact hheads u hur
  · have : u = r + 1 := by omega
    subst u
    rw [hend]

/-- A seek round moves the input right once; there is no public native-input-head primitive
for the counter host's cyclic one-step body. -/
private def inputSeekStep : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool Unit where
  q₀ := ()
  tr := fun _ _ _ => inputMoveAction 1 ()

/-- The input-only seek body preserves the entire work bank and output at every prefix.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on the number of right moves, using the public input-action step. -/
private theorem inputSeekStep_run {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg 1 Bool Unit x)
    (hc : c.state = some ()) (r : ℕ) :
    inputSeekStep.runFrom c r =
      { c with inputPos := (fun p : Fin (x.length + 2) => moveInputPos p 1)^[r] c.inputPos } := by
  induction r with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih]
    rw [step_of_inputMoveAction inputSeekStep
      ({ c with inputPos := (fun p : Fin (x.length + 2) => moveInputPos p 1)^[r] c.inputPos })
      1 hc rfl, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    simp only [hc]

/-- Before the right boundary is reached, repeated native right moves add their count. -/
private theorem inputSeek_right_value {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 2)) (r : ℕ)
    (hr : p.val + r ≤ n + 1) :
    ((fun q : Fin (n + 2) => moveInputPos q 1)^[r] p).val = p.val + r := by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp
  | succ r ih =>
    have ih' := ih (by omega)
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    change (moveInputPos _ SignType.pos).val = _
    rw [moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by omega)]
    simp only
    omega

/-- Copy, marker rewind, binary countdown, and cleanup, joined by three public seams. -/
private def inputSeekMachine : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool
    (((SweepPhase ⊕ InputSeekRw) ⊕ CounterLoopState Unit) ⊕ SweepPhase) :=
  seamCompTM
    (seamCompTM (seamCompTM (copyTM 2 0 1) .done inputSeekRewind .start)
      (Sum.inr .done) (counterLoopTM inputSeekStep () none) (.dec .run))
    (Sum.inr .done) (clearTM 2 1) .sweep

/-- The public seam visited-set inclusion transfers a common interval bound through dispatch.
This is used at all three seams of the seek, with intervals measured at its original heads. -/
private theorem inputSeek_seam_range {S₁ S₂ : Type} [DecidableEq S₁] {x : List Bool}
    (M₁ : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S₁) (ex : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S₂) (en : S₂)
    {c₀ c₁ : Cfg 2 Bool S₁ x} {t₁ t₂ : ℕ}
    (h₁ : M₁.runFrom c₀ t₁ = c₁) (hex : c₁.state = some ex)
    (hcut : ∀ u < t₁, (M₁.runFrom c₀ u).state ≠ some ex)
    (lo hi : Fin 2 → ℤ)
    (hleft : ∀ u ≤ t₁, ∀ j, (M₁.runFrom c₀ u).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (lo j) (hi j))
    (hright : ∀ u ≤ t₂, ∀ j,
      (M₂.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => en) u).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (lo j) (hi j)) :
    ∀ u ≤ t₁ + 1 + t₂, ∀ j,
      ((seamCompTM M₁ ex M₂ en).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl) u).workTapePos j ∈
        Finset.Icc (lo j) (hi j) := by
  intro u hu j
  have hv := seamCompTM_visitedByTapeHead_ofCfg M₁ ex M₂ en (T₂ := t₂) h₁ hex hcut j
    (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨u, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), rfl⟩)
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hv with hv | hv
  · obtain ⟨v, hv, heq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
    rw [← heq]
    exact hleft v (by simpa only [Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hv) j
  · obtain ⟨v, hv, heq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
    rw [← heq]
    exact hright v (by simpa only [Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hv) j

/-- **R8.5b, the input seek** (design §12.8a §3). There is a two-tape `Bool`
module with entry and exit states with the following contract. Let tape `0`
hold, from its head, a delimited word `w` whose little-endian value `p` is a
valid input position, at most `|x| + 1`, and let tape `1` be blank. From the
entry, with the input head anywhere, the module reaches `exit` with the input
head at `p` within `C·(|w| + pos + p + 1)` steps, where `pos` is the starting
input position, and not earlier. Every work tape, every work head and the
output are restored. Up to the exit every work head stays within
`C·(|w| + 1)` cells of its entry position. So the module's work space is
`O(|w| + 1)`, however far the input head travels, and repeated calls compose.
A rich host runs it lifted on two dedicated digit tapes.

**Proof sketch.** Copy `w` to the scratch tape (`Turing.copyTM_run_ofCfg`,
`2|w| + 2`). Rewind the input head: `timed_rewind` returns it to position `1`
within `pos + 2` steps, and one further left move reaches the left end marker
`0`. Run `Turing.counterLoopTM` with the scratch copy as the
counter and the one-step round "input head right", `p` rounds
(`Turing.counterLoopTM_run_done`, `p + counterOverhead w (p + 1)`, at most
`5p + 2|w| + 2` by `Turing.counterOverhead_le`). The counter ends all `true`
with its head back; `Turing.clearTM_run_ofCfg` blanks it. The phases join by
R2 seams, whose dispatch steps add a constant. The work heads move only in the
copy, the counter loop and the clear, whose trajectory clauses keep each one
within `[pos - 1, pos + |w|]` of its tape. -/
theorem exists_inputSeekTM :
    ∃ (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S) (R : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S) (entry exit : S)
      (C : ℕ),
      ∀ {x : List Bool} (p : ℕ) (w : List Bool), Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) = p →
        p ≤ x.length + 1 → ∀ d : Cfg 2 Bool S x, d.state = some entry →
        (∀ q : ℤ, -1 ≤ q → q ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
          d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + q) = FinTM.bufferTape w q) →
        (∀ q, d.workTapes 1 q = none) →
        ∃ t ≤ C * (w.length + d.inputPos.val + p + 1),
          (∀ u < t, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
          (∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j : Fin 2,
            |(R.runFrom d u).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤ ((C * (w.length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧
          (R.runFrom d t).state = some exit ∧ ((R.runFrom d t).inputPos : ℕ) = p ∧
          (R.runFrom d t).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ (R.runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos ∧
          (R.runFrom d t).output = d.output := by
  refine ⟨_, inferInstance, inferInstance, inputSeekMachine,
    Sum.inl (Sum.inl (Sum.inl .sweep)), Sum.inr .done, 13, ?_⟩
  intro x p w hp hpx d hd hw hblank
  let d₀ : Cfg 2 Bool SweepPhase x :=
    ⟨some .sweep, d.inputPos, d.workTapes, d.workTapePos, d.output⟩
  let d₁ : Cfg 2 Bool SweepPhase x :=
    { d₀ with
      state := some .done
      workTapes := fun j z => if j = 1 then FinTM.bufferTape w (z - d.workTapePos 1)
        else d.workTapes j z }
  have hcopy₀ := copyTM_run_ofCfg 0 1 (by decide) w d₀ rfl hw
  have hcopy : (copyTM 2 0 1).runFrom d₀ (2 * w.length + 2) = d₁ := by
    rw [hcopy₀.1]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> try rfl
    funext j z
    by_cases hj : j = 1
    · subst j
      simp only [d₀, d₁, true_and, if_true]
      by_cases hz : d.workTapePos 1 ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos 1 + (w.length : ℤ)
      · simp [hz]
      · rw [if_neg hz, hblank]
        unfold FinTM.bufferTape
        split_ifs with hz₀
        · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)]
        · rfl
    · simp [d₀, d₁, hj]
  let rw₀ := d₁.mapState (fun _ => InputSeekRw.start)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrewind, hrCut, hrHeads⟩ := inputSeekRewind_run rw₀ rfl
  let rw₁ : Cfg 2 Bool InputSeekRw x := { rw₀ with state := some .done, inputPos := 0 }
  let c : Cfg 1 Bool Unit x :=
    ⟨some (), 0, fun _ => d.workTapes 0, fun _ => d.workTapePos 0, d.output⟩
  let ct := fun z => FinTM.bufferTape w (z - d.workTapePos 1)
  have hct : ∀ z : ℤ, -1 ≤ z → z ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      ct (d.workTapePos 1 + z) = FinTM.bufferTape w z := by
    intro z _ _
    simp [ct]
  have hstart : rw₁.mapState (fun _ => CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run) =
      counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) c ct (d.workTapePos 1) := by
    rw [counter_cfg_eq]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> try rfl
    · funext j
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j
      · simp only [Fin.lastCases_last]
        rfl
      · simp only [Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
        have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        subst i
        rfl
    · funext j
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j
      · simp only [Fin.lastCases_last]
        rfl
      · simp only [Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
        have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        subst i
        rfl
  have horbit (a : ℕ) : counterLoopOrbit inputSeekStep (fun _ => 1) c a =
      inputSeekStep.runFrom c a := rfl
  have hstate (a : ℕ) : (counterLoopOrbit inputSeekStep (fun _ => 1) c a).state = some () := by
    rw [horbit, inputSeekStep_run c rfl]
  have hround : ∀ a < p,
      (counterLoopOrbit inputSeekStep (fun _ => 1) c a).state = some () ∧
      0 < (1 : ℕ) ∧
      (∀ u, 0 < u → u < (1 : ℕ) →
        ∃ q, (inputSeekStep.runFrom (counterLoopOrbit inputSeekStep (fun _ => 1) c a) u).state =
          some q ∧ q ≠ () ∧ (none : Option Unit) ≠ some q) ∧
      (counterLoopOrbit inputSeekStep (fun _ => 1) c (a + 1)).state = some () := by
    intro a _
    exact ⟨hstate a, Nat.one_pos, fun u hu hu' => by omega, hstate (a + 1)⟩
  let l := p + counterOverhead w (p + 1)
  have hloop₀ := counterLoopTM_run_done inputSeekStep () none (fun _ => 1) c w ct
    (d.workTapePos 1) hct p hp hround l (by simp [l])
  let lc : Cfg 2 Bool (CounterLoopState Unit) x :=
    ⟨some .done, ⟨p, by omega⟩,
      (fun j z => if j = 1 then
        FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate w.length true) (z - d.workTapePos 1)
        else d.workTapes j z), d.workTapePos, d.output⟩
  have hloop : (counterLoopTM inputSeekStep () none).runFrom
      (rw₁.mapState fun _ => .dec .run) l = lc := by
    rw [hstart, hloop₀.1, counter_cfg_eq, horbit, inputSeekStep_run c rfl]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> try rfl
    · apply Fin.ext
      simpa [c, lc] using inputSeek_right_value (0 : Fin (x.length + 2)) p (by simpa using hpx)
    · funext j z
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j
      · simp only [Fin.lastCases_last]
        change (if d.workTapePos 1 ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos 1 + (w.length : ℤ)
          then some true else ct z) =
            FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate w.length true) (z - d.workTapePos 1)
        by_cases hz : d.workTapePos 1 ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos 1 + (w.length : ℤ)
        · simp [hz, FinTM.bufferTape,
            show (z - d.workTapePos 1).toNat < w.length by omega]
        · rw [if_neg hz]
          unfold ct FinTM.bufferTape
          split_ifs with hzero
          · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega), List.getElem?_eq_none (by simp; omega)]
          · rfl
      · simp only [Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
        have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        subst i
        rfl
    · funext j
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j
      · simp only [Fin.lastCases_last]
        rfl
      · simp only [Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
        have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        subst i
        rfl
  have hlCut : ∀ u < l,
      ((counterLoopTM inputSeekStep () none).runFrom (rw₁.mapState fun _ => .dec .run) u).state ≠
        some .done := by
    rw [hstart]
    exact fun u hu => (hloop₀.2.1 u hu).1
  have hclear₀ := clearTM_run_ofCfg 1 (List.replicate w.length true)
    (lc.mapState fun _ => SweepPhase.sweep) rfl (by
      intro z _ _
      simp [lc, Cfg.mapState])
  let finish : Cfg 2 Bool SweepPhase x :=
    ⟨some .done, ⟨p, by omega⟩, d.workTapes, d.workTapePos, d.output⟩
  have hclear : (clearTM 2 1).runFrom (lc.mapState fun _ => .sweep)
      (2 * w.length + 2) = finish := by
    simpa only [List.length_replicate] using hclear₀.1.trans (by
      apply Cfg.ext <;> try rfl
      funext j z
      by_cases hj : j = 1
      · subst j
        simp only [lc, finish, Cfg.mapState, Option.map_some, List.length_replicate,
          true_and, if_true]
        rw [hblank]
        split_ifs with hz
        · rfl
        · unfold FinTM.bufferTape
          split_ifs with hzero
          · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by simp; omega)]
          · rfl
      · simp [lc, finish, Cfg.mapState, hj])
  have hcCut : ∀ u < 2 * w.length + 2,
      ((clearTM 2 1).runFrom (lc.mapState fun _ => .sweep) u).state ≠ some .done := by
    simpa only [List.length_replicate] using hclear₀.2.1
  -- The three stationary dispatches preserve the original work-head intervals.
  have hcr := seamCompTM_run_ofCfg (copyTM 2 0 1) .done inputSeekRewind .start
    hcopy rfl hcopy₀.2.1 hrewind
  have hcrCut := seamCompTM_firstReturn_ofCfg (copyTM 2 0 1) .done inputSeekRewind .start .done
    hcopy rfl hcopy₀.2.1 hrewind rfl hrCut
  have hcl := seamCompTM_run_ofCfg
    (seamCompTM (copyTM 2 0 1) .done inputSeekRewind .start) (Sum.inr .done)
    (counterLoopTM inputSeekStep () none) (.dec .run) hcr rfl hcrCut hloop
  have hclCut := seamCompTM_firstReturn_ofCfg
    (seamCompTM (copyTM 2 0 1) .done inputSeekRewind .start) (Sum.inr .done)
    (counterLoopTM inputSeekStep () none) (.dec .run) .done hcr rfl hcrCut hloop rfl hlCut
  have hall := seamCompTM_run_ofCfg
    (seamCompTM (seamCompTM (copyTM 2 0 1) .done inputSeekRewind .start) (Sum.inr .done)
      (counterLoopTM inputSeekStep () none) (.dec .run)) (Sum.inr .done)
    (clearTM 2 1) .sweep hcl rfl hclCut hclear
  have hallCut := seamCompTM_firstReturn_ofCfg
    (seamCompTM (seamCompTM (copyTM 2 0 1) .done inputSeekRewind .start) (Sum.inr .done)
      (counterLoopTM inputSeekStep () none) (.dec .run)) (Sum.inr .done)
    (clearTM 2 1) .sweep .done hcl rfl hclCut hclear rfl hcCut
  have hdmap : ((d₀.mapState Sum.inl).mapState Sum.inl).mapState Sum.inl = d := by
    apply Cfg.ext <;> try rfl
    simpa [d₀, Cfg.mapState] using hd.symm
  have hcSpan : ∀ u ≤ 2 * w.length + 2, ∀ j,
      ((copyTM 2 0 1).runFrom d₀ u).workTapePos j ∈
        Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)) := by
    intro u hu j
    have h := hcopy₀.2.2 j u hu
    fin_cases j <;> simpa [d₀] using h
  have hrSpan : ∀ u ≤ r, ∀ j, (inputSeekRewind.runFrom rw₀ u).workTapePos j ∈
      Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)) := by
    intro u hu j
    rw [hrHeads u hu]
    simp [rw₀, d₁, d₀, Cfg.mapState, Finset.mem_Icc]
  have hlSpan : ∀ u ≤ l, ∀ j,
      ((counterLoopTM inputSeekStep () none).runFrom
        (rw₁.mapState fun _ => .dec .run) u).workTapePos j ∈
          Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)) := by
    intro u hu j
    rw [hstart]
    fin_cases j
    · obtain ⟨a, v, _, hv⟩ := hloop₀.2.2.2 u hu
      have hh := hv 0
      rw [inputSeekStep_run _ (hstate a), horbit, inputSeekStep_run c rfl] at hh
      have hh' : ((counterLoopTM inputSeekStep () none).runFrom
          (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) c ct (d.workTapePos 1)) u).workTapePos 0 =
            d.workTapePos 0 := hh
      change ((counterLoopTM inputSeekStep () none).runFrom
        (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) c ct (d.workTapePos 1)) u).workTapePos 0 ∈
          Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos 0 - 1) (d.workTapePos 0 + (w.length : ℤ))
      rw [hh']
      simp [Finset.mem_Icc]
    · exact hloop₀.2.2.1 u hu
  have hclearSpan : ∀ u ≤ 2 * w.length + 2, ∀ j,
      ((clearTM 2 1).runFrom (lc.mapState fun _ => .sweep) u).workTapePos j ∈
        Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)) := by
    intro u hu j
    have h := hclear₀.2.2 j u (by simpa using hu)
    fin_cases j
    · change (if (0 : Fin 2) = 1 then _ else _) at h
      rw [if_neg (by decide)] at h
      have h' : ((clearTM 2 1).runFrom (lc.mapState fun _ => .sweep) u).workTapePos 0 =
          d.workTapePos 0 := h
      change ((clearTM 2 1).runFrom (lc.mapState fun _ => .sweep) u).workTapePos 0 ∈
        Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos 0 - 1) (d.workTapePos 0 + (w.length : ℤ))
      rw [h']
      simp [Finset.mem_Icc]
    · simpa [lc, Cfg.mapState] using h
  have hcrSpan := inputSeek_seam_range _ _ _ _ hcopy rfl hcopy₀.2.1 _ _ hcSpan hrSpan
  have hclSpan := inputSeek_seam_range _ _ _ _ hcr rfl hcrCut _ _ hcrSpan hlSpan
  have hallSpan := inputSeek_seam_range _ _ _ _ hcl rfl hclCut _ _ hclSpan hclearSpan
  rw [hdmap] at hall hallCut hallSpan
  refine ⟨((2 * w.length + 2 + 1 + r) + 1 + l) + 1 + (2 * w.length + 2), ?_,
    hallCut, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have ho := counterOverhead_le w
    rw [hp] at ho
    change r ≤ d.inputPos.val + 3 at hr
    dsimp [l]
    omega
  · intro u hu j
    have h := Finset.mem_Icc.mp (hallSpan u hu j)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> omega
  · change (inputSeekMachine.runFrom d _).state = _ ∧ _
    rw [show inputSeekMachine.runFrom d _ = finish.mapState Sum.inr from hall]
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

end Turing
```
