    rw [show (cfg.mapState e).state = some (e q) by
      simp only [Cfg.mapState, hs, Option.map_some]]
    dsimp only
    rw [hin, hwork]
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.relabelState, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact Cfg.mapState_apply e _ cfg

/-- Initialized runs correspond at every time. This is deliberately an
initialized-run lemma (epoch-1 audit, finding 5); an arbitrary-start version
would be a separate statement. -/
lemma MultiTapeTM.relabelState_runFrom_init {State' : Type*}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (e : State ≃ State') (input : List Symbol)
    (t : ℕ) :
    (tm.relabelState e).runFrom ((tm.relabelState e).initCfg input) t =
      (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) t).mapState e :=
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom_comm_of_step (Cfg.mapState e)
    (tm.relabelState_step e) (tm.initCfg input) t

end Turing

namespace Turing

variable {Symbol : Type*}

/-! ## Guarded state transport (moved from `Build/Embed` at MIG-0b's layering split) -/

/-- An injectively renamed source run agrees with a host run through any
prefix whose live source controls satisfy `good`, provided both transition
tables agree on the renamed good states for every input and work-tape read.
**Proof sketch.** Extend the renamed source table to the entire host carrier.
Step commutation identifies its run, then same-carrier guarded agreement
transfers that run to the host on the image of the good source states. -/
theorem MultiTapeTM.runFrom_mapState_of_agreeOn {k : ℕ} {S H : Type} {x : List Symbol}
    (src : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S) (host : MultiTapeTM k Symbol H)
    (emb : S ↪ H) (good : S → Prop)
    (hagree : ∀ q, good q → ∀ inp work,
      host.tr (emb q) inp work = (src.tr q inp work).mapState emb)
    (c : Cfg k Symbol S x) (t : ℕ)
    (hguard : ∀ u < t, ∀ q, (src.runFrom c u).state = some q → good q) :
    host.runFrom (c.mapState emb) t = (src.runFrom c t).mapState emb := by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty S := ⟨src.q₀⟩
  let reference : MultiTapeTM k Symbol H :=
    ⟨emb src.q₀, fun q inp work => (src.tr (Function.invFun emb q) inp work).mapState emb⟩
  have step (d : Cfg k Symbol S x) :
      reference.step (d.mapState emb) = (src.step d).mapState emb := by
    cases hs : d.state with
    | none => simp [MultiTapeTM.step, Cfg.mapState, hs]
    | some q =>
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, Cfg.mapState, hs, Option.map_some]
      change (reference.tr (emb q) d.inputSymbol d.workTapeSymbols).apply (d.mapState emb) = _
      dsimp only [reference]
      rw [Function.leftInverse_invFun emb.injective q]
      exact Cfg.mapState_apply emb _ d
  have transport (u : ℕ) :
      reference.runFrom (c.mapState emb) u = (src.runFrom c u).mapState emb :=
    MultiTapeTM.runFrom_comm_of_step (fun d => d.mapState emb) step c u
  have agreement : reference.AgreeOn host {q | ∃ p, good p ∧ emb p = q} := by
    intro q hq inp work
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hq
    dsimp only [reference]
    rw [Function.leftInverse_invFun emb.injective p]
    exact (hagree p hp inp work).symm
  rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_eq_of_agreeOn agreement]
  · exact transport t
  · intro u hu q hq
    rw [transport u] at hq
    change ((src.runFrom c u).state.map emb) = some q at hq
    obtain ⟨p, hp, he⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp hq
    exact ⟨p, hguard u hu p hp, he⟩

end Turing

namespace Turing

/-! ### Relabelling preserves space -/

/-- **State relabelling preserves every head trajectory.** For any machine `tm` and any state
equivalence `e`, head `i` of the relabelled machine visits, in its first `t` steps from its
initial configuration, exactly the cells that head `i` of `tm` visits. This is the space
clause that the coding step `Turing.exists_codeTM` does not state. [AB09, §1.4: the coding
step of the normal form]

**Proof sketch.** The relabelled run is the original run with its states renamed
(`Turing.MultiTapeTM.relabelState_runFrom_init`), and renaming changes no head position. -/
theorem MultiTapeTM.relabelState_visitedByTapeHead {k : ℕ} {Symbol : Type*}
    {State State' : Type*} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (e : State ≃ State')
    (input : List Symbol) (t : ℕ) (i : Fin k) :
    (tm.relabelState e).visitedByTapeHead ((tm.relabelState e).initCfg input) t i =
      tm.visitedByTapeHead (tm.initCfg input) t i := by
  simp only [MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead, MultiTapeTM.relabelState_runFrom_init,
    Cfg.mapState]

/-- **State relabelling preserves space at every time.** The relabelled machine uses exactly
the space of the original up to every time `t`. [AB09, §1.4]

**Proof sketch.** Sum `Turing.MultiTapeTM.relabelState_visitedByTapeHead` over the tapes. -/
theorem MultiTapeTM.relabelState_spaceUsed {k : ℕ} {Symbol : Type*} {State State' : Type*}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (e : State ≃ State') (input : List Symbol) (t : ℕ) :
    (tm.relabelState e).spaceUsed ((tm.relabelState e).initCfg input) t =
      tm.spaceUsed (tm.initCfg input) t := by
  simp only [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed, MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape,
    MultiTapeTM.relabelState_visitedByTapeHead]

end Turing
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/BufferWords.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 Seyoon Ragavan. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Simulation

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Buffer tapes of composite words

Cell identities for the buffer tape `Turing.FinTM.bufferTape w`, which holds the word `w` from
cell `0` and is blank everywhere else, when `w` is built from smaller words: a suffix read at an
offset, a middle word's letters, a prefix or a suffix of the word, the blank cells off the word,
and the cells of a unary word with its terminator. A machine's contract can then read the fields
of a serialized layout, such as a pair encoding followed by a unary state and a table, cell by
cell. Every proof reads `bufferTape` only through its published equations.

## Main results

* `Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_append_shift` — past a prefix `u`, the buffer of `u ++ w` reads `w`'s
  buffer.
* `Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_append_mid` — the letters of the middle word of `u ++ w ++ v`.
* `Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_drop`, `Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_take` — the buffer of a suffix or a
  prefix of a word.
* `Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_eq_none_of_not_mem` — every cell off the word is blank.
* `Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_unary` — the cells of the unary word `1^q 0`, its terminator
  included.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§1.2: tapes holding words; §1.4: encodings of machines as
  strings, whose fields these identities read.)
-/

namespace Turing.FinTM

/-- **A suffix at an offset**: at a cell `z ≥ 0` past the prefix `u`, the buffer of `u ++ w`
reads the buffer of `w` at `z`, including `w`'s right blank and every cell beyond it.

**Proof sketch.** Both cells are nonnegative, and list lookup in `u ++ w` at `|u| + z` is lookup
in `w` at `z`. -/
theorem bufferTape_append_shift {Symbol : Type*} (u w : List Symbol) {z : ℤ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    bufferTape (u ++ w) (u.length + z) = bufferTape w z := by
  rw [bufferTape_eq, bufferTape_eq, if_pos (by omega), if_pos hz,
    show ((u.length : ℤ) + z).toNat = u.length + z.toNat by omega,
    List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]

/-- **A middle word's letters**: in the buffer of `u ++ w ++ v`, the cell `|u| + r` holds `w`'s
letter `r`, for `r < |w|`.

**Proof sketch.** Past `u`, the buffer reads the buffer of `w ++ v`
(`Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_append_shift`), whose cell `r < |w|` is `w`'s letter. -/
theorem bufferTape_append_mid {Symbol : Type*} (u w v : List Symbol) (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length) :
    bufferTape (u ++ w ++ v) (u.length + r) = some w[r] := by
  rw [List.append_assoc, bufferTape_append_shift u (w ++ v) (Int.natCast_nonneg r), bufferTape_nat,
    List.getElem?_append_left hr, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hr]

/-- **The buffer of a suffix**: at a cell `z ≥ 0`, the buffer of `w.drop r` reads the buffer of
`w` at `r + z`.

**Proof sketch.** `w` is `w.take r ++ w.drop r`. If `r ≤ |w|`, the prefix has length `r` and
`Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_append_shift` applies. Otherwise the suffix is empty, and the cell
`r + z` is past `w`'s end, so both sides are blank. -/
theorem bufferTape_drop {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) (r : ℕ) {z : ℤ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    bufferTape (w.drop r) z = bufferTape w (r + z) := by
  by_cases hr : r ≤ w.length
  · have h := bufferTape_append_shift (w.take r) (w.drop r) hz
    rw [List.take_append_drop, List.length_take, min_eq_left hr] at h
    exact h.symm
  · rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega), bufferTape_eq, bufferTape_eq, if_pos hz,
      if_pos (by omega), List.getElem?_nil, List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)]

/-- **The buffer of a prefix**: at a cell `z < n`, the buffer of `w.take n` reads the buffer of
`w`.

**Proof sketch.** Negative cells are blank on both sides. At `0 ≤ z < n`, list lookup in
`w.take n` is lookup in `w`. -/
theorem bufferTape_take {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) (n : ℕ) {z : ℤ} (hz : z < n) :
    bufferTape (w.take n) z = bufferTape w z := by
  rw [bufferTape_eq, bufferTape_eq]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [List.getElem?_take, if_pos (by omega)]
  · rfl

/-- **Off the word, the buffer is blank**: every cell outside `[0, |w|)` reads `none`.

**Proof sketch.** A negative cell is blank by the buffer's equation, and a cell at or past `|w|`
is past the end of the list. -/
theorem bufferTape_eq_none_of_not_mem {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) {z : ℤ}
    (hz : ¬(0 ≤ z ∧ z < w.length)) : bufferTape w z = none := by
  rw [bufferTape_eq]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)
  · rfl

/-- **A unary word's cells**: the buffer of `1^q 0` (`q` letters `true`, then the terminator
`false`) reads `true` at the cells `r < q` and `false` at `r = q`, that is,
`some (decide (r < q))` for every `r ≤ q`.

**Proof sketch.** At `r < q` list lookup stays in the block of `true`s; at `r = q` it reads the
terminator. -/
theorem bufferTape_unary (q r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ q) :
    bufferTape (List.replicate q true ++ [false]) r = some (decide (r < q)) := by
  rw [bufferTape_nat]
  by_cases hlt : r < q
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by rw [List.length_replicate]; exact hlt),
      List.getElem?_replicate_of_lt hlt, decide_eq_true hlt]
  · obtain rfl : r = q := by omega
    rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by rw [List.length_replicate]), List.length_replicate,
      Nat.sub_self, decide_eq_false (Nat.lt_irrefl r)]
    rfl

end Turing.FinTM
```

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Bits
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Encoding

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Time-constructible functions

A function `T : ℕ → ℕ` is *time constructible* if `T n ≥ n` and some machine computes,
on every input `x`, the binary representation of `T |x|` within at most
`c · (T |x| + 1)` steps for a positive constant `c`. [AB09, §1.3, with the audit-mandated
budget repair below.] Time constructibility rules out pathological time bounds. It is
needed when a machine must *generate* a step budget from its input length, as in the
hierarchy theorems; note that the timed universal machine of [AB09, p. 21] receives its
budget as an explicit extra input and needs no constructibility hypothesis.

## Design and deviations from [AB09]

* Binary representation is `Nat.bits` (least-significant-bit first, with no redundant
  most-significant zeros; `Nat.bits 0 = []`), where [AB09] writes `⌞T(|x|)⌟` without
  fixing endianness. Nothing in Chapter 1 depends on the choice.
* **Deviation (audit-mandated).** [AB09] demands the computation run within exactly
  `T n` steps and then asserts that `n`, `n log n`, `n²`, `2ⁿ` are time constructible.
  The phase-1 external audit (`audits/phase1-findings.md`, finding 1, adversarial cases
  5-6) *proved the literal reading false in this model*: under the exact bound, the
  identity function — [AB09]'s own first example — is not time constructible (on the
  budget `T n = n`, the first transition on `[false]` and `[false, false]` is the same
  function call, and the length-1 budget forces it to halt with output `[true]`, which
  absorption then freezes at length 2), and even `T n = n + 1` fails by an append-only
  prefix argument. We therefore allow a positive constant factor on `T n + 1`, which
  suffices for every downstream use and restores the book's examples *after small-input
  normalization*: the literal `n · ⌈log₂ n⌉`, for instance, still violates `T n ≥ n` at
  `n = 1`, so such examples are stated with a `max`-with-`n` or `+ 1` normalization.
  Exact constants in downstream results must be derived from this form, not inherited
  from the strict reading.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.TimeConstructible` — [AB09, §1.3], with the constant-slack repair above.
* `Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM` — the binary length counter `x ↦ Nat.bits |x|` (MIG-1),
  declared under its `Turing.FinTM` name.

## Main results

* `Complexity.timeConstructible_iff` — the definition as an equivalence.
* `Complexity.timeConstructible_id` — the identity function is time constructible,
  restoring [AB09]'s example under the repaired definition.
* `Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM_computes`, `Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM_spaceUsed` — the
  counter's time `5 · (n + 1)` and space `5 · (Nat.size |x| + 1)` (MIG-1; sorried until
  the fill F-A).

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§1.3, "Time-constructible functions".)
-/

namespace Complexity

open Turing

/-- `T` is time constructible: `T n ≥ n`, and some finite binary machine computes
`x ↦ ⌞T |x|⌟` (binary via `Nat.bits`) within `c · (T |x| + 1)` steps for a positive
constant `c`. [AB09, §1.3], with the constant-slack deviation documented in the module
docstring (the literal exact-`T n` bound is refuted in this model by
`audits/phase1-findings.md`, finding 1). -/
def TimeConstructible (T : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ n, n ≤ T n) ∧
  ∃ c : ℕ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ M : FinTM Bool, ∀ x : List Bool,
    M.ComputesInTime x (T x.length).bits (c * (T x.length + 1))

/-- **Time constructibility, unfolded**: `T` is time constructible exactly when `n ≤ T n` for
every `n` and, for some constant `c > 0`, some machine computes `(T |x|).bits` on every input `x`
within `c · (T |x| + 1)` steps. -/
theorem timeConstructible_iff (T : ℕ → ℕ) :
    TimeConstructible T ↔
      (∀ n, n ≤ T n) ∧ ∃ c : ℕ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ M : FinTM Bool, ∀ x : List Bool,
        M.ComputesInTime x (T x.length).bits (c * (T x.length + 1)) :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Increment a little-endian binary word, extending it on overflow. -/
private def counterInc : List Bool → List Bool
  | [] => [true]
  | false :: bs => true :: bs
  | true :: bs => false :: counterInc bs

/-- The number of initial true bits cleared by an increment. -/
private def counterCarry : List Bool → ℕ
  | true :: bs => counterCarry bs + 1
  | _ => 0

/-- Each cleared true bit decreases the potential by one; the final write adds one.
This is the local accounting identity behind the amortized bound. -/
private lemma counterInc_potential (bs : List Bool) :
    (counterInc bs).count true + counterCarry bs = bs.count true + 1 := by
  induction bs with
  | nil => simp [counterInc, counterCarry]
  | cons b bs ih =>
    cases b with
    | false => simp [counterInc, counterCarry]
    | true => simp [counterInc, counterCarry]; omega

/-- The list increment is exactly successor in `Nat.bits`, including overflow.
**Proof sketch.** Binary induction: a low zero becomes one without a carry; a
low one becomes zero and applies the induction hypothesis to the high part. -/
private lemma counterInc_bits (n : ℕ) : counterInc n.bits = (n + 1).bits := by
  induction n using Nat.binaryRec' with
  | zero => simp [counterInc]
  | bit b n hn ih =>
    rw [Nat.bits_append_bit n b hn]
    cases b with
    | false =>
      change true :: n.bits = (2 * n + 1).bits
      exact (Nat.bit1_bits n).symm
    | true =>
      simp only [counterInc, ih]
      have he : Nat.bit true n + 1 = 2 * (n + 1) := by simp [Nat.bit_val]; omega
      rw [he, Nat.bit0_bits _ (by omega)]

/-- An increment grows the word by at most one cell, and all cleared cells lie
within the incremented word. -/
private lemma counterInc_length (bs : List Bool) :
    (counterInc bs).length ≤ bs.length + 1 ∧
      counterCarry bs ≤ (counterInc bs).length := by
  induction bs with
  | nil => simp [counterInc, counterCarry]
  | cons b bs ih =>
    cases b <;> simp only [counterInc, counterCarry, List.length_cons] <;> omega

/-- One carry transition, with the first transition also advancing the input. -/
private def counterBump (d : SignType) (w : Option Bool) : Action 1 Bool (Fin 4) :=
  if w = some true then
    ⟨d, fun _ => (some (some false), .pos), none, some 1⟩
  else ⟨d, fun _ => (some (some true), .neg), none, some 2⟩

/-- **The binary length counter**. A one-work-tape machine with four states (count `0`, carry `1`,
rewind `2`, emit `3`) that keeps a little-endian binary counter on its work tape, increments it once
per input symbol, and on the blank after the input emits the counter's bits and halts, so that it
computes `x ↦ Nat.bits |x|`. [AB09, §1.3, the examples of time-constructible functions] It is
declared under its `Turing.FinTM` name so that MIG-9 can move it into `Build/` without a rename. -/
def _root_.Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM : FinTM Bool where
  k := 1
  State := Fin 4
  tm :=
    { q₀ := 0
      tr := fun q inp work =>
        if q = 0 then
          match inp with
          | none => ⟨.zero, fun _ => (none, .zero), none, some 3⟩
          | some _ => counterBump .pos (work 0)
        else if q = 1 then counterBump .zero (work 0)
        else if q = 2 then
          match work 0 with
          | none => ⟨.zero, fun _ => (none, .pos), none, some 0⟩
          | some _ => ⟨.zero, fun _ => (none, .neg), none, some 2⟩
        else
          match work 0 with
          | none => ⟨.zero, fun _ => (none, .zero), none, none⟩
          | some b => ⟨.zero, fun _ => (none, .pos), some b, some 3⟩ }

/-- A finite word on nonnegative cells, with a blank at every other cell. -/
private def counterTape (bs : List Bool) (z : ℤ) : Option Bool :=
  if z < 0 then none else bs[z.toNat]?

/-- Canonical configurations for carry, rewind, count, and emission invariants. -/
private def counterCfg (x : List Bool) (q : Fin 4) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (z : ℤ) (bs out : List Bool) : Cfg 1 Bool (Fin 4) x :=
  ⟨some q, p, fun _ => counterTape bs, fun _ => z, out⟩

/-- Reading after a prefix gives the head of the remaining word (blank if empty). -/
private lemma counterTape_read (pre bs : List Bool) :
    counterTape (pre ++ bs) pre.length = bs.head? := by
  simp only [counterTape, if_neg (by omega : ¬(pre.length : ℤ) < 0), Int.toNat_natCast,
    List.getElem?_append_right (le_refl _), Nat.sub_self]
  cases bs <;> rfl

/-- Replace the first suffix bit, or extend the word if the suffix is empty.
**Proof sketch.** At the write position use the updated value. Before that
position both tapes read the unchanged prefix; afterwards both read the old tail.
Negative cells remain blank. -/
private lemma counterTape_write (pre bs : List Bool) (b : Bool) :
    Function.update (counterTape (pre ++ bs)) (pre.length : ℤ) (some b) =
      counterTape (pre ++ b :: bs.tail) := by
  funext z
  by_cases hz : z = (pre.length : ℤ)
  · subst z
    simp [counterTape_read]
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne hz]
    unfold counterTape
    by_cases hn : z < 0
    · simp only [if_pos hn]
    · simp only [if_neg hn]
      by_cases hl : z.toNat < pre.length
      · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hl, List.getElem?_append_left hl]
      · have hg : pre.length < z.toNat := by omega
        rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega), List.getElem?_append_right (by omega),
          List.getElem?_cons, if_neg (by omega), List.getElem?_tail]
        congr 1
        omega

/-- One carry transition updates exactly the currently scanned cell. -/
private lemma counter_carry_step (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (pre bs : List Bool) :
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.step (counterCfg x 1 p pre.length (pre ++ bs) []) =
      if bs.head? = some true then
        counterCfg x 1 p (pre.length + 1) (pre ++ false :: bs.tail) []
      else counterCfg x 2 p (pre.length - 1) (pre ++ true :: bs.tail) [] := by
  unfold MultiTapeTM.step
  change (FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.tr (1 : Fin 4) _ _).apply _ = _
  simp only [FinTM.lengthBitsTM, show (1 : Fin 4) ≠ 0 from by decide, ↓reduceIte]
  change (counterBump .zero (counterTape (pre ++ bs) pre.length)).apply _ = _
  rw [counterTape_read]
  unfold counterBump
  by_cases h : bs.head? = some true <;> simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]
  all_goals
    apply Cfg.ext
    · rfl
    · exact moveInputPos_zero p
    · funext j; exact counterTape_write pre bs _
    · funext j; simp [Action.apply, counterCfg, sub_eq_add_neg]
    · rfl

/-- A carry flips precisely the initial true bits, then writes the final true bit.
**Proof sketch.** Induct on the suffix. The empty suffix and a leading false bit
finish in one step. A leading true bit is replaced by false and included in the
prefix before invoking the induction hypothesis on the tail. -/
private lemma counter_carry (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (bs : List Bool) : ∀ pre : List Bool,
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (counterCfg x 1 p pre.length (pre ++ bs) [])
        (counterCarry bs + 1) =
      counterCfg x 2 p ((pre.length : ℤ) + counterCarry bs - 1)
        (pre ++ counterInc bs) [] := by
  induction bs with
  | nil =>
    intro pre
    simp only [counterCarry, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step,
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, counter_carry_step]
    simp [counterInc]
  | cons b bs ih =>
    intro pre
    cases b with
    | false =>
      simp only [counterCarry, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step,
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, counter_carry_step]
      simp [counterInc]
    | true =>
      simp only [counterCarry, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, counter_carry_step,
        List.head?_cons, List.tail_cons, ↓reduceIte]
      have h := ih (pre ++ [false])
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step] at h
      simpa [counterInc, List.append_assoc, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
        add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using h

/-- Rewind crosses the written prefix, detects the untouched blank at `-1`, and
returns to cell zero in the count state.
**Proof sketch.** Induct on the number of written cells still to cross.
Each bit causes one left move; at `-1` one right move ends the rewind. -/
private lemma counter_rewind (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (bs : List Bool) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ bs.length),
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (counterCfg x 2 p ((j : ℤ) - 1) bs []) (j + 1) =
      counterCfg x 0 p 0 bs [] := by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro hj
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    apply Cfg.ext <;>
      simp [MultiTapeTM.step, FinTM.lengthBitsTM, counterCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols,
        counterTape, Action.apply]
  | succ j ih =>
    intro hj
    have hw : (counterCfg x 2 p (j : ℤ) bs []).workTapeSymbols 0 = some bs[j] := by
      simp only [counterCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, counterTape,
        if_neg (by omega : ¬(j : ℤ) < 0), Int.toNat_natCast]
      exact List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)
    have hs : FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.step (counterCfg x 2 p (j : ℤ) bs []) =
        counterCfg x 2 p ((j : ℤ) - 1) bs [] := by
      unfold MultiTapeTM.step
      change (FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.tr (2 : Fin 4) _ _).apply _ = _
      simp only [FinTM.lengthBitsTM, show (2 : Fin 4) ≠ 0 from by decide,
        show (2 : Fin 4) ≠ 1 from by decide, ↓reduceIte, hw]
      apply Cfg.ext
      · rfl
      · exact moveInputPos_zero p
      · rfl
      · funext k; simp [Action.apply, counterCfg, sub_eq_add_neg]
      · rfl
    have he : ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1 = (j : ℤ) := by omega
    rw [he, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, hs]
    exact ih (by omega)

/-- The first carry transition also consumes exactly one input symbol. -/
private lemma counter_start (x : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < x.length) (bs : List Bool) :
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.step (counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 bs []) =
      FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.step (counterCfg x 1 ⟨i + 2, by omega⟩ 0 bs []) := by
  have hs : (counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 bs []).inputSymbol = some x[i] :=
    inputSymbolInner i (by simp only [counterCfg]; omega) hi
  unfold MultiTapeTM.step
  change (FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.tr (0 : Fin 4) _ _).apply _ =
    (FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.tr (1 : Fin 4) _ _).apply _
  rw [hs]
  simp only [FinTM.lengthBitsTM, show (1 : Fin 4) ≠ 0 from by decide, ↓reduceIte]
  change (counterBump .pos (counterTape bs 0)).apply _ =
    (counterBump .zero (counterTape bs 0)).apply _
  unfold counterBump
  by_cases h : counterTape bs 0 = some true <;> simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]
  all_goals
    apply Cfg.ext
    · rfl
    · apply Fin.ext
      change (moveInputPos (⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)) .pos).val =
        (moveInputPos (⟨i + 2, by omega⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)) 0).val
      rw [moveInputPos_zero, moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by simp; omega)]
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl

/-- One complete increment takes twice the carry length plus two transitions.
**Proof sketch.** The count transition is the first carry transition, with the
input advanced once. The carry uses `r + 1` steps and leaves the head at `r - 1`;
the rewind uses another `r + 1` steps and leaves the incremented word intact. -/
private lemma counter_increment (x : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < x.length)
    (bs : List Bool) :
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 bs [])
        (2 * counterCarry bs + 2) =
      counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 2, by omega⟩ 0 (counterInc bs) [] := by
  have hc : FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 bs [])
      (counterCarry bs + 1) =
      counterCfg x 2 ⟨i + 2, by omega⟩ ((counterCarry bs : ℤ) - 1) (counterInc bs) [] := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, counter_start x i hi,
      ← MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step]
    simpa only [List.length_nil, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, List.nil_append] using
      counter_carry x ⟨i + 2, by omega⟩ bs []
  rw [show 2 * counterCarry bs + 2 = (counterCarry bs + 1) + (counterCarry bs + 1) by omega,
    MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc]
  exact counter_rewind x ⟨i + 2, by omega⟩ (counterInc bs) (counterCarry bs)
    (counterInc_length bs).2

/-- The counting invariant carries a nonnegative potential of twice the popcount.
**Proof sketch.** Initially both elapsed time and potential are zero. An increment
with `r` cleared bits costs `2r + 2` steps and changes the potential by `2 - 2r`.
Thus elapsed time plus potential increases by exactly four per input symbol.
The semantic invariant records the exact canonical binary word and head positions. -/
private lemma counter_count (x : List Bool) : ∀ i (hi : i ≤ x.length),
    ∃ t, t + 2 * i.bits.count true ≤ 4 * i ∧
      FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.initCfg x) t =
        counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 i.bits [] := by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro hi
    refine ⟨0, by simp, ?_⟩
    apply Cfg.ext
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · funext j z
      simp [MultiTapeTM.initCfg, counterCfg, counterTape]
    · rfl
    · rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    intro hi
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hc⟩ := ih (by omega)
    refine ⟨t + 2 * counterCarry i.bits + 2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hp := counterInc_potential i.bits
      rw [counterInc_bits] at hp
      omega
    · rw [show t + 2 * counterCarry i.bits + 2 = t + (2 * counterCarry i.bits + 2) by omega,
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc, counter_increment x i (by omega), counterInc_bits]

/-- The emit phase appends exactly the stored prefix, one bit per step.
**Proof sketch.** Induct on the emitted length, using the nonblank cell at each
index below the word length; the tape contents and input position never change. -/
private lemma counter_emit_run (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (bs : List Bool) : ∀ i (_hi : i ≤ bs.length),
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (counterCfg x 3 p 0 bs []) i =
      counterCfg x 3 p i bs (bs.take i) := by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => intro hi; rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    intro hi
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega)]
    have hw : (counterCfg x 3 p i bs (bs.take i)).workTapeSymbols 0 = some bs[i] := by
      simp only [counterCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, counterTape,
        if_neg (by omega : ¬(i : ℤ) < 0), Int.toNat_natCast]
      exact List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)
    unfold MultiTapeTM.step
    change (FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.tr (3 : Fin 4) _ _).apply _ = _
    simp only [FinTM.lengthBitsTM, show (3 : Fin 4) ≠ 0 from by decide,
      show (3 : Fin 4) ≠ 1 from by decide, show (3 : Fin 4) ≠ 2 from by decide,
      ↓reduceIte, hw]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · rfl
    · exact moveInputPos_zero p
    · rfl
    · funext j; simp [Action.apply, counterCfg]
    · simp only [Action.apply, counterCfg]
      rw [List.take_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)]

/-- At the first blank after the stored word, emission halts without extra output. -/
private lemma counter_emit (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (bs : List Bool) :
    let c := FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (counterCfg x 3 p 0 bs []) (bs.length + 1)
    c.state = none ∧ c.output = bs := by
  have hw : (counterCfg x 3 p bs.length bs (bs.take bs.length)).workTapeSymbols 0 =
      none := by
    simp only [counterCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, counterTape,
      if_neg (by omega : ¬(bs.length : ℤ) < 0), Int.toNat_natCast]
    exact List.getElem?_eq_none (le_refl _)
  dsimp only
  rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', counter_emit_run x p bs bs.length (le_refl _)]
  unfold MultiTapeTM.step
  change ((FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.tr (3 : Fin 4) _ _).apply _).state = none ∧ _
  simp only [FinTM.lengthBitsTM, show (3 : Fin 4) ≠ 0 from by decide,
    show (3 : Fin 4) ≠ 1 from by decide, show (3 : Fin 4) ≠ 2 from by decide,
    ↓reduceIte, hw]
  simp [Action.apply, counterCfg]

/-- **The length counter's time**. The counter computes `x ↦ Nat.bits |x|` within `5·(n + 1)` steps.
[AB09, §1.3]

**Proof sketch.** The body of today's `timeConstructible_id`, which `f2_counter_computes` copies:
with twice the number of `true` counter bits as potential, elapsed time plus potential is at most
`4n` after `n` increments (the private `counter_count`); entering emission and the final halt add
two steps, and the emitted word, of length at most `n`, costs one step per bit. -/
theorem _root_.Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM_computes : FinTM.lengthBitsTM.ComputesFunInTime
    (fun x => Nat.bits x.length) (fun n => 5 * (n + 1)) := by
  sorry

/-- **The length counter's space**. At every time, the counter's work tape has visited at most
`5·(Nat.size |x| + 1)` cells: logarithmic space.

**Proof sketch.** Catalog's `f2_counter_space`: every counting round returns the head to the
origin, a carry walks at most the counter's binary width, which never exceeds `Nat.size |x|`,
and emission walks the stored word once, so at every time the head stays in an interval of at
most `5·(Nat.size |x| + 1)` cells (the head ledger `f2_counter_heads`, from the increment
ledger `f2_counter_count_space`). -/
theorem _root_.Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM_spaceUsed (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.spaceUsed (FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.initCfg x) t ≤
      5 * (Nat.size x.length + 1) := by
  sorry

/-- The identity function is time constructible. [AB09, §1.3 examples]

**Proof sketch.** A one-work-tape machine maintains a little-endian binary counter on
its work tape while scanning the input left to right: for each input symbol it
increments the counter (walking right over `true` cells turning them `false` until the
first `false`/blank cell, which becomes `true`, then returning to cell 0). Incrementing
`n` times costs amortized `O(1)` per increment, `O(n)` in total. When the input head
reads the blank past the input, the machine walks the counter left to right emitting
each bit to the output tape (`O(log n)` steps) and halts. The total is at most
`c · (n + 1)` steps for an absolute constant `c`, and the emitted string is `n.bits`
(for `n = 0` the counter region is empty and nothing is emitted, matching
`Nat.bits 0 = []`). The formal proof uses twice the number of true counter bits as
potential: elapsed time plus potential is at most `4n` after `n` increments.
Entering emission and its final halting transition add two steps; the output length
is at most `n`, so `c = 5` suffices. -/
theorem timeConstructible_id : TimeConstructible id := by
  refine ⟨fun n => le_refl n, 5, by decide, FinTM.lengthBitsTM, fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hc⟩ := counter_count x x.length (le_refl _)
  have hs : FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.step
      (counterCfg x 0 ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ 0 x.length.bits []) =
      counterCfg x 3 ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ 0 x.length.bits [] := by
    have hin : (counterCfg x 0 ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ 0 x.length.bits []).inputSymbol =
        none := by simp [Cfg.inputSymbol, counterCfg]
    unfold MultiTapeTM.step
    change (FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.tr (0 : Fin 4) _ _).apply _ = _
    rw [hin]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [FinTM.lengthBitsTM, Action.apply, counterCfg]
  have hstart : FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.initCfg x) (t + 1) =
      counterCfg x 3 ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ 0 x.length.bits [] := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', hc, hs]
  have he := counter_emit x ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ x.length.bits
  have hbase : FinTM.lengthBitsTM.ComputesInTime x x.length.bits
      ((t + 1) + (x.length.bits.length + 1)) := by
    refine ⟨_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hstart]; exact he.1
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hstart]; exact he.2
  apply hbase.mono
  have hl := Turing.length_bits_le_self x.length
  change (t + 1) + (x.length.bits.length + 1) ≤ 5 * (x.length + 1)
  omega

end Complexity
```

```
/-

Authors: Seyoon Ragavan

import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Catalog
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Seam
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.BufferWords

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The step block's seam layout from a captured serialization

The startups of the step-block simulators (the `k`-generic universal machine's
`Turing.exists_selfStartupTMK`, the record-table canonizer, and the nondeterministic interpreter
core `Turing.exists_ndInterpreterCore`) capture a machine's canonical serialization
`serializeK M = pairEncode n.bits (unaryFin M.q₀ ++ tableBitsK M.tr)` on a scratch tape. The step
block's represented start (`Turing.StepBlock.Rep`) instead wants the bare table on the table tape
and the unary initial state on the summary tape from cell `2`. This module builds the one machine
that redistributes the first into the second, so that every startup cites it.

## Main results

* `Turing.exists_seamLayoutTM` — the redistribution's contract, proved: eight phases on one phase
  host (six catalog rows and two private leaves), at one time `T ≤ 18·(|s| + 1)` fixed before the
  configuration.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§1.4, the machine encoding.)
-/

namespace Turing

/-! ### Private layer: the two leaves

The eight-phase route of `Turing.exists_seamLayoutTM` composes six catalog rows and two leaves.
The leaves live here, `private`, with framed contracts in the rows' style: an exact time, a
first-visit cut at the exit anchor, an explicit endpoint over an arbitrary configuration, and
silence. -/

/-- Control states of the pair-skip leaf `Turing.sl_pairSkipTM`: `start` scans the first cell
of an aligned pair, `after b` remembers it, and `done` is the live exit anchor. -/
private inductive sl_PairPhase where
  /-- at the first cell of an aligned pair -/
  | start
  /-- the pair's first cell held `b` -/
  | after (b : Bool)
  /-- the live exit anchor -/
  | done
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- **The pair-skip leaf.** Started on the first cell of a pair encoding, the machine reads
aligned pairs of tape `src`, always moving right: a doubled bit returns to `start`, and the
separator pair `false, true` enters `done` on the same step that crosses it, so the head ends
one cell past the separator after exactly `2|a| + 2` steps on `pairEncode a w`. No catalog row
serves this scan: the seek rows stop only at blank cells, and no row reads aligned pairs. -/
private def sl_pairSkipTM (k : ℕ) (src : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Bool sl_PairPhase where
  q₀ := .start
  tr := fun s _ w =>
    match s with
    | .start =>
      match w src with
      | some b => ⟨0, fun j => (none, if j = src then .pos else 0), none, some (.after b)⟩
      | none => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, some .start⟩
    | .after b =>
      if b = false ∧ w src = some true then
        ⟨0, fun j => (none, if j = src then .pos else 0), none, some .done⟩
      else
        ⟨0, fun j => (none, if j = src then .pos else 0), none, some .start⟩
    | .done => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, some .done⟩

/-- Control states of the unary-split leaf `Turing.sl_unarySplitTM`: two offset moves on the
summary tape, the copying loop, and the live exit anchor. -/
private inductive sl_SplitPhase where
  /-- the first offset move on the summary tape -/
  | mv1
  /-- the second offset move on the summary tape -/
  | mv2
  /-- the copying loop -/
  | copy
  /-- the live exit anchor -/
  | done
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- **The unary-split leaf.** Move the head of `sm` right twice; then, while `src` reads `true`,
write `true` on `sm` and move both heads right; at the first non-`true` cell write `false` on
`sm` with that head staying, blank the scanned cell of `src`, and move the head of `src` right,
into `done`. On a unary word `1^q 0` under the head of `src` this takes exactly `q + 3` steps,
writes the word on `sm` two cells past that head's start, and does not restore the terminator
on `src`. No catalog row serves it: the copy and transfer rows stop at a blank, not at a
`false` terminator, and none blanks a single source cell while offsetting the destination. -/
private def sl_unarySplitTM (k : ℕ) (src sm : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Bool sl_SplitPhase where
  q₀ := .mv1
  tr := fun s _ w =>
    match s with
    | .mv1 => ⟨0, fun j => (none, if j = sm then .pos else 0), none, some .mv2⟩
    | .mv2 => ⟨0, fun j => (none, if j = sm then .pos else 0), none, some .copy⟩
    | .copy =>
      if w src = some true then
        ⟨0, fun j => if j = src then (none, .pos) else if j = sm then (some (some true), .pos)
          else (none, 0), none, some .copy⟩
      else
        ⟨0, fun j => if j = src then (some none, .pos) else if j = sm then (some (some false), 0)
          else (none, 0), none, some .done⟩
    | .done => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, some .done⟩

/-- A silent action with a stationary input head changes only the control, the cells under the
written heads, and the head positions, each by its explicit field. -/
private lemma sl_apply_eq {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} {S : Type} (a : Action k Bool S)
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (h0 : a.inputTape = 0) (hout : a.output = none) :
    a.apply c =
      { c with
        state := a.state
        workTapes := fun j => Function.update (c.workTapes j) (c.workTapePos j)
          ((a.workTapes j).1.getD (c.workTapes j (c.workTapePos j)))
        workTapePos := fun j => c.workTapePos j + ((a.workTapes j).2 : ℤ) } := by
  have hi : (a.apply c).inputPos = c.inputPos := by
    rw [Action.apply_inputPos, h0, moveInputPos_zero]
  have hwt : (a.apply c).workTapes = fun j => Function.update (c.workTapes j)
      (c.workTapePos j) ((a.workTapes j).1.getD (c.workTapes j (c.workTapePos j))) :=
    funext fun j => by rw [Action.apply_workTapes, Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]
  have hwp : (a.apply c).workTapePos = fun j => c.workTapePos j + ((a.workTapes j).2 : ℤ) :=
    funext fun j => Action.apply_workTapePos a c j
  have ho : (a.apply c).output = c.output := by
    rw [Action.apply_output, hout, Option.toList_none, List.append_nil]
  exact Cfg.ext (Action.apply_state a c) hi hwt hwp ho

/-- A leaf step that only moves the head of tape `i` one cell right: the control changes, the
head advances, and everything else stays. -/
private lemma sl_step_move {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} {S : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S)
    (i : Fin k) {c : Cfg k Bool S x} {s : S} (hc : c.state = some s) (s' : S)
    (htr : M.tr s c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols =
      ⟨0, fun j => (none, if j = i then .pos else 0), none, some s'⟩) :
    M.step c =
      { c with
        state := some s'
        workTapePos := Function.update c.workTapePos i (c.workTapePos i + 1) } := by
  rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hc, htr, sl_apply_eq _ _ rfl rfl]
  apply Cfg.ext <;> dsimp only
  · funext j
    rw [Option.getD_none, Function.update_eq_self]
  · funext j
    rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hj
    · rw [Function.update_self, if_pos rfl]
      simp
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hj, if_neg hj]
      simp

/-- Two aligned-pair steps of the pair-skip leaf, from any configuration: read the pair
`(b₀, b₁)` under the head of `src`, advance that head twice, and land in `done` exactly when
the pair is the separator `false, true`, else back in `start`.

**Proof sketch.** Each step moves only the head of `src` one cell right (`sl_step_move`). The
first reads `b₀` at `start` and enters `after b₀`; the second reads `b₁` and enters `done` exactly
for the separator. Compose the two steps (`Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step'`). -/
private lemma sl_pairSkip_two_steps {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool sl_PairPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .start) (b₀ b₁ : Bool)
    (h0 : d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src) = some b₀)
    (h1 : d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + 1) = some b₁) :
    (sl_pairSkipTM k src).runFrom d 1 =
        { d with
          state := some (.after b₀)
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos src (d.workTapePos src + 1) } ∧
      (sl_pairSkipTM k src).runFrom d 2 =
        { d with
          state := some (if b₀ = false ∧ b₁ = true then .done else .start)
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos src (d.workTapePos src + 2) } := by
  have hs1 : (sl_pairSkipTM k src).step d =
      { d with
        state := some (.after b₀)
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos src (d.workTapePos src + 1) } := by
    refine sl_step_move _ src hstate _ ?_
    have hr : d.workTapeSymbols src = some b₀ := by rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]; exact h0
    simp only [sl_pairSkipTM]
    rw [hr]
  have hrun1 : (sl_pairSkipTM k src).runFrom d 1 =
      { d with
        state := some (.after b₀)
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos src (d.workTapePos src + 1) } := by
    rw [show (1 : ℕ) = 0 + 1 from rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step',
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hs1]
  refine ⟨hrun1, ?_⟩
  have hr1 : ({ d with
      state := some (sl_PairPhase.after b₀)
      workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos src (d.workTapePos src + 1) } :
        Cfg k Bool sl_PairPhase x).workTapeSymbols src = some b₁ := by
    rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]
    dsimp only
    rw [Function.update_self]
    exact h1
  have hs2 : (sl_pairSkipTM k src).step { d with
      state := some (.after b₀)
      workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos src (d.workTapePos src + 1) } =
      { d with
        state := some (if b₀ = false ∧ b₁ = true then .done else .start)
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos src (d.workTapePos src + 2) } := by
    refine (sl_step_move (sl_pairSkipTM k src) src
      (c := { d with
        state := some (.after b₀)
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos src (d.workTapePos src + 1) })
      rfl (if b₀ = false ∧ b₁ = true then .done else .start) ?_).trans ?_
    · simp only [sl_pairSkipTM]
      rw [hr1]
      cases b₀ <;> cases b₁ <;> simp
    · apply Cfg.ext <;> dsimp only
      rw [Function.update_idem, Function.update_self]
      congr 1
      ring
  rw [show (2 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 from rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', hrun1, hs2]

/-- **The pair-skip leaf, framed.** From any configuration in `start` whose tape `src` holds the
first `2|a| + 2` cells of the pair encoding `pairEncode a tail` from its head, the leaf reaches
`done` at exactly `2|a| + 2` and not earlier, with that head `2|a| + 2` cells right of its start
and everything else — every cell of every tape, every other head, the input position and the
output — unchanged. The output is unchanged at every time up to the exit.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on `a`. For `a = []` the encoding begins with the separator
`false, true` (`Turing.pairEncode_eq`), and two steps reach `done` (`sl_pairSkip_two_steps`).
For `b :: a` it begins with the doubled pair `b, b`, so two steps return to `start` two cells
further right, where the tape holds `pairEncode a tail` (`Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_append_shift`),
and the induction hypothesis gives the rest. The cut and silence follow by splitting the time at
`2`. -/
private theorem sl_pairSkipTM_run {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src : Fin k) (a tail : List Bool)
    (d : Cfg k Bool sl_PairPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .start)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℕ, p < 2 * a.length + 2 →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape (pairEncode a tail) p) :
    (sl_pairSkipTM k src).runFrom d (2 * a.length + 2) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos src
            (d.workTapePos src + (2 * a.length + 2 : ℕ)) } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * a.length + 2, ((sl_pairSkipTM k src).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      ∀ t ≤ 2 * a.length + 2, ((sl_pairSkipTM k src).runFrom d t).output = d.output := by
  induction a generalizing d with
  | nil =>
    have hsplit : pairEncode ([] : List Bool) tail = false :: true :: tail := by
      rw [pairEncode_eq]
      simp
    have h0 := hw 0 (by omega)
    rw [FinTM.bufferTape_nat, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, hsplit] at h0
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero] at h0
    have h1 := hw 1 (by omega)
    rw [FinTM.bufferTape_nat, Nat.cast_one, hsplit] at h1
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_succ, List.getElem?_cons_zero] at h1
    obtain ⟨hrun1, hrun2⟩ := sl_pairSkip_two_steps src d hstate false true h0 h1
    rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩] at hrun2
    have hT : 2 * ([] : List Bool).length + 2 = 2 := by simp
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hT, show ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 2 from by norm_num, hrun2]
    · intro t ht
      rw [hT] at ht
      rcases t with _ | _ | t
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hstate]
        simp
      · rw [hrun1]
        simp
      · omega
    · intro t ht
      rw [hT] at ht
      rcases t with _ | _ | t
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
      · rw [hrun1]
      · rcases t with _ | t
        · rw [hrun2]
        · omega
  | cons b a ih =>
    have hsplit : pairEncode (b :: a) tail = b :: b :: pairEncode a tail := by
      rw [pairEncode_eq, pairEncode_eq]
      simp
    have h0 := hw 0 (by omega)
    rw [FinTM.bufferTape_nat, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, hsplit] at h0
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero] at h0
    have h1 := hw 1 (by omega)
    rw [FinTM.bufferTape_nat, Nat.cast_one, hsplit] at h1
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_succ, List.getElem?_cons_zero] at h1
    obtain ⟨hrun1, hrun2⟩ := sl_pairSkip_two_steps src d hstate b b h0 h1
    rw [show (if b = false ∧ b = true then sl_PairPhase.done else .start) = .start from by
      cases b <;> simp] at hrun2
    have hw₂ : ∀ p : ℕ, p < 2 * a.length + 2 →
        ({ d with
            state := some sl_PairPhase.start
            workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos src (d.workTapePos src + 2) } :
          Cfg k Bool sl_PairPhase x).workTapes src
          (({ d with
              state := some sl_PairPhase.start
              workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos src (d.workTapePos src + 2) } :
            Cfg k Bool sl_PairPhase x).workTapePos src + p) =
          FinTM.bufferTape (pairEncode a tail) p := by
      intro p hp
      dsimp only
      rw [Function.update_self]
      have h := hw (2 + p) (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
      rw [show (d.workTapePos src + ((2 + p : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
          d.workTapePos src + 2 + (p : ℕ) from by
        push_cast; ring] at h
      rw [h, hsplit,
        show b :: b :: pairEncode a tail = [b, b] ++ pairEncode a tail from by simp,
        show ((2 + p : ℕ) : ℤ) = (([b, b] : List Bool).length : ℤ) + (p : ℕ) from by simp,
        FinTM.bufferTape_append_shift _ _ (Int.natCast_nonneg p)]
    obtain ⟨ihrun, ihcut, ihout⟩ := ih _ rfl hw₂
    have hT : 2 * (b :: a).length + 2 = 2 + (2 * a.length + 2) := by
      rw [List.length_cons]
      ring
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hT, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun2, ihrun]
      apply Cfg.ext <;> dsimp only
      rw [Function.update_idem, Function.update_self]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    · intro t ht
      rcases t with _ | _ | t
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hstate]
        simp
      · rw [hrun1]
        simp
      · rw [show t + 1 + 1 = 2 + t from by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun2]
        exact ihcut t (by omega)
    · intro t ht
      rcases t with _ | _ | t
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
      · rw [hrun1]
      · rw [show t + 1 + 1 = 2 + t from by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun2]
        exact ihout t (by omega)

/-- The split leaf's copying step: at `copy` reading `true` on `src`, write `true` under the
head of `sm` and advance both heads one cell right.

**Proof sketch.** At `copy` reading `true` the table gives the write-and-advance action; apply it
through `sl_apply_eq` and compare the fields tape by tape, using `src ≠ sm`. -/
private lemma sl_split_step_true {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src sm : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ sm)
    {c : Cfg k Bool sl_SplitPhase x} (hc : c.state = some .copy)
    (hr : c.workTapeSymbols src = some true) :
    (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step c =
      { c with
        state := some .copy
        workTapes := Function.update c.workTapes sm
          (Function.update (c.workTapes sm) (c.workTapePos sm) (some true))
        workTapePos := Function.update
          (Function.update c.workTapePos src (c.workTapePos src + 1)) sm
          (c.workTapePos sm + 1) } := by
  have htr : (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).tr .copy c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols =
      ⟨0, fun j => if j = src then (none, .pos) else if j = sm then (some (some true), .pos)
        else (none, 0), none, some .copy⟩ := by
    simp only [sl_unarySplitTM]
    rw [hr, if_pos rfl]
  rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hc, htr, sl_apply_eq _ _ rfl rfl]
  apply Cfg.ext <;> dsimp only <;> try rfl
  · funext j
    rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
    · rw [Function.update_self, if_neg (Ne.symm hne), if_pos rfl]
      dsimp only
      rw [Option.getD_some]
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
      rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
      · rw [if_pos rfl]
        dsimp only
        rw [Option.getD_none, Function.update_eq_self]
      · rw [if_neg hjsrc, if_neg hjsm]
        dsimp only
        rw [Option.getD_none, Function.update_eq_self]
  · funext j
    rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
    · rw [Function.update_self, if_neg (Ne.symm hne), if_pos rfl]
      simp
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
      rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
      · rw [Function.update_self, if_pos rfl]
        simp
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc, if_neg hjsrc, if_neg hjsm]
        simp

/-- The split leaf's exit step: at `copy` reading the terminator on `src`, write `false` under
the head of `sm` (which stays), blank the scanned cell of `src`, advance the head of `src`, and
enter `done`.

**Proof sketch.** At `copy` reading `false` the table gives the terminating action; apply it
through `sl_apply_eq` and compare the fields tape by tape, using `src ≠ sm`. -/
private lemma sl_split_step_exit {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src sm : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ sm)
    {c : Cfg k Bool sl_SplitPhase x} (hc : c.state = some .copy)
    (hr : c.workTapeSymbols src = some false) :
    (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step c =
      { c with
        state := some .done
        workTapes := Function.update (Function.update c.workTapes src
            (Function.update (c.workTapes src) (c.workTapePos src) none)) sm
          (Function.update (c.workTapes sm) (c.workTapePos sm) (some false))
        workTapePos := Function.update c.workTapePos src (c.workTapePos src + 1) } := by
  have htr : (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).tr .copy c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols =
      ⟨0, fun j => if j = src then (some none, .pos) else if j = sm then (some (some false), 0)
        else (none, 0), none, some .done⟩ := by
    simp only [sl_unarySplitTM]
    rw [hr]
    simp
  rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hc, htr, sl_apply_eq _ _ rfl rfl]
  apply Cfg.ext <;> dsimp only <;> try rfl
  · funext j
    rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
    · rw [Function.update_self, if_neg (Ne.symm hne), if_pos rfl]
      dsimp only
      rw [Option.getD_some]
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
      rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
      · rw [Function.update_self, if_pos rfl]
        dsimp only
        rw [Option.getD_some]
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc, if_neg hjsrc, if_neg hjsm]
        dsimp only
        rw [Option.getD_none, Function.update_eq_self]
  · funext j
    rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
    · rw [Function.update_self, if_pos rfl]
      simp
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc, if_neg hjsrc]
      rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
      · rw [if_pos rfl]
        simp
      · rw [if_neg hjsm]
        simp

/-- The copying loop of the unary-split leaf, framed: from `copy` with the unary word `1^q 0`
under the head of `src`, the leaf exits in exactly `q + 1` steps and not earlier, having
written `1^q 0` on `sm` from that head's cell on (that head ends on the terminator), blanked
the terminator's cell on `src`, and moved the head of `src` one cell past it. The output and
everything off the two heads' ranges are unchanged, at every time up to the exit.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on `q`. At `q = 0` the source head reads the terminator, and one exit
step (`sl_split_step_exit`) gives the endpoint. At `q + 1` one copying step
(`sl_split_step_true`) writes `true` on `sm` and advances both heads, leaving `1^q 0` under the
source head; the induction hypothesis gives the rest, and the written cells join the new one
cell by cell. The cut and silence follow by splitting off the first step. -/
private theorem sl_unarySplit_copy {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src sm : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ sm)
    (q : ℕ) (d : Cfg k Bool sl_SplitPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .copy)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ q →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = some (decide (p < q))) :
    (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d (q + 1) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapes := Function.update (Function.update d.workTapes src
              (Function.update (d.workTapes src) (d.workTapePos src + q) none)) sm
            (fun z => if d.workTapePos sm ≤ z ∧ z ≤ d.workTapePos sm + q
              then some (decide (z < d.workTapePos sm + q)) else d.workTapes sm z)
          workTapePos := Function.update (Function.update d.workTapePos src
            (d.workTapePos src + q + 1)) sm (d.workTapePos sm + q) } ∧
      (∀ t < q + 1, ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      ∀ t ≤ q + 1, ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d t).output = d.output := by
  induction q generalizing d with
  | zero =>
    have h0 := hw 0 le_rfl
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, decide_eq_false (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)] at h0
    have hs := sl_split_step_exit src sm hne hstate
      (by rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]; exact h0)
    have hrun1 : (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d 1 = (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step d := by
      rw [show (1 : ℕ) = 0 + 1 from rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step',
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [show ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 0 from by norm_num, hrun1, hs]
      apply Cfg.ext <;> dsimp only <;> try rfl
      · funext j
        rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
        · simp only [Function.update_self]
          funext z
          rcases eq_or_ne z (d.workTapePos j) with rfl | hz
          · rw [Function.update_self, if_pos (by omega)]
            congr 1
            symm
            rw [decide_eq_false_iff_not]
            omega
          · rw [Function.update_of_ne hz, if_neg (by omega)]
        · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
          rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
          · simp only [Function.update_self, add_zero]
          · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc]
      · funext j
        rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
        · simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hne), add_zero]
        · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
          rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
          · simp only [Function.update_self, add_zero]
          · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc]
    · intro t ht
      rcases t with _ | t
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hstate]
        simp
      · omega
    · intro t ht
      rcases t with _ | t
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
      · rcases t with _ | t
        · rw [hrun1, hs]
        · omega
  | succ q ih =>
    have h0 := hw 0 (by omega)
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, decide_eq_true (by omega : 0 < q + 1)] at h0
    have hs := sl_split_step_true src sm hne hstate
      (by rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]; exact h0)
    have hw₁ : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ q →
        ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step d).workTapes src
          (((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step d).workTapePos src + p) =
          some (decide (p < q)) := by
      intro p hp
      rw [hs]
      dsimp only
      rw [Function.update_of_ne hne, Function.update_of_ne hne, Function.update_self]
      have h := hw (1 + p) (by omega)
      rw [show (d.workTapePos src + ((1 + p : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
          d.workTapePos src + 1 + (p : ℕ) from by
        push_cast; ring, show decide (1 + p < q + 1) = decide (p < q) from by
        rw [decide_eq_decide]; omega] at h
      exact h
    obtain ⟨ihrun, ihcut, ihout⟩ := ih ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step d) (by rw [hs]) hw₁
    have hstep1 : ∀ t : ℕ, (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d (t + 1) =
        (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step d) t := fun t =>
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hstep1 (q + 1), ihrun, hs]
      apply Cfg.ext <;> dsimp only <;> try rfl
      · funext j
        rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
        · simp only [Function.update_self]
          funext z
          by_cases hz1 : d.workTapePos j + 1 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ d.workTapePos j + 1 + (q : ℕ)
          · rw [if_pos hz1, if_pos (by omega)]
            congr 1
            rw [decide_eq_decide]
            omega
          · rw [if_neg hz1]
            by_cases hz0 : z = d.workTapePos j
            · subst hz0
              rw [Function.update_self, if_pos (by omega)]
              congr 1
              symm
              rw [decide_eq_true_eq]
              omega
            · rw [Function.update_of_ne hz0, if_neg (by omega)]
        · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
          rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
          · simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
            congr 1
            push_cast
            ring
          · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc, Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
      · funext j
        rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
        · simp only [Function.update_self]
          push_cast
          ring
        · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
          rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
          · simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
            push_cast
            ring
          · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc, Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
    · intro t ht
      rcases t with _ | t
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hstate]
        simp
      · rw [hstep1 t]
        exact ihcut t (by omega)
    · intro t ht
      rcases t with _ | t
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
      · rw [hstep1 t, ihout t (by omega), hs]

/-- **The unary-split leaf, framed.** From any configuration in `mv1` whose tape `src` holds the
unary word `1^q 0` from its head, the leaf reaches `done` at exactly `q + 3` and not earlier,
with the word written on `sm` from two cells right of that tape's head (that head ends on the
written terminator), the terminator's cell of `src` blanked and its head one cell past it, and
everything else — every other cell, every other head, the input position and the output —
unchanged. The output is unchanged at every time up to the exit.

**Proof sketch.** Two offset moves of the head of `sm` (`sl_step_move`), which leave `src`
untouched, then the copying loop (`sl_unarySplit_copy`) from the shifted summary head. Compose at
time `2` and collect the fields. -/
private theorem sl_unarySplitTM_run {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src sm : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ sm)
    (q : ℕ) (d : Cfg k Bool sl_SplitPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .mv1)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ q →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = some (decide (p < q))) :
    (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d (q + 3) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapes := Function.update (Function.update d.workTapes src
              (Function.update (d.workTapes src) (d.workTapePos src + q) none)) sm
            (fun z => if d.workTapePos sm + 2 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ d.workTapePos sm + 2 + q
              then some (decide (z < d.workTapePos sm + 2 + q)) else d.workTapes sm z)
          workTapePos := Function.update (Function.update d.workTapePos src
            (d.workTapePos src + q + 1)) sm (d.workTapePos sm + 2 + q) } ∧
      (∀ t < q + 3, ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      ∀ t ≤ q + 3, ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d t).output = d.output := by
  have hs1 : (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step d =
      { d with
        state := some .mv2
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 1) } :=
    sl_step_move _ sm hstate _ (by simp only [sl_unarySplitTM])
  have hs2 : (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step { d with
      state := some sl_SplitPhase.mv2
      workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 1) } =
      { d with
        state := some .copy
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 2) } := by
    refine (sl_step_move (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm) sm
      (c := { d with
        state := some sl_SplitPhase.mv2
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 1) })
      rfl .copy (by simp only [sl_unarySplitTM])).trans ?_
    apply Cfg.ext <;> dsimp only
    rw [Function.update_idem, Function.update_self]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hrun1 : (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d 1 =
      { d with
        state := some .mv2
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 1) } := by
    rw [show (1 : ℕ) = 0 + 1 from rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step',
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hs1]
  have hrun2 : (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d 2 =
      { d with
        state := some .copy
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 2) } := by
    rw [show (2 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 from rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', hrun1, hs2]
  have hw₂ : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ q →
      ({ d with
          state := some sl_SplitPhase.copy
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 2) } :
        Cfg k Bool sl_SplitPhase x).workTapes src
        (({ d with
            state := some sl_SplitPhase.copy
            workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 2) } :
          Cfg k Bool sl_SplitPhase x).workTapePos src + p) = some (decide (p < q)) := by
    intro p hp
    dsimp only
    rw [Function.update_of_ne hne]
    exact hw p hp
  obtain ⟨crun, ccut, cout⟩ := sl_unarySplit_copy src sm hne q _ rfl hw₂
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [show q + 3 = 2 + (q + 1) from by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun2, crun]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> dsimp only <;> try rfl
    · simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hne]
    · funext j
      rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
      · simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hne]
      · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
        rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
        · simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
        · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc, Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
  · intro t ht
    rcases t with _ | _ | t
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hstate]
      simp
    · rw [hrun1]
      simp
    · rw [show t + 1 + 1 = 2 + t from by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun2]
      exact ccut t (by omega)
  · intro t ht
    rcases t with _ | _ | t
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    · rw [hrun1]
    · rw [show t + 1 + 1 = 2 + t from by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun2]
      exact cout t (by omega)

/-! ### Private layer: the word identities

The source word `s = pairEncode a (1^q 0 ++ v)` splits as the header `pairEncode a []`, the
unary field and the table field; its cells are read through `Turing.pairEncode_eq` and the
published `Turing.FinTM.bufferTape` identities only. -/

/-- The unary word's cells at an integer index: `true` strictly below `q`, `false` at `q`. -/
private lemma sl_bufferTape_unary_int (q : ℕ) {z : ℤ} (h0 : 0 ≤ z) (hq : z ≤ (q : ℕ)) :
    FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate q true ++ [false]) z = some (decide (z < (q : ℕ))) := by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r : ℕ, z = (r : ℤ) := ⟨z.toNat, (Int.toNat_of_nonneg h0).symm⟩
  rw [FinTM.bufferTape_unary q r (by exact_mod_cast hq)]
  congr 1
  rw [decide_eq_decide]
  omega

/-- The written summary cells, as the unary word's buffer two cells right: the interval
`[2, 2 + q]` filled with `1^q 0` over a blank tape reads `bufferTape (1^q 0) (z - 2)`. -/
private lemma sl_sm_word (q : ℕ) (z : ℤ) :
    (if 2 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ 2 + (q : ℕ) then some (decide (z < 2 + (q : ℕ)))
      else (none : Option Bool))
      = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate q true ++ [false]) (z - 2) := by
  by_cases hz : 2 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ 2 + (q : ℕ)
  · rw [if_pos hz, sl_bufferTape_unary_int q (by omega) (by omega)]
    congr 1
    rw [decide_eq_decide]
    omega
  · rw [if_neg hz, FinTM.bufferTape_eq_none_of_not_mem]
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_replicate, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
    push_cast
    omega

/-- The unary word read backward: cell `q - p` of `1^q 0` is cell `p` of its reversal, for
every `p ≤ q + 1` (at `p = q + 1` both reads are the blanks off the word). -/
private lemma sl_reverse_read (q : ℕ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ q + 1) :
    FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate q true ++ [false]) ((q : ℕ) - (p : ℕ) : ℤ)
      = FinTM.bufferTape ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]).reverse) p := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p (q + 1) with hlt | hge
  · rw [show ((q : ℕ) : ℤ) - (p : ℕ) = ((q - p : ℕ) : ℤ) from by omega,
      FinTM.bufferTape_nat,
      FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_reverse (by simp; omega)]
    congr 1
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_replicate, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
    omega
  · obtain rfl : p = q + 1 := by omega
    rw [show ((q : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (-1 : ℤ) from by push_cast; ring,
      FinTM.bufferTape_left]
    symm
    apply FinTM.bufferTape_eq_none_of_not_mem
    simp only [List.length_reverse, List.length_append, List.length_replicate,
      List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
    push_cast
    omega

/-- The unary field's cells of the source word: in `pairEncode a (1^q 0 ++ v)`, the cell
`2|a| + 2 + p` holds `true` for `p < q` and `false` for `p = q`. -/
private lemma sl_read_unary (a v : List Bool) (q : ℕ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ q) :
    FinTM.bufferTape (pairEncode a ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]) ++ v))
      ((2 * a.length + 2 + p : ℕ)) = some (decide (p < q)) := by
  rw [show pairEncode a ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]) ++ v) =
      pairEncode a [] ++ ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]) ++ v) from by
      rw [pairEncode_eq, pairEncode_eq]
      simp,
    show ((2 * a.length + 2 + p : ℕ) : ℤ) =
        ((pairEncode a [] : List Bool).length : ℤ) + (p : ℕ) from by
      rw [length_pairEncode, List.length_nil]
      push_cast
      ring,
    FinTM.bufferTape_append_shift _ _ (Int.natCast_nonneg p), FinTM.bufferTape_nat,
    List.getElem?_append_left (by simp; omega),
    ← FinTM.bufferTape_nat, FinTM.bufferTape_unary q p hp]

/-- The table field's cells of the source word: past the header and the unary field,
`pairEncode a (1^q 0 ++ v)` reads the table word's buffer, its right blank and every cell
beyond it included. -/
private lemma sl_read_table (a v : List Bool) (q : ℕ) {p : ℤ} (h0 : 0 ≤ p) :
    FinTM.bufferTape (pairEncode a ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]) ++ v))
      (((2 * a.length + 2 + q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + p) = FinTM.bufferTape v p := by
  rw [show pairEncode a ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]) ++ v) =
      (pairEncode a [] ++ (List.replicate q true ++ [false])) ++ v from by
      rw [pairEncode_eq, pairEncode_eq]
      simp,
    show ((2 * a.length + 2 + q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
        ((pairEncode a [] ++ (List.replicate q true ++ [false])).length : ℤ) from by
      simp only [List.length_append, length_pairEncode, List.length_replicate,
        List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
      push_cast
      ring,
    FinTM.bufferTape_append_shift _ _ h0]

/-! ### Private layer: the phase host

Eight phases on `Turing.phaseHostTM`: six catalog rows through their `_run_ofCfg` contracts and
the two leaves. The host's table is read only through `Turing.phaseHostTM_run`; the last
phase's `done` redirects to itself, so the lemma's lockstep window covers the clear to its
exact exit time, and the dispatch that the self-redirect would take lies strictly after the
contract's horizon. -/

/-- The eight phases of the seam layout, in route order. -/
private inductive sl_Key where
  /-- phase 1: skip over the suffix `s.drop r` on the source tape -/
  | skipRest
  /-- phase 2: skip back over the whole source word -/
  | rewindAll
  /-- phase 3: the pair-skip leaf over the header -/
  | pairSkip
  /-- phase 4: the unary-split leaf -/
  | unarySplit
  /-- phase 5: the walk home on the summary tape -/
  | walkHome
  /-- phase 6: the transfer of the table word -/
  | moveTable
  /-- phase 7: skip back over the remaining prefix -/
  | rewindHead
  /-- phase 8: clear the remaining prefix; its `done` is the exit -/
  | clearHead
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- Each phase's control carrier. -/
private abbrev sl_Ph : sl_Key → Type
  | .skipRest | .rewindAll | .walkHome | .rewindHead => SeekPhase
  | .pairSkip => sl_PairPhase
  | .unarySplit => sl_SplitPhase
  | .moveTable | .clearHead => SweepPhase

/-- Each phase's machine: four catalog seek/sweep rows, the transfer row and the two leaves. -/
private def sl_part (k : ℕ) (src tbl sm : Fin k) : (i : sl_Key) → MultiTapeTM k Bool (sl_Ph i)
  | .skipRest => skipTM k src
  | .rewindAll => skipBackTM k src
  | .pairSkip => sl_pairSkipTM k src
  | .unarySplit => sl_unarySplitTM k src sm
  | .walkHome => walkTM k sm (· = sm) .neg
  | .moveTable => transferTM k src tbl
  | .rewindHead => skipBackTM k src
  | .clearHead => clearTM k src

/-- The dispatch table: each phase's `done` redirects to the next phase's entry, and the last
phase's `done` to itself (the redirect is never taken inside the contract's horizon). -/
private def sl_red : (i : sl_Key) → sl_Ph i → Option ((j : sl_Key) × sl_Ph j)
  | .skipRest, s => if s = .done then some ⟨.rewindAll, .run⟩ else none
  | .rewindAll, s => if s = .done then some ⟨.pairSkip, .start⟩ else none
  | .pairSkip, s => if s = .done then some ⟨.unarySplit, .mv1⟩ else none
  | .unarySplit, s => if s = .done then some ⟨.walkHome, .run⟩ else none
  | .walkHome, s => if s = .done then some ⟨.moveTable, .sweep⟩ else none
  | .moveTable, s => if s = .done then some ⟨.rewindHead, .run⟩ else none
  | .rewindHead, s => if s = .done then some ⟨.clearHead, .sweep⟩ else none
  | .clearHead, s => if s = .done then some ⟨.clearHead, .done⟩ else none

/-- Each phase carrier is finite. -/
private instance sl_instFintypePh (i : sl_Key) : Fintype (sl_Ph i) := by
  cases i <;> dsimp only [sl_Ph] <;> infer_instance

/-- Each phase carrier has decidable equality. -/
private instance sl_instDecEqPh (i : sl_Key) : DecidableEq (sl_Ph i) := by
  cases i <;> dsimp only [sl_Ph] <;> infer_instance

/-- The canonical mid-run configuration of the seam layout: a control state, the three owned
tapes' contents and head positions, over an arbitrary frame `d` whose other tapes, input
position and output ride along untouched. -/
private def sl_cfg {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} {S : Type} (src tbl sm : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool ((i : sl_Key) × sl_Ph i) x) (st : S) (wsrc wtbl wsm : ℤ → Option Bool)
    (psrc ptbl psm : ℤ) : Cfg k Bool S x where
  state := some st
  inputPos := d.inputPos
  workTapes := Function.update (Function.update (Function.update d.workTapes src wsrc)
    tbl wtbl) sm wsm
  workTapePos := Function.update (Function.update (Function.update d.workTapePos src psrc)
    tbl ptbl) sm psm
  output := d.output

/-- The dispatch's rewrap: a live configuration with its control replaced by the next phase's
tagged entry is the next phase's configuration, tagged — provided the two agree on every field
but the control. -/
private lemma sl_rewrap {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} {S : Type} {i' : sl_Key}
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (c₂ : Cfg k Bool (sl_Ph i') x) (ent : sl_Ph i') (st₀ : S)
    (hc : c.state = some st₀) (hstate : c₂.state = some ent) (hin : c.inputPos = c₂.inputPos)
    (hw : c.workTapes = c₂.workTapes) (hp : c.workTapePos = c₂.workTapePos)
    (ho : c.output = c₂.output) :
    c.mapState (fun _ => (⟨i', ent⟩ : (j : sl_Key) × sl_Ph j)) =
      c₂.mapState (Sigma.mk i') := by
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_state, Cfg.mapState_state, hc, hstate, Option.map_some, Option.map_some]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos, Cfg.mapState_inputPos, hin]
  · funext j p
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes, Cfg.mapState_workTapes, hw]
  · funext j
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, hp]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_output, Cfg.mapState_output, ho]

/-- A phase guard from a row's first-visit cut: strictly before the exit, every live control
state of the phase leaves the dispatch table silent. -/
private lemma sl_guard {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src tbl sm : Fin k) (i : sl_Key)
    {c : Cfg k Bool (sl_Ph i) x} {T : ℕ} (done' : sl_Ph i)
    (hred : ∀ st : sl_Ph i, st ≠ done' → sl_red i st = none)
    (hcut : ∀ t < T, ((sl_part k src tbl sm i).runFrom c t).state ≠ some done') :
    ∀ u < T, ∀ st, ((sl_part k src tbl sm i).runFrom c u).state = some st →
      sl_red i st = none :=
  fun u hu st hst => hred st (fun hh => hcut u hu (hh ▸ hst))

/-- A host state tagged by a phase other than the last is never the exit. -/
private lemma sl_tagged_ne_done {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (i : sl_Key) (hi : i ≠ .clearHead)
    (c : Cfg k Bool (sl_Ph i) x) :
    (c.mapState (Sigma.mk i)).state ≠
      some (⟨.clearHead, .done⟩ : (j : sl_Key) × sl_Ph j) := by
  rw [Cfg.mapState_state]
  cases hc : c.state with
  | none => simp
  | some st =>
    simp only [Option.map_some, ne_eq, Option.some.injEq]
    intro hcon
    exact hi (congrArg Sigma.fst hcon)

/-- Phase 1, hosted: the skip over the suffix `s.drop r` of the source word, one dispatch into
phase 2; no state of its window is the exit.

**Proof sketch.** From the head, the source cells are `s.drop r` and its right blank
(`Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_drop`), the premise of `Turing.skipTM_run_ofCfg`, which ends with the
head at `|s| + 1`. Then `Turing.phaseHostTM_run`, with its guard from the row's first-visit
cut (`sl_guard`), gives the lockstep window and the dispatch, and `sl_rewrap` identifies the
dispatched configuration with the next phase's, field by field. Every state of the window
carries this phase's tag, so none is the exit (`sl_tagged_ne_done`). -/
private lemma sl_phase1 {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src tbl sm : Fin k) (hst : src ≠ tbl)
    (hss : src ≠ sm) (d : Cfg k Bool ((i : sl_Key) × sl_Ph i) x)
    (s : List Bool) (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ s.length) (wt ws : ℤ → Option Bool) (pt ps : ℤ) :
    (phaseHostTM (sl_part k src tbl sm) ⟨.skipRest, .run⟩ sl_red).runFrom
        ((sl_cfg src tbl sm d SeekPhase.run (FinTM.bufferTape s) wt ws
          (r : ℤ) pt ps).mapState (Sigma.mk sl_Key.skipRest)) ((s.drop r).length + 1 + 1) =
      (sl_cfg src tbl sm d SeekPhase.run (FinTM.bufferTape s) wt ws
        ((s.length : ℤ) + 1) pt ps).mapState (Sigma.mk sl_Key.rewindAll) ∧
    ∀ u ≤ (s.drop r).length + 1,
      (((phaseHostTM (sl_part k src tbl sm) ⟨.skipRest, .run⟩ sl_red).runFrom
        ((sl_cfg src tbl sm d SeekPhase.run (FinTM.bufferTape s) wt ws
          (r : ℤ) pt ps).mapState (Sigma.mk sl_Key.skipRest)) u).state) ≠
        some (⟨.clearHead, .done⟩ : (j : sl_Key) × sl_Ph j) := by
  have hw : ∀ p : ℤ, 0 ≤ p → p ≤ ((s.drop r).length : ℤ) →
      (sl_cfg src tbl sm d SeekPhase.run (FinTM.bufferTape s) wt ws
          (r : ℤ) pt ps).workTapes src
        ((sl_cfg src tbl sm d SeekPhase.run (FinTM.bufferTape s) wt ws
          (r : ℤ) pt ps).workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape (s.drop r) p := by
    intro p h0 _
    dsimp only [sl_cfg]
    simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hss, Function.update_of_ne hst]
    exact (FinTM.bufferTape_drop s r h0).symm
  obtain ⟨row, cut, -⟩ := skipTM_run_ofCfg src (s.drop r)
    (sl_cfg src tbl sm d SeekPhase.run (FinTM.bufferTape s) wt ws (r : ℤ) pt ps) rfl hw
  have H := phaseHostTM_run (sl_part k src tbl sm) ⟨.skipRest, .run⟩ sl_red .skipRest
    _ _ ((s.drop r).length + 1) row SeekPhase.done rfl ⟨.rewindAll, .run⟩
    (by simp [sl_red])
    (sl_guard src tbl sm .skipRest SeekPhase.done
      (fun st h => by simp only [sl_red]; rw [if_neg h]) cut)
  refine ⟨H.2.trans ?_, fun u hu => ?_⟩
  · refine sl_rewrap _ _ _ SeekPhase.done ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · funext j
      dsimp only [sl_cfg]
      by_cases hjsrc : j = src
      · rw [hjsrc, Function.update_self]
        simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hss, Function.update_of_ne hst]
        rw [List.length_drop]
        omega
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc]
        by_cases hjsm : j = sm
        · rw [hjsm]
          simp only [Function.update_self]
        · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
          by_cases hjtbl : j = tbl
          · rw [hjtbl]
            simp only [Function.update_self]
          · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjtbl, Function.update_of_ne hjsrc]
    · rfl
  · rw [H.1 u hu]
    exact sl_tagged_ne_done .skipRest (by decide) _

/-- Phase 2, hosted: the skip back over the whole source word, one dispatch into phase 3.

**Proof sketch.** With the head at `|s| + 1`, the word `s` ends one blank before it, the premise
of `Turing.skipBackTM_run_ofCfg`, which returns the head to `0`. As for phase 1, the host lemma,
the rewrap and the phase tag finish. -/
private lemma sl_phase2 {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src tbl sm : Fin k) (hst : src ≠ tbl)
    (hss : src ≠ sm) (d : Cfg k Bool ((i : sl_Key) × sl_Ph i) x)
    (s : List Bool) (wt ws : ℤ → Option Bool) (pt ps : ℤ) :
    (phaseHostTM (sl_part k src tbl sm) ⟨.skipRest, .run⟩ sl_red).runFrom
        ((sl_cfg src tbl sm d SeekPhase.run (FinTM.bufferTape s) wt ws
